Bekhorot 35a:4-16: Gemara paam acheret haya kulei. utzericha, dei ashmeinan goy — dela ate lemisrach, aval katan deate lemisrach — ema la.
Vei ashmoinan katan, mishshum dela ate leichallofe begadol, aval goy deate leichallofe begadol — ema la. tzericha.
Amar rav chisda amar rav kattina: lo shanu ella daamaru leh "ella im ken haya bo mum", aval im amaru leh "im naasa bo mum" — keman daamaru leh "zil aved beh muma" dame.
Amar rava: mikkede mimmela hu, ma li "haya", ma li "naasa"? ella "naasa" name mimmela hu, vela shena.
Ze hakkelal: kol shehu ledaat — asur. leetoye may? leetoye gerama.
Shello ledaat — leetoye mesiach lefi tummo.
Mishna haya bechor rodfo, beato, veasa bo mum — hare ze shochatin alav.
Gemara amar rav pappa: lo shanu ella shebbeato bishat redifa, aval leachar redifa — la. peshita!
Mahu detema: tzareh hu demiddechar, ka mashma lan.
Ikka deamri, amar rav pappa: la tema bishat redifa — in, aval shello bishat redifa — la, ella afillu leachar redifa name. may tama? tzaareh [hu] demiddechar.
Amar rav yehuda: muttar lehattil mum bivchor kodem sheyyatza laavir haolam. amar rava: gadya beudeneh, immera besifvavteh. ikka deamri: immera name beudeneh, emor derech tzedaav nefak.

Amar rava: achel vela michaze, pae umichaze — have muma. may ka mashma lan? tenena: hachutin hachitzonot — shennifgemu veshennigmemu, happenimiyyot — shenneekru. may tama? lav mishshum dechi pae michze?!
Amar rav pappa: rava name tama dematnitin mefaresh, may tama nekeru have muma — mishshum dechi pae michze.
Berakhot 51a:13-17: Amar rabbi yishmael ben elisha: shelosha devarim sach li suriel sar happanim: al tittol chalukecha beshacharit miyyad hashshammash vetilbash. veal tittol yadecha mimmi shello natal yadav. veal tachazir kos isparagos ella lemi shennetano lecha — mippene shettachsefit, veamri la, istalganit shel malache chabbala metzappin lo laadam, veomrim: ematay yavo adam lide echad middevarim hallalu veyillached.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, shelosha devarim sach li malach hammavet: al tittol chalukecha shacharit miyyad hashshammash vetilbash. veal tittol yadecha mimmi shello natal yadav. veal taamod lifne hannashim beshaa shechozrot min hammet, mippene sheani merakked uva lifnehen vecharbi beyaday veyesh li reshut lechabbel.

Vei paga, may takkanteh? linshof midducheteh arba ammot, i ikka nahara — lebereh, vei ikka darka acharina — lezil ba, vei ikka guda — leku achora, vei la — layhdar appeh velema: "vayyomer Adonai el hassatan yigar Adonai becha vegomer" ad dechalfi minneh.

Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi avahu, veamri la bematnita tana: asara devarim neemru bechos shel beracha: taun haddacha ushetifa. chay umale. ittur veittuf. notlo bishte yadav, venotno bayyamin. umagbiho min hakkarka tefach, venoten enav bo. veyesh omrim: af meshaggero bemattana leanshe veto.
Amar rabbi yochanan: anu en lanu ella arbaa bilvad: hadacha, shetifa, chay, umale. tana: hadacha — mibbifnim, ushetifa — mibbachutz.

Makkot 23a:1-12: Amar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: minnayin lirtzua shehi shel egel – dichtiv "arbaim yakkennu", usemich leh "lo tachsom shor bedisho".

Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: minnayin livama shennafla lifne mukke shechin, sheen chosmin otah – dichtiv "lo tachsom shor bedisho", usemich leh "ki yeshvu achim yachdav vegomer".
Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: kol hamevazze et hammoadim keillu oved avoda zara, dichtiv "elohe massecha lo taase lach", usemich leh "et chag hammatztzot tishmor".

Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: kol hamesapper lashon hara, vechen hamekabbel lashon hara, vechol hammeid edut sheker – rauy lehashelicho lichlavim, dichtiv "lakkelev tashlichun oto", usemich leh "lo tissa shema shav vegomer", keri beh name "lo tassi".

Ushete retzuot vechulei. tana: shel chamor. kiddaresh hahu galilaa aleh derav chisda: "yada shor konehu vachamor evus bealav yisrael lo yada vegomer", amar hakkadosh baruch hu: yavo mi shemmakkir evus bealav, veyippara mimmi sheeno makkir evus bealav.

Yadah tefach vechulei. amar abbaye: shema minna kol chad vechad lefum gabbeh avdinan leh. amar leh rava: im ken nappesh lehu retzuot tuva! ella amar rava: avkata it lay, ki bae meykattar bay, ki bae merappe ba.
Malkin oto vechulei. mena hane mille? amar rav kahana: deamar kera "vehippilo hashshofet vehikkahu lefanav kede rishato bemispar" – risha achat millefanav, shete rishayot meacharav.

En malkin oto vechulei. amar rav chisda amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin lirtzua shehi muchepelet – shenneemar "vehippilo". veha mibbee leh legufeh! im ken lichtov kera "yattehu", may "hippilo"? shema minna tarte.
Hammakke makke beyado. tanu rabbanan: en maamidin chazzanin ella chasere choach vitere madda. rabbi yehuda omer: afillu chasere madda vitere koach.

Amar rava: kevoteh derabbi yehuda mistabbera, dichtiv "lo yosif... pen yosif", i amrat bishlama chasere madda – hayeynu ditzrich leazhore. ella i amrat yetere madda – mi tzerich leazhore? verabbanan: en mezarzin ella lamzoraz.
Tana: keshehu magbiah – magbiah bishte yadav, ucheshehu makke – makke beyado achat, ki hechi (delete) [detete] middideh.
Mishnah Mikvaot 5:1-4:
Mayan sheheeviro al gabbe hashshoket, pasul. heeviro al gabbe safa chol shehu, kasher chutza lah, shehammayan metaher bechol shehu. heeviro al gabbe verecha vehifsiko, hare hu chemikve. chazar vehimshicho, pasul lazzavim velamtzoraim ulekaddesh mehen me chattat, ad sheyyeda sheyyatzu harishonim: 
Heeviro al gabbe chelim o al gabbe safsal, rabbi yehuda omer, hare hu chemo shehaya. rabbi yose omer, hare hu chemikve, uvilvad shello yatbil al gabbe hassafsal: 
Mayan shehu mashuch kenadal, ribba alav vehimshicho, hare hu chemo shehaya. haya omed veribba alav vehimshicho, shave lemikve letaher beashboren, ulemayan lehatebil bo bechol shehu: 
Kol hayyammim kemikve, shenneemar (Bereshit 1), ulemikve hammayim kara yammim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, hayyam haggadol kemikve. lo neemar yammim, ella sheyyesh bo mine yammim harebe. rabbi yose omer, kol hayyammim metaharim bezochalin, ufesulin lazzavin velamtzoraim, ulekaddesh mehem me chattat:
Mishnah Mikvaot 5:5-6:2:
Hazzochalin, kemayan. vehannotfim, kemikve. heid rabbi tzadok al hazzochalin sherabbu al hannotfim, shehem kesherim. venotfim sheasaan zochalin, somech afillu makkel, afillu kane, afillu zav vezava, yored vetovel, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, kol davar shehu mekabbel tuma, en mazchilin bo: 
Gal shennitlash uvo arbaim sea, venafal al haadam veal hakkelim, tehorim. kol makom sheyyesh bo arbaim sea, tovlin umatbilin. matbilin bacharitzin uvinatzim uvefarsat hachamor hameorevet babbika. bet shammay omrim, matbilin bechardalit. bet hillel omrim, en matbilin. umodim shehu goder kelim vetovel bahem. vechelim sheggadar bahem, lo hutbelu: 
Kol hameorav lammikve, kammikve. chore hammeara vesidke hammeara, matbil bahem kema shehem. ukkat hammeara, en matbilin bah ella im ken hayta nekuva chishfoferet hannod. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehi maamedet atzmah. aval im enah maamedet atzmah, matbilin bah kema shehi: 
Deli shehu male chelim vehitbilan, hare ellu tehorim. veim lo taval, en hammayim meoravin, ad sheyyihyu meoravin kishfoferet hannod:
Mishnah Mikvaot 6:3-7:
Shelosha mikvaot, baze esrim sea, uvaze esrim sea, uvaze esrim sea mayim sheuvin, vehashshauv min hatztzad, veyardu shelosha vetavlu vahen venitarvu, hammikvaot tehorin vehattovlim tehorim. haya hashshauv baemtza, veyardu shelosha vetavlu vahem venitarvu, hammikvaot kemot shehayu, vehattovlim kemot shehayu: 
Hassefog vehaddeli shehayu vahen shelosha luggin mayim venaflu lammikve, lo fesaluhu, shello amru ella shelosha luggin shennaflu: 
Hashshidda vehatteva shebbayyam, en matbilin bahem, ella im ken hayu nekuvin kishfoferet hannod. rabbi yehuda omer, bichli gadol, arbaa tefachim. uvekatan, rubbo. im haya sak o kuppa, matbilin bahem kema shehem, mippene shehammayim meoravin. hayu netunim tachat hatztzinnor, enam poslim et hammikve, ella matbilin otan umaalin otan kedarkan: 
Gistera shebbammikve vehitbil bah et hakkelim, taharu mittumatan, aval temeim al gav keli cheres. im hayu hammayim tzafim al gabbav kol shehen, tehorin. mayan hayyotze min hattannur veyarad vetaval betocho, hu tahor veyadav temeot. veim hayu al gabbav rum yadav, af yadav tehorot: 
Eruv mikvaot, kishfoferet hannod, keavyah vechachalalah, kishte etzbaot chozrot limkoman. safek kishfoferet hannod, safek sheenah kishfoferet hannod, pesula, mippene shehi min hattora. vechen kazzayit min hammet vechazzayit min hannevela vechaadasha min hashsheretz. kol sheyyaamod kishfoferet hannod, memaatah. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol shehu mibberiyyat hammayim, tahor:
Mishnah Mikvaot 6:8-11:
Metaharim et hammikvaot, haelyon min hattachton, veharachok min hakkarov. ketzad. mevi sillon shel cheres o shel avar, umanniach yado tachtav, ad shehu mitmalle mayim, umoshcho umashshiko, afillu chassaara, dayyo. haya vaelyon arbaim sea uvattachton en kelum, memalle vakkatef venoten laelyon, ad sheyyerdu lattachton arbaim sea: 
Kotel shebben shete mikvaot shennisdak lashsheti, mitztaref. velaerev, en mitztaref, ad sheyyehe vemakom echad kishfoferet hannod. rabbi yehuda omer, chilluf haddevarim. nifretzu ze vetoch ze, al rum, kiklippat hashshum. veal rochav, kishfoferet hannod: 
Haavik shebbammerchatz, bizman shehu vaemtza, posel. min hatztzad, eno fosel, mippene shehu chemikve samuch lemikve, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, im mekabbelet haambati reviit ad shello yaggiu laavik, kasher. veim lav, pasul. rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok omer, im mekabbel haavik kol shehu, pasul: 
Hammatheret shebbammerchatz, hattachtona melea sheuvin vehaelyona melea chesherin, im yesh keneged hannekev shelosha luggin, pasul. kamma yehe vannekev veyihye vo shelosha luggin. achad mishshelosh meot veesrim labberecha, divre rabbi yose. verabbi elazar omer, afillu hattachtona melea chesherim vehaelyona melea sheuvin veyesh betzad hannekev shelosha luggin, kasher, shello amru ella shelosha luggin shennaflu:
Mishnah Mikvaot 7:1-4:
Yesh maalin et hammikve velo foslin, poslin velo maalin, lo maalin velo foslin. ellu maalin velo foslin, hashsheleg, vehabbarad, vehakkefor, vehaggelid, vehammelach, vehattit hannarok. amar rabbi akiva, haya rabbi yishmael dan kenegdi lomar, hashsheleg eno maale et hammikve. veheidu anshe medva mishshemo sheamar lahem, tzeu vehaviu sheleg vaasu mikve battechilla. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, even habbarad, kammayim. ketzad maalin velo foslin. mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea chaser achat, nafal mehem sea letocho veheelahu, nimtzeu maalin velo foslin: 
Ellu foslin velo maalin, hammayim, ben temeim ben tehorim, ume chevashim ume shelakot, vehattemed ad shello hechemitz. ketzad poslin velo maalin. mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea chaser kortov, venafal mehen kortov letocho, lo heelahu, poslo vishlosha luggin. aval shear hammashkin, ume ferot, vehatztzir, vehammuryas, vehattemed mishshehechemitz, peamim maalin ufeamim sheenan maalin. ketzad. mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea chaser achat, nafal letocho sea mehem, lo heelahu. hayu vo arbaim sea, natan sea venatal sea, hare ze chasher: 
Hediach bo salle zetim vesalle anavim, veshinnu et marav, kasher. rabbi yose omer, me hatztzeva poslin oto vishlosha luggin, veenan poslin oto veshinnuy mare. nafal letocho yayin, umochal, veshinnu et marav, pasul. ketzad yaase. yamtin lo ad sheyyerdu geshamim veyachzeru marehen lemare hammayim. hayu vo arbaim sea, memalle vakkatef venoten letocho ad sheyyachzeru marehen lemare hammayim: 
Nafal letocho yayin o mochal veshinnu miktzat marav, im en bo mare mayim arbaim sea, hare ze lo yitbol bo:
Mishnah Mikvaot 7:5-8:2:
Shelosha luggin mayim, venafal letochan kortov yayin, vahare marehen kemare hayyayin, venaflu lemikve, lo fesaluhu. shelosha luggin mayim chaser kortov, venafal letochan kortov chalav, vahare marehen kemare hammayim, venaflu lemikve, lo fesaluhu. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, hakkol holech achar hammare: 
Mikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea mechuvvanot, yardu shenayim vetavlu ze achar ze, harishon tahor, vehashsheni tame. rabbi yehuda omer, im hayu raglav shel rishon nogot bammayim, af hashsheni tahor. hitbil bo et hassagos veheelahu, miktzato nogea bammayim, tahor. hakkar vehakkeset shel or, kevan shehigbiah siftotehem min hammayim, hammayim shebbetochan sheuvin. ketzad yaase, matbilan umaale otam derech shulehem: 
Hitbil bo et hammitta, af al pi sheragleha shokot battit heave, tehora, mippene shehammayim mekaddemin. mikve shemmemav meruddadin, kovesh afillu chavile etzim, afillu chavile kanim, kede sheyyitpechu hammayim, veyored vetovel. machat shehi netuna al maalot hammeara, haya molich umevi vammayim, kevan sheavar aleha haggal, tehora: 
Eretz yisrael tehora, umikveoteha tehorim. mikveot haammim shebbechutza laaretz, kesherim levaale kerayin, afillu nitmalleu vekilon. shebbeeretz yisrael, shechutz lammafteach, kesherim af leniddot. millifnim min hammafteach, kesherim levaale kerayin, ufesulim lechol hattemeim. rabbi eliezer omer, hakkerovim lair veladderech, temeim, mippene hakkevisa. veharchokim, tehorim:  
Ellu vaale kerayin shehem tzerichin tevila. raa mayim chalukim o achurim, battechilla, tahor. baemtza uvassof, tame. mittechilla vead sof, tahor. levanim venimshachim, tame. rabbi yose omer, levanim kaachurim:
Mishnah Sukkah 3:1-5:
Lulav haggazul vehayyavesh, pasul. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat, pasul. niktam rosho, nifretzu alav, pasul. nifredu alav, kasher. rabbi yehuda omer, yeegdennu milmala. tzinne har habbarzel, kesherot. lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim kede lenanea bo, kasher: 
Hadas haggazul vehayyavesh, pasul. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat, pasul. niktam rosho, nifretzu alav o shehayu anavav merubbot mealav, pasul. veim miatan, kasher. veen memaatin beyom tov: 
Arava gezula vivesha, pesula. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat, pesula. niktam roshah, nifretzu aleha, vehatztzaftzafa, pesula. kemusha, veshennashru miktzat aleha, veshel baal, keshera: 
Rabbi yishmael omer, shelosha hadassim ushete aravot, lulav echad veetrog echad, afillu shenayim ketumim veechad eno katum. rabbi tarfon omer, afillu shelashtan ketumim. rabbi akiva omer, keshem shellulav echad veetrog echad, kach hadas echad vaarava echat: 
Etrog haggazul vehayyavesh, pasul. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat, pasul. shel arla, pasul. shel teruma temea, pasul. shel teruma tehora, lo yittol, veim natal, kasher. shel demay, bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin. shel maaser sheni birushalayim, lo yittol, veim natal, kasher:
Mishnah Sukkah 3:10-13:
Mi shehaya eved o ishsha o katan makrin oto, one acharehen ma shehen omrin, utehi lo meera. im haya gadol makre oto, one acharav haleluyah: 
Makom shennahagu lichpol, yichpol. lifshot, yifshot. levarech acharav, yevarech acharav. hakkol keminhag hammedina. hallokeach lulav mechavero vashsheviit, noten lo etrog bemattana, lefi sheen rashshay lelakcho vashsheviit: 
Barishona haya lulav nittal bammikdash shiva, uvammedina yom echad. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe lulav nittal bammedina shiva, zecher lammikdash. vesheyyehe yom hanef kullo asur: 
Yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat, kol haam molichin et lulevehen levet hakkeneset. lammochorat mashkimin uvain, kol echad veechad makkir et shello, venotlo. mippene sheamru chachamim, en adam yotze yede chovato beyom tov harishon shel chag belulavo shel chavero. ushear yemot hechag, adam yotze yede chovato belulavo shel chavero:
Mishnah Sukkah 3:14-4:2:
Rabbi yose omer, yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat, veshachach vehotzi et hallulav lirshut harabbim, patur, mippene shehotzio virshut: 
Mekabbelet ishsha miyyad benah umiyyad balah umachazirato lammayim beshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, beshabbat machazirin, beyom tov mosifin, uvammoed machalifin. katan hayyodea lenanea, chayyav ballulav: 
Lulav vaarava, shishsha veshiva. hahallel vehassimcha, shemona. sukka venissuch hammayim, shiva. vehechalil, chamishsha veshishsha: 
Lulav shiva ketzad, yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat, lulav shiva, ushear kol hayyamim, shishsha:
Mishnah Sukkah 3:6-9:
Alta chazazit al rubbo, nittela fitmato, niklaf, nisdak, nikkav vechasar kol shehu, pasul. alta chazazit al miuto, nittal uktzo, nikkav velo chasar kol shehu, kasher. etrog hakkushi, pasul. vehayarok kecharti, rabbi meir machshir, verabbi yehuda posel: 
Shiur etrog hakkatan, rabbi meir omer, kaegoz. rabbi yehuda omer, kabbetza. uvegadol, kede sheyyochaz shenayim beyado achat, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, afillu echad bishte yadav: 
En ogdin et hallulav ella vemino, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, afillu vimshicha. amar rabbi meir, maase veanshe yerushalayim, shehayu ogdin et lulevehen begimoniyyot shel zahav. amru lo, bemino hayu ogdin oto millematta: 
Vehechan hayu menanein, behodu laAdonai techilla vasof, uveanna Adonai hoshia na, divre vet hillel. uvet shammay omrim, af beanna Adonai hatzelicha na. amar rabbi akiva, tzofe hayiti verabban gamliel uverabbi yehoshua, shekkol haam hayu menaneim et lulevehen, vehen lo nineu ella veanna Adonai hoshia na. mi shebba vadderech velo haya veyado lulav littol, lichsheyyikkanes leveto yittol al shulchano. lo natal shacharit, yittol ben haarbayim, shekkol hayyom kasher lallulav:
Mishnah Sukkah 4:3-7:
Arava shiva ketzad, yom shevii shel arava shechal lihyot beshabbat, arava shiva, ushear kol hayyamim shishsha: 
Mitzvat lulav ketzad. yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat, molichin et lulevehen lehar habbayit, vehachazzanin mekabbelin mehen vesodrin otan al gav haitztabba, vehazzekenim mannichin et shellahen ballishka. umelammedim otam lomar, kol mi shemmaggia lulavi veyado, hare hu lo vemattana. lemachar mashkimin uvain, vehachazzanin zorkin otam lifnehem. vehen mechattefin umakkin ish et chavero. uchesherau vet din shebbau lide sakkana, hitkinu sheyyehe chol echad veechad notel beveto: 
Mitzvat arava ketzad, makom haya lematta mirushalayim, venikra motza. yordin lesham umelakketin mishsham murbiyyot shel arava, uvain vezokfin otan betzidde hammizbeach, verashehen kefufin al gabbe hammizbeach. taku veheriu vetakau. bechol yom makkifin et hammizbeach paam achat, veomrim, anna Adonai hoshia na, anna Adonai hatzelicha na. rabbi yehuda omer, ani vaho hoshia na. veoto hayyom makkifin et hammizbeach sheva peamim. bishat petiratan, ma hen omrim, yofi lecha mizbeach, yofi lecha mizbeach. rabbi eliezer omer, leyah ulecha, mizbeach. leyah ulecha, mizbeach: 
Kemaasehu vechol kach maasehu veshabbat, ella shehayu melakketin otan meerev shabbat umannichim otan begigiyyot shel zahav, kede shello yichmoshu. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, chariyyot shel dekel hayu meviin, vechovtin otan bakkarka betzidde hammizbeach, veoto hayyom nikra yom chibbut chariyyot: 
Miyyad hattinokot shomtin et lulevehen veochlin etrogehen:
Mishnah Sukkah 4:8-5:1:
Hahallel vehassimcha shemona ketzad. melammed shechayyav adam bahallel uvassimcha uvichvod yom tov haacharon shel chag, kishar kol yemot hechag. sukka shiva ketzad. gamar milleechol, lo yattir sukkato, aval morid et hakkelim min hammincha ulemala, mippene chevod yom tov haacharon shel chag: 
Nissuch hammayim ketzad. tzelochit shel zahav machazeket sheloshet luggim haya memalle min hashshilloach. higgiu leshaar hammayim, taku veheriu vetakau. ala vakkevesh ufana lismolo, shene sefalim shel kesef hayu sham. rabbi yehuda omer, shel sid hayu, ella shehayu mushcharin penehem mippene hayyayin. umenukkavin kemin shene chotamin dakkin, echad meubbe veechad dak, kede sheyyehu shenehem kalin bevat achat. maaravi shel mayim, mizrachi shel yayin. era shel mayim letoch shel yayin, veshel yayin letoch shel mayim, yatza. rabbi yehuda omer, belog haya menassech kol shemona. velamnassech omrim lo, hageba yadecha, sheppaam achat nissech echad al gabbe raglav, uregamuhu chol haam beetrogehen: 
Kemaasehu vechol kach maasehu veshabbat, ella shehaya memalle meerev shabbat chavit shel zahav sheenah mekuddeshet, min hashshilloach, umannichah ballishka. nishpecha o nitgalleta, haya memalle min hakkiyyor, shehayyayin vehammayim hammegullin, pesulim legabbe hammizbeach: 
Hechalil chamishsha veshishsha. zehu hechalil shel bet hashshoeva, sheena docha lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov. amru, kol mi shello raa simchat bet hashshoeva, lo raa simcha miyyamav:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Ishsha lo tikra betzibbur mippene kevod hatztzibbur. katan hayyodea likrot veyodea lemi mevarchin ole mimminyan hakkorim. vechen maftir ole mehamminyan shehare hu kore battora. veim hifsik sheliach tzibbur bekaddish ben mashlim uven hammaftir eno ole min hamminyan. tzibbur shello haya bahem yodea likrot ella echad ole vekore veyored vechozer vekore sheniyya ushelishit ad sheyyigmor minyan hakkorim shel oto hayyom:

Bechol keria ukeria meellu kohen kore rishon veacharav levi veacharav miyyisrael. uminhag pashut hu hayyom sheafillu kohen am haaretz kodem likrot lifne chacham gadol yisrael. vechol mi shehu gadol mechavero bechachma kodem likrot. vehaacharon sheggolel sefer tora notel sachar keneged hakkol. lefichach ole umashlim afillu gadol shebbatztzibbur:

En sham kohen ole yisrael. velo yaale acharav levi kelal. en sham levi kohen shekkara rishon chozer vekore hu atzmo paam sheniyya bimkom levi. aval lo yikra acharav kohen acher shemma yomru harishon pasul ulefichach ole kohen acher. vechen lo yikra levi achar levi shemma yomru echad mishshenehem pasul:

Ketzad seder hakkeria battora. achar hattefilla kol yom sheyyesh bo tefillat musaf achar sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur tefillat shacharit omer kaddish umotzi sefer tora vekore leechad echad min hatztzibbur veolin vekorin battora. uchesheggomrin machazir sefer tora limkomah veomer kaddish umitpallelin tefillat musaf. veyamim sheyyesh bahen maftir umusaf nahagu lomar kaddish kodem sheyyaale hammaftir. veyesh mekomot shennahagu lomar kaddish achar hammaftir:

Ketzad seder hakkeria battora. achar hattefilla kol yom sheyyesh bo tefillat musaf achar sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur tefillat shacharit omer kaddish umotzi sefer tora vekore leechad echad min hatztzibbur veolin vekorin battora. uchesheggomrin machazir sefer tora limkomah veomer kaddish umitpallelin tefillat musaf. veyamim sheyyesh bahen maftir umusaf nahagu lomar kaddish kodem sheyyaale hammaftir. veyesh mekomot shennahagu lomar kaddish achar hammaftir:

Uvemincha shel shabbat veshel yom hakkippurim achar sheyyigmor sheliach tzibbur <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" veseder hayyom omer kaddish umotzi sefer tora veolin vekorin bo umachaziro veomer kaddish umitpallelin mincha. vechen betaanit korin bemincha veachar kach omer kaddish umitpallelin tefillat mincha. aval beyom tov lo nahagu likrot bemincha:

Veyom sheen bo musaf kesheggomer tefillat shacharit omer kaddish umotzi sefer tora vekorin bo umachaziro veomer kaddish veachar kach omer <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" veseder hayyom kederech sheomrim bechol yom veomer kaddish vechol haam niftarin:

En korin bechummashin bevatte kenesiyyot mishshum kevod tzibbur. veen gollin sefer tora betzibbur mippene torach hatztzibbur shello yatriach alehem lihyotan omdin ad sheyyiglol sefer tora. lefichach im yitztarchu likrot shene inyanim motziin shene sifre tora. velo yikra ish echad inyan echad bishte torot shemma yomru sefer rishon pagum haya ulefichach kore bashsheni:

Kol haggolel sefer tora gollu mibbachutz ucheshehu mehaddeko mehaddeko mibbifnim. vetzarich lehaamido al hattefer kede shello yikkara. makom shemmotziin sefer tora achar shekkorin bo umolichin oto levet acher lehatzenio en hatztzibbur rashshain latzet ad sheyyetze sefer tora vilauu oto vehem acharav ad hammakom shemmatzniin oto bo:

Hamminhag happashut bechol yisral shemmashlimin et hattora beshana achat. matchilin beshabbat sheachar chag hassukkot vekorin beseder <small>(Bereshit 1 1)</small> "bereshit". bashsheniyya <small>(Bereshit 6 9)</small> "elle toldot". bashshelishit <small>(Bereshit 12 1)</small> "vayyomer Adonai el avram". vekorin veholchin al hasseder hazze ad sheggomrin et hattora bechag hassukkot. veyesh mi shemmashlim et hattora beshalosh shanim veeno minhag pashut:

Ezra tikken lahem leyisrael sheyyehu korin kelalot shebbesefer vayyikra kodem atzeret veshebbemishne tora kodem rosh hashshana. vehamminhag happashut sheyyehu korin <small>(Bamidbar 1 1)</small> "bemidbar sinay" kodem atzeret. <small>(Devarim 3 23)</small> "vaetchannan" achar tisha beav. <small>(Devarim 29 9)</small> "attem nitztzavim" kodem rosh hashshana. <small>(Vayikra 6 b)</small> "tzav et aharon" kodem happesach beshana peshuta. lefichach yesh shabbatot shekkorin shacharit shene sedarin kegon <small>(Vayikra 12 b)</small> "ishsha ki tazria" v<small>(Vayikra 14 b)</small> "zot tihye torat hammetzora". <small>(Vayikra 26 3)</small> "im bechukkotay" im <small>(Vayikra 25 1)</small> "behar sinay" vechayyotze bahen kede sheyyashlimu beshana veyikreu otan hassedarim beonatan:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:1-2:
Hakosher kesher shel kayyama vehu maase umman chayyav. kegon kesher haggammalin vekesher hassappanin vekishre retzuot minal vesandal shekkoshrin haratzanin bishat asiyyatan. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval hakkosher kesher shel kayyama veeno maase umman patur. vekesher sheeno shel kayyama veeno maase umman muttar lekashro lechattechilla: 
Ketzad. nifseka lo retzua ukesharah, nifsak hachevel ukesharo, o shekkashar chevel bidli o shekkashar resen behema hare ze patur. vechen kol kayyotze beellu hakkesharim shehen maase hedyot vechol adam kosher otan lekayyama. vechol kesher sheeno shel kayyama im kesharo kesher umman hare ze asur:
Niddah 24b:10-13: Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hammappelet demut lilit, immo temea leda, valad hu ella sheyyesh lo kenafayim. tanya name hachi: amar rabbi yose, maase besimonya beachat shehippila demut lilit, uva maase lifne chachamim veamru: valad hu ella sheyyesh lo kenafayim.
Hammappelet demut nachash, hora chanina ben achiv shel rabbi yehoshua: immo temea leda. halach rabbi yosef vesipper devarim lifne rabban gamliel, shalach lo rabbi yehoshua: haneheg ben achicha vavo.

Bahalichatan, yatzta kallat (rabbi) chanina likrato, amra lo: rabbi, hammappelet kemin nachash mahu? amar lah: immo tehora. amra lo: vahalo mishshimcha amra li chamoti immo temea? veamar lah: meeze taam? hoil vegalgal eno agol keshel adam. mittoch devareha nizkar rabbi yehoshua, shalach lo lerabban gamliel: mippi hora chanina.
Amar abbaye: shema minna, tzureba merabbanan deamar milleta — lema ba tama, dechi madkeru leh — middechar.
Pesachim 117b:20-118b:9: Gemara amar leh rav chanan lerava: shema minna birkat hammazon teuna kos. amar leh: arba kase tikkenu rabbanan derech cherut, kol chad vechad naaved beh mitzva.
Revii gomer alav et hahallel veomer alav birkat hashshir.

May "birkat hashshir"? rav yehuda amar: "yehallucha Adonai elohenu". verabbi yochanan amar: "nishmat kol chay". tanu rabbanan: revii gomer alav et hahallel, veomer hallel haggadol, divre rabbi tarfon. veyesh omrim: "Adonai roi lo echsar".

Mehechan hallel haggadol? rabbi yehuda omer: mehodu" ad "naharot bavel". verabbi yochanan omer: mishshir hammaalot" ad "naharot bavel". rav acha bar yaakov amar: mikki yaakov bachar lo yah" ad "naharot bavel".
Velamma nikra shemo hallel haggadol? amar rabbi yochanan: mippene shehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev berumo shel olam umechallek mezonot lechol beriyya.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hane esrim veshishsha "hodu", keneged mi — keneged esrim veshishsha dorot shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beolamo velo natan lahem tora, vezan otam bechasdo.
Amar rav chisda: may dichtiv "hodu laAdonai ki tov"? hodu laAdonai sheggove chovato shel adam betovato: ashir beshoro, veet ani beseo, yatom bevetzato, almana betarnegoltah.
Amar rabbi yochanan: kashin mezonotav shel adam kiflayim kayyoleda, deillu beyoleda ketiv: "beetzev", uvimzonot ketiv "beitztzavon".
Veamar rabbi yochanan: kashin mezonotav shel adam yoter min haggeulla, deillu bigulla ketiv: "hammalach haggoel oti mikkol ra", malach bealma, veillu bimzonot ketiv: "haelohim haroe oti".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu laadam "vekotz vedardar tatzmiach lach" zalgu enav demaot, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, ani vachamori nochal beevus echad? kevan sheamar lo: "bezeat appecha tochal lechem", nitkarra dato.
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: ashrenu im amadnu barishona, vaadayin la paltinan minna, deka achlinan isve dedavra.
Amar rav shezvi mishshemeh derabbi elazar ben azarya: kashin mezonotav shel adam kikriat yam sof, dichtiv: "noten lechem lechol basar", usemich leh: "legozer yam sof ligzarim".
Amar rabbi elazar ben azarya: kashin nekavav shel adam keyom hammita vechikriat yam sof, shenneemar: "mihar tzoe lehippateach", uchetiv batreh: "roga hayyam vayyehemu gallav".
Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: kol hamevazze et hammoadot keillu oved avoda zara, shenneemar: "elohe massecha lo taase lach", uchetiv batreh: "et chag hammatztzot tishmor".

Veamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: kol hamesapper lashon hara, vechol hamekabbel lashon hara, vechol hammeid edut sheker bachavero — rauy lehashelicho lichlavim, shenneemar: "lakkelev tashlichun oto", uchetiv batreh: "lo tissa shema shav", ukeri beh: "lo tassi".

Vechi meachar deikka hallel haggadol, anan may tama amrinan hay? mishshum sheyyesh bo chamishsha devarim hallalu: yetziat mitzrayim, keriat yam sof, umattan tora, utechiyyayt hammetim, vechevlo shel mashiach.

Yetziat mitzrayim, dichtiv: "betzet yisrael mimmitzrayim". ukeriat yam sof, dichtiv: "hayyam raa vayyanos". mattan tora, dichtiv: "heharim rakdu cheelim". techiyyayt hammetim, dichtiv: "ethallech lifne Adonai".

Chevlo shel mashiach, dichtiv: "lo lanu Adonai lo lanu", veamar rabbi yochanan: "lo lanu Adonai lo lanu" — zo shibud malchiyyot. ikka deamri, amar rabbi yochanan: "lo lanu Adonai lo lanu" — zo milchemet gog umagog.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: mippene sheyyesh bo millut nefashot shel tzaddikim miggehinnam, shenneemar: "anna Adonai malleta nafshi". chizkiyya amar: mippene sheyyesh bo yeridatan shel tzaddikim lechivshan haesh, vaaliyyaytan mimmennu.
Yeridatan, dichtiv: "lo lanu Adonai lo lanu" amar chananya, "ki leshimcha ten kavod" amar mishael, "al chasdecha veal amittecha" amar azarya, "lamma yomru haggoyim" amru kullan.

Aliyyaytan mikkivshan haesh, dichtiv: "halelu et Adonai kol goyim" amar chananya, "shabbechuhu kol haummim" amar mishael, "ki gavar alenu chasdo" amar azarya, "veemet Adonai leolam haleluyah" amru kullan.

Veyesh omrim: "veemet Adonai leolam" gavriel amaro. beshaa shehippil nimrod harasha et avraham avinu letoch kivshan haesh amar gavriel lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, ered vaatzannen veatztzil et hatztzaddik mikkivshan haesh. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: ani yachid beolami vehu yachid beolamo, nae layyachid lehatztzil et hayyachid. ulefi shehakkadosh baruch hu eno mekappeach sechar kol beriyya, amar: tizke vetatztzil shelosha mibbene vanav.

Darash rabbi shimon hashshiloni: beshaa shehippil nevuchadnetztzar harasha chananya mishael vaazarya letoch kivshan haesh, amad yorekmo sar habbarad lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, ered vaatzannen et hakkivshan veatztzil latztzaddikim hallalu mikkivshan haesh. amar lo gavriel: en gevurato shel hakkadosh baruch hu bechach sheatta sar barad, vehakkol yodin shehammayim mechabbin et haesh. ella, ani sar shel esh ered vaakarer mibbifnim,
Veakdiach mibbachutz, veeese nes betoch nes. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: red! beotah shaa patach gavriel veamar: "veemet Adonai leolam".

Rabbi natan omer: "veemet Adonai leolam" — dagim shebbayyam amaruhu, kidrav huna. deamar rav huna: yisrael shebbeoto haddor mikketanne amana hayu, vechiddaresh rabba bar mari: may dichtiv "vayyamru al yam beyam suf" — melammed shehimru yisrael beotah shaa veamru: keshem sheanu olin mitztzad echad, kach mitzriyyim olim mitztzad acher.

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lesar shel yam: pelot otan layyabbasha! amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kelum yesh eved shennoten lo rabbo mattana vechozer venotel mimmennu? amar lo: etten lach echad umechetza shebbahen.

Amar lo: ribbono shel olam, yesh eved shettovea et rabbo? amar lo: nachal kishon yehe li arev. miyyad palat otan layyabbasha uvau yisrael verau otan. shenneemar: "vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met al sefat hayyam".
May echad umechetza shebbahen? deillu befaro ketiv: "shesh meot rechev bachur", veillu besisra ketiv: "tesha meot rechev barzel".

Ki ata sisra [ata alayyhu bedikre defarzela, hotzi hakkadosh baruch hu alehem kochavim mimmesillotam, dichtiv:] "min shamayim nilchamu hakkochavim". kevan dinchitu kochve shamayim alayyhu, akdiru hane dikre defarzela. nechitu leakrore lemische nafshayyhu benachal kishon,

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lenachal kishon: lech vehashelem ervoncha. miyyad gerafam nachal kishon vehishlichan layyam, shenneemar: "nachal kishon gerafam nachal kedumim", may "nachal kedumim"? nachal shennaasa arev mikkedem. beotah shaa patchu dagim shel yam veamru: "veemet Adonai leolam".
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, may dichtiv: "moshivi akeret habbayit" — amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, samuni banecha kechuleda zo haddara beikkare vattim.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "ahavti ki yishma Adonai" — amra keneset yisrael: ribbono shel olam emat ani ahuva lefanecha — bizman shettishma kol tachanunay. "dalloti veli yehoshia" — amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, af al pi sheddalla ani bemitzvot, lecha ani veli nae lehoshia.
Pirkei Avot 3:10-13: Hu haya omer, kol sheruach habberiyyot nocha hemennu, ruach hammakom nocha hemennu. vechol sheen ruach habberiyyot nocha hemennu, en ruach hammakom nocha hemennu. rabbi dosa ven harekinas omer, shena shel shacharit, veyayin shel tzohorayim, vesichat hayeladim, vishivat batte chenesiyyot shel amme haaretz, motziin et haadam min haolam:

Rabbi elazar hammodai omer, hamechallel et hakkadashim, vehamevazze et hammoadot, vehammalbin pene chavero varabbim, vehammefer berito shel avraham avinu alav hashshalom, vehamegalle fanim battora shello chahalacha, af al pi sheyyesh beyado tora umaasim tovim, en lo chelek laolam habba:
Rabbi yishmael omer, heve kal lerosh, venoach letishchoret, veheve mekabbel et kol haadam besimcha:
Rabbi akiva omer, sechok vekallut rosh, margilin leerva. masoret, seyag lattora. maasrot, seyag laosher. nedarim, seyag lapperishut. seyag lachachma, shetika:
Pirkei Avot 3:14-17: Hu haya omer, chaviv adam shennivra vetzelem. chibba yetera nodaat lo shennivra vetzelem, shenneemar (Bereshit 9) ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. chavivin yisrael shennikreu vanim lammakom. chibba yetera nodaat lahem shennikreu vanim lammakom, shenneemar (Devarim 14) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. chavivin yisrael shennittan lahem keli chemda. chibba yetera nodaat lahem shennittan lahem keli chemda shebbo nivra haolam, shenneemar (Mishlei 4) ki lekach tov natatti lachem, torati al taazovu:
Hakkol tzafuy, veharshut netuna, uvetov haolam niddon. vehakkol lefi rov hammaase:

Hu haya omer, hakkol natun beeravon, umetzuda ferusa al kol hachayyim. hachanut petucha, vehachenvani mekif, vehappinkas patuach, vehayyad kotevet, vechol harotze lilvot yavo veyilve, vehaggabbaim machazirim tadir bechol yom, venifrain min haadam middato veshello middato, veyesh lahem al ma sheyyismochu, vehaddin din emet, vehakkol metukkan lasseuda:

Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, im en tora, en derech eretz. im en derech eretz, en tora. im en chachma, en yira. im en yira, en chachma. im en bina, en daat. im en daat, en bina. im en kemach, en tora. im en tora, en kemach. hu haya omer, kol shechachmato merubba mimmaasav, lema hu dome, leilan sheanafav merubbin vesharashav muatin, veharuach baa veokarto vehofachto al panav, shenneemar (yirmeya 17) vehaya kearar baarava velo yire ki yavo tov veshachan charerim bammidbar eretz melecha velo teshev. aval kol shemmaasav merubbin mechachmato, lema hu dome, leilan sheanafav muatin vesharashav merubbin, sheafillu chol haruchot shebbaolam baot venoshvot bo en mezizin oto mimmekomo, shenneemar (sham) vehaya keetz shatul al mayim veal yuval yeshallach sharashav velo yire ki yavo chom, vehaya alehu raanan, uvishnat batztzoret lo yidag, velo yamish measot peri:
Pirkei Avot 3:18-4:4:
Rabbi eliezer ben chisma omer, kinnin ufitche nidda, hen hen gufe halachot. tekufot vegimatriot, parperaot lachachma:  
Ben zoma omer, ezehu chacham, hallomed mikkol adam, shenneemar (tehillim kayit) mikkol melammeday hiskalti ki edvotecha sicha li. ezehu gibbor, hakkovesh et yitzro, shenneemar (Mishlei 16) tov erech appayim miggibbor umoshel berucho milloched ir. ezehu ashir, hassameach bechelko, shenneemar (tehillim 128) yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach. ashrecha, baolam hazze. vetov lach, laolam habba. ezehu mechubbad, hamechabbed et habberiyyot, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 b) ki mechabbeday achabbed uvozay yekallu: 
Ben azzay omer, heve ratz lemitzva kalla chevachamura, uvoreach min haavera. shemmitzva goreret mitzva, vaavera goreret avera. shessechar mitzva, mitzva. usechar avera, avera: 
Hu haya omer, al tehi vaz lechol adam, veal tehi maflig lechol davar, sheen lecha adam sheen lo shaa veen lecha davar sheen lo makom: 
Rabbi levitas ish yavne omer, meod meod heve shefal ruach, shettikvat enosh rimma. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, kol hamechallel shem shamayim basseter, nifrain mimmennu vegaluy. echad shogeg veechad mezid bechillul hashshem:
Pirkei Avot 3:6-9: Rabbi chalafta ven dosa ish kefar chananya omer, asara sheyyoshvin veoskin battora, shechina sheruya venehem, shenneemar (tehillim 82) elohim nitztzav baadat el. uminnayin afillu chamishsha, shenneemar (Amos 9) vaaguddato al eretz yesadah. uminnayin afillu shelosha, shenneemar (tehillim 82) bekerev elohim yishpot. uminnayin afillu shenayim, shenneemar (Malachi 3) az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma vegomer. uminnayin afillu echad, shenneemar (Shemot 20) bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi avo elecha uverachticha:

Rabbi elazar ish bartota omer, ten lo mishshello, sheatta veshellecha shello. vechen bedavid hu omer (divre hayamim 1 29) ki mimmecha hakkol umiyyadcha natannu lach. rabbi shimon omer, hamehallech badderech veshone, umafsik mimmishnato veomer, ma nae ilan ze uma nae nir ze, maale alav hakkatuv keillu mitchayyev benafsho:

Rabbi dostay berabbi yannay mishshum rabbi meir omer, kol hashshocheach davar echad mimmishnato, maale alav hakkatuv keillu mitchayyev benafsho, shenneemar (Devarim 4) rak hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha meod pen tishkach et haddevarim asher rau enecha. yachol afillu takfa alav mishnato, talmud lomar (sham) ufen yasuru millevavcha kol yeme chayyecha, ha eno mitchayyev benafsho ad sheyyeshev visirem millibbo:

Rabbi chanina ven dosa omer, kol sheyyirat cheto kodemet lechachmato, chachmato mitkayyemet. vechol shechachmato kodemet leyirat cheto, en chachmato mitkayyemet. hu haya omer, kol shemmaasav merubbin mechachmato, chachmato mitkayyemet. vechol shechachmato merubba mimmaasav, en chachmato mitkayyemet:
Pirkei Avot 4:5-8:
Rabbi yishmael beno omer, hallomed tora al menat lelammed, maspikin beyado lilmod ulelammed. vehallomed al menat laasot, maspikin beyado lilmod ulelammed lishmor velaasot. rabbi tzadok omer, al taasem atara lehitgaddel bahem, velo kardom lachpor bahem. vechach haya hillel omer, udeishtammesh betaga, chalaf. ha lamadta, kol hannehene middivre tora, notel chayyav min haolam: 
Rabbi yose omer, kol hamechabbed et hattora, gufo mechubbad al habberiyyot. vechol hamechallel et hattora, gufo mechullal al habberiyyot: 
Rabbi yishmael beno omer, hachosech atzmo min haddin, porek mimmennu eva vegazel ushevuat shav. vehaggas libbo vahoraa, shote rasha vegas ruach: 
Hu haya omer, al tehi dan yechidi, sheen dan yechidi ella echad. veal tomar kabbelu dati, shehen rashshain velo atta:
Pirkei Avot 4:9-12:
Rabbi yonatan omer, kol hamekayyem et hattora meoni, sofo lekayyemah meosher. vechol hamevattel et hattora meosher, sofo levattelah meoni: 
Rabbi meir omer, heve memaet beesek, vaasok battora. veheve shefal ruach bifne chol adam. veim batalta min hattora, yesh lecha vetelim harebe chenegdach. veim amalta vattora, yesh lo sachar harebe litten lach: 
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, haose mitzva achat, kone lo feraklit echad. vehaover avera achat, kone lo kattegor echad. teshuva umaasim tovim, kitris bifne happuranut. rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer, kol kenesiyya shehi leshem shamayim, sofah lehitkayyem. vesheenah leshem shamayim, en sofah lehitkayyem: 
Rabbi elazar ben shammua omer, yehi chevod talmidcha chaviv alecha keshellecha, uchevod chavercha kemora rabbecha, umora rabbecha kemora shamayim:

Sotah 17a:6-24: Gemara bemay ka mippalgi? behay kera kamippalgi: "vechatav et haalot haelle hakkohen bassefer".
Rabbi meir savar: "alot" — alot mammash. "haalot" — lerabbot kelalot habbaot mechamat berachot. "elle" — lemaote kelalot shebbemishne tora. "haelle" — lemaote tzauoot vekabbalot amen.
Verabbi yose: kullehu kidkaamrat, "et" — lerabbot tzauoot vekabbalot.

Verabbi yehuda — kullehu bemiute daresh lehu. "alot" — alot mammash. "haalot" — lemaote kelalot habbaot mechamat berachot. "elle" — lemaote kelalot shebbemishne tora. "haelle" — lemaote tzauoot vekabbalot.
Verabbi meir, may shena hay he dimrabbe beh, umay shena hay he demaet beh?
He degabbe(5 4)ribbuya — ribbuya (hi), he degabbe(5 4)miuta — miuta.
Veha let leh lerabbi meir mikkelal lav atta shomea hen?
Daresh rabbi akiva: ish veishsha zachu — shechina benehen. lo zachu — esh ochaltan.
Amar rava: udeishsha adifa middeish, may tama — hay metzaref, vehay la metzaref.
Amar rava: mippene ma amra tora have afar lesota? zachta — yotze mimmenna ben keavraham avinu, dichtiv beh "afar vaefer", lo zachta — tachzor laafarah.
Deresh rava: bischar sheamar avraham avinu "veanochi afar vaefer", zachu banav lishte mitzvot, efer para vaafar sota.
Hatam hechsher mitzva ikka, hanaa lekka.
Daresh rava: bischar sheamar avraham avinu "im michut vead seroch naal", zachu banav lishte mitzvot: chut shel techelet uretzua shel tefillin.
Bishlama retzua shel tefillin, dichtiv: "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha", vetanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: ellu tefillin shebbarosh.
Ella chut shel techelet, may hi? detanya, haya rabbi meir omer: ma nishtanna techelet mikkol mine tzivonin?

Mippene shehattechelet dome layyam, veyam dome larakia, verakia dome lechisse hakkavod — shenneemar: "vayyiru et elohe yisrael vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar", uchetiv: "kemare even sappir demut kisse".
Zohar Chadash, Midrash HaNe'elam Al Eich: Achati beratti immi, lean azlat, lean panit lemehach. anan deshamin bechol yoma kirkura da deribbonana, lan yaot lemivke, lan yaot lemisped, lan yaot lemiftach echa. echa yashva vadad vegomer.

Rabbi levitas chozaa patach, (Bereshit 3:15) veeva ashit bencha uven haishsha uven zaracha. devavo sagge hava min yoma deitbere alma, al ila deeta denachash, mehahi shaata deitlatyay, itdachyay mikkamme tara demalka, vehu kamin tadir ben gedarin dealma, ben inun gedarin deorayyta, kol inun dedashin beakev, beinun gedarin, nashech lon.

Vavy deashkach, vavy denashech. vavy al devavu bisha deitneter. al devavu bisha dahavavt leh behay ishsha, deitkarya ishsha yirat Adonai. devavu vish natar lah min yoma deitbere alma, ad detavar lah bitviru, lemishkav leafra.

(Eicha 1:1) "echa "yashva "vadad "hair "rabbati "am "hayta, istakkal beatvavn deresh kol teva veteva, vetishkach netiru devavu visha, deitnatra, ad deitcharav be makdesha. eva raa bereshe atvavn, itneter lah lehahi eshet chayil, bitviru deve makdesha, lemishkav leafra.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Eicha 1:1) "kealmana "rabbati "baggoyim "sarati "bamdinot "hayta "lamas, tikra lemafrea bereshe atvavn, la beshivrech. bitviru deve makdesha, bitviru dichnishta deyisrael, devavu visha adbek la beshivrech.

Echa deitdabbekat lehahi eva raa da, kal denachash, kal meriru divchiya barkiin. illen karan echa, umissitra ochora karan eva. hada hu dichtiv, veeva ashit bencha uven haishsha, ben sitra da, uven sitra da, ishtakkach bechurban be makdesha. uvikra kadmaa itreshim kolla leminda dehay 25, adbek lah eva raa, denater lah miyyoma deitbere alma.

Echa yashva vadad, rabbi harkinas patach, (Bereshit 3:24) vaygaresh et haadam vayyashken mikkedem laggan eden. vaygaresh et, da keneset yisrael. bechurban be makdesha, deittarchat beteruchin, deishtelachat beshilluchin, karseyay demalka naflat.

Vaygaresh et, da karseyay demalka. vavy deitterachat, vavy denaflat. haadam, hahu deshallet al kuresyay, dichtiv beh (yechezkel 1:26) veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam kulei. naflat karseyay, nafal kolla.

Vayyashchen, hahu detarech leda, ashken veashre yishuva ochora, behippucha. beshaata deitcherev be makdesha, salek lechavod illaa leela, veazir deyokneh mikkema dahavavt. vechuresyay natel minneh veitperash.

Chivyachol ashre legan eden im keruvim letatta, veitperash mehahu kavod illaa. veashre lehahi lahat hacherev, lemekam beducheta derabbanuteh, lemitar ulemishav ulemastir, hahu orach deingid meetz hachayyim.

Ushelomo malka tzavavch veamar, (Mishlei 30:21) tachat shalosh ragza eretz kulei tachat eved ki yimloch kulei veshifcha ki tirash gevirtah. shifcha lego, gevirtah levar. echa yashva vadad, may vadad. kema deat amer, badad yeshev michutz lammachane moshavo.

Shalchu leho bene ara kaddisha, yaot deattun itbaddartun bene ammaya, veattun levar meara kaddisha, veyaot lecho lemivke alayychu veal garmayychu, dinfaktun minhora lachashocha, keavda denafek mibbe mareh. aval anan it lan lemivke ulemebad hespeda, velan shaddar kudesha berich hu sifra dehespeda, daanan benaha dematronita, vaanan mibbene vetah, veyadin yekara demare alma. velan yaot lemivke, ulefarsha inun alfa betin.

Vaanan yatmin bela abba veimma, umistakkelin ayynin lechotle veta deimmana, veha itcharav, vela ashkachna lah. dahavat yanka lan bechol yoma, beyomin kaddemain, mishappiru dilah. vahavet nechimat lan, umemallelet al libbana, keimma livrah. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 66:13) keish asher immo tenachamennu vegomer.

Vehasheta istakkelan ayynin lechol setar, vaatar bet motava deimmana itbalbel, veha itcharav. nevatash resha lechotle veta umotavah. man yenachem lan, uman yemallel al libbana, veyagen alana kamme malka.

Chad havenan chatan kamme avuna, vesalek retzua lealkaa lan, ihi kayymat lekamman, umekabbelet malkiyyuta demalka, begin laagana alana. kema deat amer (sham 53) vehu mecholal mippeshaenu medukka meavonotenu kulei uvachavurato nirpa lanu. vehasheta imma let lan, vavy. vavy lan, vavy lecho. lan yaot lemivke, lan yaot lemisped, lan yaot lefatra inun millin dimriru, leodaa leho, leinun deyadin lemivke millin dehespeda.

Nikrav bechol yoma legabbe arsa deimmana, vela nishkach lah tamman. nishal alah, let man deyashgach alan. nishal learsa dilah, itbalbela. nishal lechuresyay, naflat. nishal lehechalin dilah, omaan inun dela yadin minah. nishal leafra, reshimu deikveta let tamman.

Nishal leigra, ha igra atev lan, detamman yatva mevakka umeyayllelet alan veazlat mevakka, tzoochat bekol meriru alan, meigra leigra. kema deat amer, (sham 22) ma lach efo ki alit kullach laggaggot. nishal leorchin ushevilin, kullehu amrin dishmau kal meriru divchiyya, dimvakka al benaha, vela yadin lean istallakat.

Lan yaot lemivke, lan yaot lemisped. nenashshek afra deraglaha, nenashshek atar be motavah, nenashshek kotle hechala, venivke bimriru. anan niftach behespeda, dechamenan bechol yoma kol hay. nivke tadir vela itneshe meriru divchiyya minan.

Echa yashva vadad, Rabbi chaninay verabbanan patche kera beadam harishon. (Bereshit 2:15) vayyikkach Adonai elohim et haadam vayyannichehu vegan eden vegomer. vayyikkach, bamme lekacho. Rabbi chaninay amar, lekacho bidvarim. kema deat amer (Vayikra 8:2) kach et aharon. verabbanan amru, lekacho beruach. kema deat amer, (Melachim b 2:3) hayyom Adonai lokeach et adonecha meal roshecha.

Vayyannichehu vegan eden, kede lihyot lo menucha, ladaat ulehakkir hachachma vehattora. deamar ribbi chaninay, hattora limdah hakkadosh baruch hu laadam. hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov 28:27) az raah vaysapperah vegomer, vayyomer laadam. vehayu malache hashsharet mekalsin lefanav.
Ad sheraa somoamar leh bashshamayim, venitkanne bo, veyarad min hashshamayim kidmut tzel al nachash. hannachash nira, vehatztzel alav, takfa vechela dileh.

Karev hahu nachash legabbe itteta, dedata kalla min haish. mikkan deitteta la itpattat, ella beitteta ochora. (Bereshit 3:1) vayyomer el haishsha af ki amar elohim, miyyad patach beaf. mehacha, devitchillat devarav shel adam nikkar mi hu. kach hu patach beaf, lehodia mi hu.

Natal siman ze, im tekabbel, im lo tekabbel. vehimshichah bidvarim, ad sheppatcha beot mem, veamra mikkol etz haggan achol nochel. miyyad natal hannachash haot, vayyasem otah al zeroo hassemalit, vehaya mamtin al vav 416 mippiha, kede lihyot 446 nachon lifnehem.

Hitchil lefattotah, ad dichtiv, (sham) vattere haishsha, betama sagge vetakkif. melammed, shepparchu haotiyyot vav 416, vesalku lehitchabber im ot mem. veot mem hayta ola veyoredet, velo hayta mitchabberet immahem, ad shenitpattet.

Ufarchu vav 416, 4 zimnin, vaakifu leot mem led sitrin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:6) vattikkach mippiryo vattochal vattitten gam leishah vattippakachna ene shenehem. ha 4 zimnin 6 400. melammed, shessivvo laot mem learba tzedadin, vehamm baemtza, mavet bechol sitrin.

Chomoddavar acher, (Yirmeyahu 9:20) ki ala mavet bachalonenu. da samael, deihu chad mechallone shemaya. veal da mi gever yichye velo yire mavet. miyyad shalat bah, vehitil bah zuhama. nachat kudesha berich hu lemecheme, vayyitchabbe haadam veishto.

Ta chaze, kodem shechatu, hayta hashshechina atara al rashehem, lihyot bishvilam shora al haolam. kevan shechatu, kivyachol, tash kochah, veistallekat velo shallitat. vekudesha berich hu share lekonen, veamar echa, ma tehe minah, shaltanuta aadu minah. uf hacha bechureban be makdesha, shuletanuta aadu, vekudesha berich hu share lemisped, veamar echa, ma tehe aleha.

Patchu inhu veamre, (Eicha 1:1) echa yashva vadad hair, ketiv (Yeshayahu 22:5) ki yom mehuma umevusa umevucha vegomer. ki yom. chad yoma it lekudesha berich hu, rechima denafsheh, kelila mikkol shear yomin, shit yomin kelilan beh, vehu kelala dechullehu. veal deasgiu chovin, istallak leela, leve alma dechayyin.

Cheden mittechot shippule mashkena, kam yoma dimriru, yoma divchiya, yoma detzaara, yoma deikre mehuma umevusa umevucha, veal bego mashkena, veshetze vesaev. veribbona demashkena, azal vaarak veittarach miggo motaveh lego tura dilvar, ulego tura decharuv, umashkena itcharav.

Levatar, nachat hahu yoma illaa, deistallak, sheal al mishkaneh, veha itcharav. al veashgach al mare demashkena, matrunita rechimta denafsheh, vehi itterachat vearkat, vechol binyaynah satir. keden share lemige, goa batar goa, kinhimu detarnegola al nukeveh. hada hu dichtiv, (sham) mekarkar kir, nehimu ketarnegola. kir, ribbon shallita.

Veshoa el hahar, avid shoa vetzavavch legabbe tura, dearkat tamman matrunita. avid shoa tzavavch vekare binhimu divchiyya echa. echa rechimta denafshay, echa shafninati shelemati, echa yechidata dili, deityachada immi beyichuda. echa dahavit natla bechol yoma, chamesh veesrim atvavn deyichuda, veitkeriat ko al da.
Achati beratti immi, lean azlat, lean panit lemehach. anan deshamin bechol yoma kirkura da deribbonana, lan yaot lemivke, lan yaot lemisped, lan yaot lemiftach echa. echa yashva vadad vegomer.
Zohar, Vayakhel 14: Hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka veitchazit, veitkashshitat. (sefer acher hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka leitattera baavahan) keden kol chedva ishtechach leella vetatta, vealmin kullehu bechedva. uvehay lelya, hay nekuda itpashat nehoraa, ufaris gadpoy al alma, vechol shiltonin acharanin mitabberan, unetiru ishtechach al alma.

Ucheden ittosaf ruach nishmeta beyisrael, al kol chad vechad, uvehahi nishmeta yetera, nashyayn kol itzba vechemata, vela ishtechach bar chedva, leella vetatta. hahu rucha denachit veittosaf bivne alma, kad nachit, itsache bevusemin deginta deeden, venachit veshara al amma kaddisha, zakkain innun, kad hay rucha itar.

Behahi shaata dehahu rucha nachit nachtin immah lego ginta deeden, shittin retichin, mitatterin leshit sitrin. vechad mate leginta deeden, keden kol innun ruchin venishmatin deginta deeden, kullehu (mitare lehahu mitattere (nusach acher behahu)) rucha. keruze kare veamar, zakkain attun yisrael, amma kaddisha, diruta demarichon ittear legabbayychu.

Raza derazin leyade chachmeta, zakkain innun kad hay rucha itar. hay rucha ihu itpashshetuta dehay nekuda, venafka minnah, veitpashsheta bealma, vehahu have raza deshabbat, deshara letatta, veal da ketiv beh shemira, (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, shabbat la ketiv, ella et hashshabbat, leasgaa hahu rucha deshare al kolla, veitzterich lenatra leh, hoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 56:6) kol shomer shabbat mechallelo.

Behay raza it raza achara. hay rucha, ithani behay yoma, mehanaotan deyisrael, umeinnuga dilhon, uvegin da, bae lemehav leh innuga, bemechla uvemishteya, telat zimnin, bitlat seudatin, ditlat darge mehemnuta, kema deukemuha. vehay natil chedva veinnuga, beinnun seudate deyisrael. zakkaa chulakeh, man deahane leh, umeaneg leh, behay yoma.

Hay rucha, ithane kol shita yomin, merucha illaa deattika dechol attikin. uveyoma deshabbeta, kevan denachit, veitsache beginta deeden belelya, itannag (Rosh Chodesh amud alef, 98 amud bet) meinnuga degufa, bisudate dimhemnuta, veitattar (nusach acher veitannag) hay rucha meella vetatta, veitrave bechol sitrin, beitra dilella vetatta.

Vehoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, itzterich leh lenatra leh. veal da ketiv veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat. shabbat, da hu hahi nekuda tattaa. et hashshabbat, da hu hay rucha, itpashshetuta dehahi nekuda. hahu itpashshetuta, kad ittosaf kiddushan uvirkan milleella, al hahi nekuda, itnehir kolla, veitavid rucha nehira bechol sitrin, itpelag leella venahir. veitpelag letatta venahir. veda hu dichtiv beni uven beni yisrael chulak achasana it lan kachada.

Chulaka dilella, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga illaa kaddisha, veithane mizziva illaa deattika dechol attikin. chulaka tattaa, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga diltatta, deithane behane seudate. veal da, bae leannega leh, bemechla uvemishteya bilvushe yekar, uvechedva decholla.

Vechad mitattera hay chulaka letatta, veitnetir kema deitzterich, salleka leella, veitchabbera behahu chulaka achara. vehay nekuda natil kolla meella vetatta, veitkelila mikkol sitrin. uvegin demitattera beshabbat, meella umittatta, kol shear yomin yahiv chela lecholla, veityeyhiv leh shuletanu meella umittatta. uverazin desifra dishlomo malka, ishtechach raza da, veukemuha butzina kaddisha, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael.

Ketiv vayyinnafash, veukemuha vavy nefesh deavdat veshappir ihu. aval i hachi vavy gufa itzterich lememar, deminneh avdat nefesh. aval raza demilla, bevar nash it nefesh, denatla umashich legabbeh lehay rucha meerev shabbat. vehahu rucha sharya begavvav dehahi nefesh, vedayyra bah kol yoma deshabbeta. ucheden, hahu nefesh, yetera beribbuya vetoalta yattir mimma dehava.

Veal da taninan, kol nafshan deyisrael mitatteran beyoma deshabbeta, veitra dilhon, desharya hay rucha begavvavyyhu. kevan denafak shabbeta, vehahu rucha salleka leella, keden vavy lenefesh, deavdat ma deavdat. avdat hahu itra illaa, vehahu chela kaddisha dehava ba, veda hu vayyinnafash, vavy nefesh, deavdat ma deavdat.

Onatan dechakkimin, deyade razin illain, milelya deshabbeta lelelya deshabbeta, veokmuha. aval milla da shailna levutzina kaddisha, deha chazenan dehay kitra tattaa, nakta ma denakta bimama, uvelelya yahiv mezona lechol cheleh, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. nakta bimama, veyahava belelya. vehasheta amar mar deziuuga ishtechach behay lelya.

Amar, vadday ziuuga ishtechach belelya da. may tama. begin dehay lelya, afrishat nishmatin lechol innun chakkimin, deyadin razin dechachmeta. vechibbura, veziuuga, la ishtechach beyoma achara bechol chedva, bela irbuveya (sefer acher ella begin da) achara, kegon da. begin deinnun nishmatin difligat, feligat lon bechakkimin, betzaddikim, bachaside kedka yeot. (sefer acher vetu bechol) uvechol lelya velelya, ziuuga ishtechach vadday. ematay befalgut lelya. veha okimna. aval la bechol sitrin kehay ziuuga.

Uvegin da, chakkimin deyadin razin, bayayn lesaddera shimmusha dilhon, behay lelya. may taama. begin dechol yome deshabbeta, it lon rucha achara deshara al alma, uvehay lelya it lon rucha achara kaddisha illaa, denachta livni kaddishin, vehahu rucha nashiv meattika dechol attikin, venachta lego nekuda tattaa, lemehav bah nayycha lecholla, veda itpelig lechol sitrin, leella vetatta, kema deat amar beni uven bene yisrael.

Vechad innun chakkimin, yatvin behahu rucha kaddisha, rucha illaa, baan leshammesha arsayyhu, dehay rucha amshich avatreh letatta, kol innun nishmatin kaddishin, veyartin kaddishe elyonin, behay rucha, nishmatin kaddishin livnehon kedka yeot.

ohc: Vayyitten Adonai. amar beyadenu, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha beferek haroe (berachot ned:) deakar tura bar telata parse veayyte al resheh vechulei, moshe kamma hava vechulei, shavvavr umachyeh bekarsuleh vekatleh, ad kan. vehu amro vayyitten Adonai perush, al yede tekiat hahar betzavvaro. veomer beyadenu, sheharago beyado mammash, veamar leshon rabbim kemo (Bereshit 1:26) "naase adam", gam yad moshe yad kol yisrael techashev.

rashi: Al hashsheminit. kinnor shel shemona nimin, veshminit shemo. vechen matzinu (divrei hayamim 1 15:21) peloni uvanav "al hashsheminit lenatztzeach":
targum: Leshabbacha binginata al kinara ditmanya nemaya tushebachta ledavid:

rashi: Hachilloti tet lefanecha. kafa sar shel emoriyyim shel mala tachat raglav shel moshe vehidricho al tzavvaro:
ohc: Ree hachilloti vegomer. amar hachilloti leshon avar, chozer el maamar "hiksha Adonai et rucho lemaan titto beyadecha", umaamar hachilloti chozer lannetina lo lemaamar "lefanecha", umoshe hevin shechozer lechol haamur, velaze hitchannen laAdonai bechashvo shehuttar hanneder, keamram zichronam livracha (sifre resh parashat vaetchannan).

rashi: Havu lachem. hazeminu atzmechem laddavar:
Anashim. vechi taale al datecha nashim, ma talo anashim? tzaddikim, kesufim:

Chachamim unevonim. mevinim davar mittoch davar; zo hi sheshshaal ariyyos et rabbi yose ma ben chachamim linvonim? chacham dome leshulchani ashir, keshemmeviin lo dinarin lirot roe, uchesheen meviin lo yoshev vetohe, navon dome leshulchani taggar, keshemmeviin lo maot lirot roe, uchesheen meviin lo, hu mechazzer umevi mishshello (sifre):

Viduim leshivtechem. shehem nikkarim lachem, sheim ba lefanay meuttaf betallito, eni yodea mi hu umee ze shevet hu, veim hagun hu, aval attem makkirin bo, sheattem giddaltem oto, lechach neemar viduim leshivtechem (sifre):
Berashechem. rashim umechubbadim alechem – shettihyu nohagin bahem kavod veyira:
Vaashamam. chaser yod, limmed sheashmotehem shel yisrael teluyot berashe dayyanehem, shehaya lahem limchot ulechavven otam ladderech hayeshara (sifre):
ohc: Havu lachem vegomer. amar lachem lehakedim taam maamar "leshivtechem", ki ze mehannaot lachem kesheyyihye kol shevet shoftav mimmennu. veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat pinchas befasuk "yifkod Adonai elohe haruchot ish al haeda" vegomer (Bamidbar 27:16), vesham taskil ofen hannaot sheyyesh baddavar hazze, vehu amro "lachem".
Vaasimem vegomer. perush, hagam sheani omer lachem "havu lachem" sheattem hem habbocharim otam, lo yihye tachat maamarchem verishyonchem, ani asim otam lerashim alechem lirdotchem bemakkel uvirtzua.

rashi: Vattamru. leshon haterasa – hitrastem keneged maamaro:
ohc: Velo avitem vegomer. vahagam sheasara amru edut kemo sheamar besamuch "achenu hemassu" vegomer, kevar amar lahem Adonai sheen horashat hair mitztzad gevurat yisrael ella bemattana meAdonai, kemo sheddiyyaknu befarashat shelach (Bamidbar 13:2) mimmaamar "asher ani noten" ki hu yorish mippenehem yoshve haaretz, kemo sheamar gam ken besamuch "Adonai vegomer hu yillachem lachem", veen bemaamar ze setira lehachechish hafelaat tokef hair vaanasheha sheamru hammeraggelim, uvaze lo kasha kushyat ramban.

rashi: Uvefarischem kappechem alim enay mikkem. lefi sheyyedchem damim maleu:
Damim. retzicha:
targum: Vechad kahanaya parsin yedehon letzalaa alechon mesalekna appe shechinti minchon veaf kad attun masgan letzalaa la raava kodamay lekabbala tzelotchon midi yedchon dam zakkay malyan:

rashi: Metim. anashim, bevizzat sichon neemar bazaznu lanu, leshon bizza, shehayta chaviva alehem uvozzim ish lo, ucheshebbau levizzat og, kevar hayu seveim umeleim, vehayta bezuya beenehem, umekarin umashlichin behema uvegadim, velo natlu ki im kesef vezahav, lechach neemar bazzonu lanu, leshon bizzayon, kach nidrash besifre befa vayyeshev yisrael bashshittim:

Vatteshvu vekadesh yamim rabbim. 19 shana, shenneemar kayyamim asher yeshavtem bishar hammassaot, vehem hayu 38 shana, 19 mehem asu vekadesh 25 shana holchim umetorafim vechazru lekadesh, kemo shenneemar (Bamidbar 32) "vayniem bammidbar"; kach matzati beseder olam:

Vayhi bearbaim shana beashte asar chodesh beechad lachodesh. melammed shello hochichan ella samuch lammita; mimmi lamad? miyyaakov, shello hochiach et banav ella samuch lammita, amar, reuven beni ani omer lecha mippene ma lo hochachticha kol hashshanim hallalu, kede shello tannicheni vetelech vetidbak beesav achi; umippene arbaa devarim en mochichin et haadam ella samuch lammita, kede shello yehe mochicho vechozer umochicho, veshello yehe chavero roehu umitbayyesh mimmennu, kulei kidita besifre. vechen yehoshua lo hochiach et yisrael ella samuch lammita, vechen shemuel shenneemar (Shmuel 1 12), "hinni anu vi", vechen david et shelomo veno (Melachim 1 2):
Kaasher taasena haddevorim. ma haddevora hazzot keshehi makka et haadam miyyad meta, af hem keshehayu nogim bachem miyyad metim:
Kevarishona. aamid lachem shoftim kesherim:
Ir hatztzedek. kevattechilla "tzedek yalin bah" (Yeshayahu 1:21):
targum: Vaamane vich dayane kusheta taknin kivkadmeta umalche milchach kad min avla uvatar ken yitkere lach karta dekusheta karta mehemanta:

rashi: Lo taartzun. leshon shevira, ketargumo, vedome lo (Iyov 30) "baarutz nechalim lishkon"– shibbur hannechalim:

Vattikrevun elay kullechem. beirbuveya; ulehallan hu omer (Devarim Adonai) "vattikrevun elay kol rashe shivtechem veziknechem vattomru hen heranu vegomer", otah keriva hayta hogenet – yeladim mechabbedim et hazzekenim ushelachum lifnehem, uzekenim mechabbedim et harashim lalechet lifnehem, aval kan "vattikrevun elay kullechem" beirbuveya – yeladim dochafin et hazzekenim, uzekenim dochafin et harashim (sifre):
Veyashivu otanu davar. beeze lashon hem medabberim:
Et hadderech asher naale bah. en derech sheen bah akmimut:
Veet hearim asher navo alehen. techilla lichbosh (sham):
Atta vakata. leyisrael min hatztzur mayanot (Shemot 17:6):
Atta hovashta. yarden, shehu nahar etan (Yehoshua 3:15):
targum: Ant bezata maayana min kefa vahave lenachala ant yabbeshta megizat nachale arnona umegizat yuveka veyordana dehon takifin:

rashi: Eretz refaim techashev. eretz refaim nechshevet af hi, lefi sheharfaim yashvu vah lefanim, aval lo zo hi shennatatti leavraham:
ohc: Eretz refaim techashev vegomer. peresh Rashi veze leshono: aval lo zo hi shennatatti leavraham. veen ani roe hechreach lidvarav, ki hechan matzinu sheamar Adonai sheen refaim ellu bakkelal? veod, kevan shello peresh Adonai leavraham min refaim ella setam – kol refaim bemashma. veraiti shettala zayneh bema sheamar hakkatuv "hahu yikkare eretz refaim" (Devarim 3:13), meamro "hahu" heiranu sheacheret, hagam shennikret refaim, enah kefi haemet refaim. vechen gilla dato besof perek ellu terefot (chullin 60.), veen hechreach laze. vetevat "hahu" mi yomar shebba lishlol refaim acherim? dilma ba lishlol chevel argov acher sheeno nikra eretz refaim ki im hahu. vechen haddaat nota keshennomar shettevat "hahu" lediyyuk baa, achar sheamar hakkatuv al eretz ammon umoav sherfaim yashvu vah vaAdonai natan leavraham harfaim bederech kelal. veod, tevat "hahu yikkare" lo miata ella hakkeria, sheenah nikret ken hayyom "eretz refaim" ella eretz sichon veog velo eretz ammon umoav. gam shettechashev eretz zo meare harfaim sheamar Adonai leavraham, lo hayta nikret beoto zeman eretz refaim, lefi shennetanah Adonai livne lot mittaam gilgul devarim shel avraham kaamur bedivrehem (Rashi pasuk 5), umishshel avraham natnu lelot.

Uchefi ze yeduyyak al nachon lamma beeretz sichon veog amar "yikkare" uveeretz bene lot amar techashev, ki eretz sichon veog od shemah aleha lefi shehaya og bah, aval eretz bene lot enah nikret eretz refaim hagam shehi nechshevet eretz refaim uvichlal refaim sheamar Adonai leavraham hi nichlelet. vehaikkar sheani choshev baze hiv shekkol sheyyomar hakkatuv shettikkare eretz refaim hi bichlal mattenat avraham, ulefi divre barayta shel sifre (chelek 2 299) sheheveti befarashat mattot sheeretz sichon veog enah bichlal haaretz shekkarat Adonai im avraham, yeduyyak ma sheamar hakkatuv "hahu yikkare eretz refaim" al ze hadderech: hahu yikkare velo yechashev, perush, shehaolam korim oto eretz refaim aval kefi haemet enah nechshevet refaim bishvil shemma shekkorin otah bene adam eretz refaim lo tikkanes bichlal harfaim shennatan Adonai. veayyen besamuch (Devarim 3:13) ma shekkatavti befasuk "hahu yikkare eretz refaim" vesham perashti beofen acher.

rashi: Konehu. metakkeno bacharisha bayyom, umeachar shehirgilo bechach yodea bo. aval chamor atum eno mevin bealav ad sheyyaachilennu. veyisrael lo nitpakkach leda keshor, keshekkerativ "yisrael yihye shemecha" (Bereshit 35:10), vehodativ ketzat chukkotay vehem azavuni, kidmeforash (Yechezkel 20:39) veomer "ish et gillule vegomer". veaf leachar shehotzetim mimmitzrayim veheechaltim et hamman vekarati otam "ammi bene yisrael", lo hitbonnu kachamor (62). davar acher: yada shor konehu. makkir hashshor konehu lihyot morao alav, lo shinna ma sheggazarti alav lomar eni choresh hayyom, vachamor lo amar livalav eni toen hayyom. uma ellu shennivreu leshammeshchem, veenam lo lekibbul sachar im yizku velo leshillum puranut im chotim, lo shinnu et middatam sheggazarti alehem, veyisrael sheim zochim mekabbelim sachar veim chotim mekabbelim puranut:
Lo yada. lo avu leda, veyadu vedashu beakev, veammi lo natan lev lehitbonen:
targum: Yeda tora zabbeneh vachamara orya dimrohi yisrael la alif lemida dechalti ama la istakkel lemetav leorayti:

rashi: Shuva Adonai. mecharoncha:
Challetza nafshi. mecholyi:
targum: Tuv Adonai petze nafshi perak li biglal tuvach:

rashi: Atta over hayyom et gevul moav, vekaravta mul bene ammon. mikkan sheeretz ammon letzad tzafon:

Vayhi chaasher tammu vegomer vaydabber Adonai elay vegomer. aval mishshilluach hameraggelim ad kan lo neemar befarasha zo vaydabber ella vayyomer, lelammedcha shekkol 38 shana shehayu yisrael nezufim, lo nityached immo haddibbur bilshon chibba, panim el panim veyishshuv haddaat – lelammedcha sheen hashshechina shora al hanneviim ella bishvil yisrael (mechilta Shemot 12):
Anshe hammilchama. mibben esrim shana hayyotzim batztzava:

Hoy. kol hoy shebbammikra leshon kovel vekina, keadam haggoneach millibbo vetzoek "aha", ella sheyyesh mehem muatin shehem leshon tzaakat keriat kol, kemo "hoy hoy venusu meeretz tzafon" (Zecharya 2:10), vetargumo "achlu" leshon hacheraza. hoy yesh lizok al goy kadosh hannehpach lihyot goy chote, veam shenneemar bo "ki am kadosh atta" (Devarim 7:6) nehpach lihyot am keved avon:
Am keved avon. kevedut avon. kaved adam shehu kaved, 449 belaaz. keved shem davar shel kevedut, 496 belaaz, vedavuk im tevat avon:
Zera mereim. vehem hayu "zera berach Adonai" (Yeshayahu 61:9), banim hayu lehakkadosh baruch hu nehefchu lemashchitim:
Niatzu. hirgizu:

Nazoru achor. en nezira bechol makom ella leshon perishut, vechen hu omer "veyinnazru mikkadshe vene yisrael" (Vayikra 22:2), "nezir echav" (Bereshit 49:26). af kan nazoru – nesogu laachorehem meetzel hammakom:
targum: Vay al deitkeriu am kadish vachato kenisha vechira veasgiu chovin itkeniu vezara rechima veavishu itamar lehon benin chavivin vechabbilu orchathon shevaku yat pulechana dayya katzu bedachalat kadisha deyisrael uvedil ovdehon bishaya istecharu vahavo leachora:

rashi: Vattahinu. leshon "hinnennu vealinu el hammakom" (Bamidbar 14), ze hallashon sheamartem leshon "hen", kelomar nizdammantem:
Hacharem. leshon hove – haloch vechallot:

Vehinnechem hayyom kechochve hashshamayim. vechi chechochve hashshamayim hayu beoto hayyom, vahalo lo hayu ella shishshim ribbo, mahu vehinnechem hayyom? hinnechem meshulim kayyom – kayyamim leolam kachamma vechallevana vechakkochavim (80 sifre):
ohc: Adonai elohechem vegomer. kashe, hare lo matzinu shennitrabbu mimma shehayu bemitzrayim ribbuy sheyyesh bo hekker, kammuvan mimmispar sheni shel shana hashshenit, sheal oto zeman hu omer sheamar lahem "baet hahi" vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha besifre amru veze leshonam: "hirba etchem" – higdil etchem al dayyanechem vechulei, ad kan. veulay shennitkavven od al pi ma sheamru bazzohar (chelek 3 211:) sheal yede hazekarat ribbuy tova yafil hashelatat koach bammastin lehara, veamar (sham 212.) shebbechol makom shemmazkir shem elyon alav en koach bechochot hara lishlot bo, ulefi sheamar moshe "lo uchal levaddi" vegomer hare hu maflig beribbuyim veyesh baze chashash haamur. laze hizkir shemo yitbarach alehem veamar Adonai vegomer hirba etchem shebbaze en makom lammerea kaamur sham, ulefi ze titparesh tevat "hirba" kifshatah.

Vehinnechem hayyom. dikdek lomar hayyom, lehair ki hammaamar nechlak lishne zemannim: echad hu bashshana hashshenit kesheamar lahem "lo uchal levaddi", veal oto zeman hu omer "hirba etchem", vehashsheni hu bazzeman shehu medabber immahem bishnat haarbaim, kemo sheddikdek lomar "vehinnechem hayyom" vegomer.

Uferush amro kechochve hashshamayim, nitkavven al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (sanhedrin 26.) en minyan larshaim, shehagam sheyyihye misparam rav en ribbuyam ribbuy. ha lamadta shemminyan hatztzaddikim yityaches elav haribbuy hagam sheyyihyu muatim bemispar, vehu ma shennitkavven lomar vehinnechem vegomer kechochve, perush, sheachar shehirba etchem od lachem shehinnechem hayyom kechochve vegomer, perush, vedavar ze hu gam ken geder haribbuy shebbihyotam kechochavim yimmanu leribbuy atzum.

rashi: Haemim lefanim vegomer. atta savur shezzo eretz refaim shennatatti lo leavraham, lefi shehaemim shehem refaim yashvu vah lefanim, aval lo zo hi, ki otan refaim horashti mippene vene lot vehoshavtim tachtam:
Refaim yechashvu vegomer. refaim hayu necheshavin otam emim, kaanakim hannikraim refaim, al shem shekkol haroe otam yadav mitrappot (Bereshit Rabba 26):
Emim. al shem sheematam muttelet al habberiyyot (sham), vechen beseir yashvu hachorim unetattim livne esav:
ohc: Refaim yechashvu vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan modienu hakkatuv sheharfaim yechashvu vegomer. venire ki lefi shebbaammim asher amar Adonai leavraham latet lanu (Bereshit 15:18) hizkir harfaim shehu echad measara, vehodia hakkatuv ki ar shennatan yerushsha livne lot hi harfaim asher amar Adonai leavraham, vehu amro haemim lefanim yashvu vah vegomer, uferush "lefanim" hu kodem shekkarat Adonai berit im avraham, vehakkavvana baze shettaamod lizchutenu.

rashi: Umlal. nishchat vedal koach (392 109), kemo "hayyehudim haamelalim" deezra (Nechemya 3:34):
targum: Chus alay Adonai metul dechalash ana asi yati Adonai metul deitbehilu garmay:

rashi: Neum haadon. shehakkol shello, uveyado laakor etchem meartzechem velintoa bah acherim:
Avir yisrael. takpo shel yisrael:
Hoy. leshon hazemana vehacheraza, vedome lo "hoy venusu meeretz tzafon" (Zecharya 2:), veyedu hakkol ki ennachem mitztzaray shehichisuni bemaasehem:
targum: Bechen amar ribbon alma Adonai tzevaot takifa deyisrael karta yerushelem ana atid lenachamutah beram vay lerashiaya kad itgele lemebad pureanut din mesane ami veativ nekama livel devavi:

rashi: Yirashum. lashon hove, kelomar natatti vahem koach shehayu morishim otam veholchim:
Arim gedolot uvetzurot bashshamayim. dibberu hakketuvim leshon havay (sifre; chullin 90):
Lezona. toa meal eloheha:
Kirya. shehayta neemana umelea mishpat, vetzedek haya lan bah, veatta meratztzechim:
Meleati mishpat. kegon "rabbati am" (Eicha 1:):

Tzedek yalin bah. tamid shel shachar haya mechapper al averot shel hallayla, veshel ben haarbayim mechapper al shel hayyom. davar acher: shehayu melinim bah dine nefashot, keshello hayu motzin lo zechut bayyom harishon lo hayu gomrin et dino ad lemachar, ulay yimtzeu lo zechut, veatta naasu rotzchin. umatzinu bifsikta (perek 15:7): rabbi menachem bar oshaya amar: 481 (arba meot ushemonim veachat) batte chenesiyyot hayu birushalayim keminyan meleati begimatriyya:
Veatta meratztzechim. hargu et uriyya, hargu et zecharya:
targum: Echden tavu ovdaha lemeheve chetaita karta mehemanta dahavat malya avde dina kusheta hava mitaved bah uchean inun ketole nafshan:

rashi: Mi-vikkesh zot miyyedchem remos chatzeray. lirmos et chatzeray, achare sheen levavchem shalem immi:
targum: Kad attun atan leitchazaa kodamay man teva da miyedchon lemete uleitdasha azarati:

rashi: Vannefen vannaal. kol tzad tzafon hu aliyya:
Veet haaretz hazzot. haamura lemala, minnachal arnon vead har chermon, yarashnu baet hahi:
Mearoer asher al nachal arnon. eno mechubbar lerosho shel mikra ella lesofo – al natatti larouveni velaggadi, aval leinyan yerushsha ad har chermon haya:
Vaatzavve et shoftechem. amarti lahem hevu metunin baddin – im ba din lefanecha paam achat, shetayim, veshalosh, al tomar kevar ba din ze lefanay peamim harebe, ella heyu nosim venotnim bo (sham):
Baet hahiv. mishshemminnitim amarti lahem en achshav kilsheavar, lesheavar heyitem birshut atzmechem, achshav hare attem meshubadim latztzibbur (sham):
Shamoa. leshon hove, 70 belaaz, kemo zachor, shamor:
Uven gero. ze baal dino sheoger alav devarim; davar acher uven gero, af al iske dira ben chalukkat achim, afillu ben tannur lechirayim (sham; sanhedrin 7):
ohc: Baet hahi lemor. amro lemor, kevar katavti beharebe mekomot kol sheeno omer haddevarim atzman ketzuratan yomar "lemor". kemo chen bema shellefanenu lo shetztzivva otam baet hahi belashon ze atzmo, ella mechuvvan hatztziuuy haya lemor lahem "shamoa" vegomer.

Veulay shennitkavven gam ken lirmoz ma sheamru zichronam livracha besanhedrin (yerushalmi sanhedrin 3:8:7) veze leshono: rav huna kad hava chaze zechu levar nash vela hava yada leh, hava patach leh mishshum "petach picha leillem" (Mishlei 31:9) ad kan. vehu ma sheramaz betevat lemor, ki alav lemor leval tihye haemet nederet veyishpot tzedek.

Od yitbaer al derech ma sheamru besanhedrin (sanhedrin 7:) ufasko rambam beferek 21 mehilchot sanhedrin, veze leshono: tzarich haddayyan lishmoa hatteanot mibbaale dinin velishnot taanotehem, shenneemar (Melachim 1 3:23) "vayyomer hammelech zot omeret" vegomer. vehu ma shennitkavven bemaamar lemor shamoa, perush shetztzarich hashshofet lomar befiv ma sheshshama mibbaale dinim.

Shamoa ben achechem vegomer. kashe ma tzarich letzauot laze, im lo yishmeu al ma yadunu? od lamma amar bederech ze velo amar "shimu"? achen hakkavvana hi sheyyihyu matmidin lishmoa velo yakutzu, vedavar ze yitchallek lishne devarim: echad hu mibbaale dinim atzman, sheim yomru "od yesh lanu liton, od yesh lanu lehochiach" – lo yakutzu middivrehem, uma gam kesheyyarbu lehavi reayot achar reayot velo hoilu, lo yomar haddayyan "shuv en reaya veen taana", ella shamoa bitmidut. vehashsheni sheim hitrichu alehem baale dinin, lo yomru "harebe torach tarachnu hayyom veen lishmoa od toen venitan ad achar zeman", ella shamoa been hefsek, vechan nitztauu al dikduk innuy haddin.

Od yirtze lehazehiram lehitchakkem mittoch haddevarim hanneemarim ben hattoanim lehakkir amittut hainyan, vahagam sheal pi hatteanot yizke hazzakkay veyitchayyev hachayyav, im nikkarim mittoch seder divrehem umeakimat siftehem hefech ma shennitchayyev haddin – en laddayyan ella ma sheenav root. vehu amro shamoa leshon hasekala, ben achechem perush, ma sheyyaavru benehem mehaddevarim umehahitvakkechut, ushefattem tzedek perush, kefi ma sheyyitbarer lachem shehu tzedek, hagam sheyyihye hefech mishpat hassiddur, shehammishpat lo ba ella ledayyan sheeno yodea berur laddavar – en laddayyan ella ma sheenav root.

Od nitkavven al derech amram bemassechet makkot mishna besof perek 1 (makkot 6:) veze leshonam: shello tehe sanhedrin shomaat mippi meturegman vechulei, ad kan. vehu amro shamoa ben achechem velo mehammeturegman:

Od yirtze shello yihye hashshofet matzhil panav venose enav beechad mehem umashpil enav meechad mehem, ella shettihye derech hashshemia shava benehem, vehu amro shamoa perush derech hashshemia tihye ben achechem, im atta tissa enecha – tissa lishnehem, veim tashpil – tashpil lishnehem. o efshar sheyyetzav Adonai shello yissa enav kol ikkar bahem, ki efshar sheyyite echad mehem bemin hariyya shehu ayin yafa yoter mimmennu veyistattemu taanotav. veshamati mippi chacham gadol chasid vegadol beyisrael, chaviv alay keruchi, 10 harav rabbi moshe birdugo zichrono lechayye haolam habba, shehaya medakdek bishat haddin sheyyihyu enav lematta velo haya nose enav kol ikkar, veshehaya margish sheim haya nose enav letzad hahechreach beeze echad mibbaale haddin haya mitbalbel shekkenegdo, vehu amro shamoa ben achechem shello yaasu ella hashshemia vehaddevarim baim mehattoanim lifnehem been hishtannut leechad mehem, uvaze "ushefattem tzedek".

Ben ish uven achiv vegomer. nitkavven hakkatuv lehazehir al shelosha dinim hassovvot mishpat tzedek. haechad al derech ma shekkatav rambam beferek 22 mehilchot sanhedrin veze leshono: shello tomar ish peloni vechulei shemma yaharog et beni vechulei, ad kan. keneged ze amar ben ish, uchederech sheddarshu zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 6.) befasuk "lo taguru mippene ish". keshebbaim shene achim lemishpat tavo sevarat haddayyan lomar en ledakdek bemishpat ze ki anashim achim hem, laze amar uven achiv.

Gam nitkavven lema sheamru beferek shevuat haedut (shavuot lo.) ufesako rambam perek 21 mehilchot sanhedrin 2: baale dinin shehaya echad mehem melubbash begadim vechulei, omer lammechubbad "o halebishehu kemotcha ad shettadun immo o levosh kemoto" vechulei, ad kan. vehu ma shennitkavven beamro uven achiv – sheyyihyu achim behaderaga achat, shezzulat ze lo yetze mishpat tzedek, uchemo shekkatav sham rambam bitchillat happerek.

3 Al pi ma sheamru beferek shevuat haedut (shavuot 30.) veze leshonam: tanu rabbanan, "betzedek tishpot amitecha" (Vayikra 19:15) – shello yehe echad yoshev veechad omed vechulei, vehu amro uven gero, perush sheyyihye mitgorer kemoto, o shenehem bishiva o shenehem baamida, shezzulat ze en kan mishpat tzedek.

rashi: Veal titgar bam vegomer. lo asar lahem al moav ella milchama, aval meyarim hayu otam, venirim lahem keshehem mezuyyanim, lefichach ketiv (Bamidbar 22) "vayyagar moav mippene haam", shehayu shollim uvozzim otam; aval bivne ammon neemar (pasuk 19) "veal titgar bam" – shum geruy, bischar tzeniut immam, shello firsema al aviha kemo sheasta habbechira shekkara shem benah moav (bava kamma 38):
Ar. shem hammedina:
Vayyetze sichon. lo shalach bishvil og laazor lo, lelammedcha shello hayu tzerichim ze laze:

Al me tukku vegomer. adam shellaka vechozer al sirchono, chavero mochicho veomer lo: "al ze lakita, veencha noten lev lomar 'al surchan ze lakiti, lo ashuv laasot od?" af kan "al me tukku" meachar sheadayin attem mosifim sara, lasur meachare hammakom? halo kevar kol rosh locholi, velamma lo tavinu?
targum: La mistakkelin lememar al ma lakana od mosfin lemechte vela amrin ma den kol resh mera vechol lev davay:

rashi: Velo shama Adonai bekolchem. kivyachol asitem middat rachamav keillu achzari:
