ohc: Vattashuvu vattivku vegomer velo shama Adonai vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat hakkatuv, im hakkavvana baze sheshshavu mehammilchama vayyivku al ma shehikku mehem haemoriyyim, en yadua mechuvvan hassippur baze. gam amro velo shama vegomer velo heezin vegomer im habbechi haya al tzara sheavra alehem, ma makom lemaamar ze. achen nire shekkavvanat hakkatuv hi sheachar shehikkum haemoriyyim nichneu lifne Adonai veshavu bitshuva gam bivchi al avon kemishpat hashshavim, veaf al pi chen gadla tzachanatam shello shama Adonai teshuvatam velo heezin livchiyyatam.

rashi: Vayyoridu elenu. maggid sheeretz yisrael gevoha mikkol haaratzot (sham):
Vayyomru tova haaretz. mi hem sheamru tovatah? yehoshua vechalev (sham):
ohc: Vayyikchu veyadam vegomer. tzarich ladaat: 1, lamma hutzrach lomar vayyikchu veyadam, shello haya tzarich lomar ella "vayyoridu elenu mipperi haaretz". 2, lamma amar vayyashivu otanu davar vayyomru vegomer, shello haya tzarich lomar ella "vayyashivu otanu tova".

Achen hakkavvana hi, lefi shehayu bammeraggelim shete haderagot: achat raa, hi teshuvat asara meraggelim, veachat tova, hi teshuvat yehoshua vechalev. uvidvarav kan amar shete hatteshuvot. keneged ma sheheshivu asara haanashim harshaim leraa amar vayyikchu vegomer vayyashivu otanu davar, perush, lo ratza moshe alav hashshalom lachzor haddevarim haraim shello leorer haddin al shekkevar metu, veamar hainyan setam sheheshivu davar. ulehaircha sheal asara meraggelim hu omer, amar vayyikchu veyadam, perush, al derech amram zichronam livracha (sota lod.) shemona meraggelim natlu eshkol, echad natal teena, veechad natal rimmon, aval yehoshua vechalev lo natlu kelum kaamur bedivrehem zichronam livracha. vehu ma sheddikdek bemaamar vayyikchu veyadam lomar shehem haasara shellakchu beyadam mipperi haaretz, vayyashivu otanu davar ma sheheshivu. gam efshar ladun gezera shava "davar" middavar" haamur befarashat shelach dichtiv (Bamidbar 13:26) "vayyashivu otam davar". vahagam sheen adam dan gezera shava ella im ken kibbelah merabbo, bechayyotze baze legallot peshate hakketuvim hodiunu rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheyyecholin legallot bigzera shava kazo, veze pashut laholchim beor hachayyim. ucheneged yehoshua vechalev amar "vayyomru tova haaretz". uchefi ze yesh taam nachon lechefel vayyashivu vegomer vayyomru vegomer. gam nityashshev divre moshe sheamar devarav setumim "vayyomru tova haaretz" shemmashmaut haddevarim yaggid al kullan, velidvarenu hare chillek divre hammeraggelim lishnayim, raim vetovim.

rashi: Penu useu lachem. zo derech arad vecharma:
Uvou har haemori. kemashmao:
Veel kol shechenav. ammon umoav vehar seir:
Baarava. ze mishor shel yaar:
Vahar. ze har hammelech:
Uvashshefela. zo shefelat darom:
Uvannegev uvechof hayyam. ashkelon veazza vekesari vechulei kidita besifre:

Ad hannahar haggadol. mippene shennizkar im eretz yisrael koro gadol, meshal hedyot omer "eved melech melech", "hiddabbek lashshachavar veyishtachavu lecha", "kerav legabbe dehina veiddahen" (shavuot 47):
Vaomar alechem baet hahiv lemor. mahu lemor? amar lahem moshe lo meatzmi ani omer lachem, ella mippi hakkabba (sham):

Lo uchal levaddi vegomer. efshar shello haya moshe yachol ladun et yisrael? adam shehotziam mimmitzrayim, vekara lahem et hayyam, vehorid et hamman, vehegiz hasselav, lo haya yachol ledunam? ella kach amar lahem, Adonai elohechem harebe etchem – higdil veherim etchem al dayyanechem, natal et haonesh mikkem unetano al haddayyanin; vechen amar shelomo (Melachim 1 3) "ki mi yuchal lishpot et ammecha hakkaved hazze"; efshar mi shekkatuv bo (sham Adonai) "vayyechkam mikkol haadam", omer mi yuchal lishpot? ella kach amar shelomo, en dayyane umma zo chedayyane shear haummot, sheim dan vehoreg umakke vechonek umatte et dino vegozel en bechach kelum, ani im chiyyavti mamon shello chaddin, nefashot ani nitba, shenneemar (Mishlei 22) "vekava et kovehem nafesh" (sifre; sanhedrin 7):
ohc: Lemor lo uchal vegomer. perush, lo sheamar lahem haddevarim kichtavan "lo uchal levaddi" vegomer, ella maamar hammuvan mimmennu shekkavvanato lomar "lo uchal".

rashi: Atta hitztzavta. lahem kol gevulot artzam bechol tov:
Kayitz vachoref atta yetzartam. hare ze dugemat "shevuot chukkot katzir yishmar lanu" (Yirmeyahu 5:24), lo shinnita lanu seder hashshanim:
targum: Ant akemta kol techuma deara kayta vesitva ant beratinun:

rashi: Penu lachem. amarti lehaavir etchem derech rochav eretz edom letzad tzafon likkanes laaretz, kilkaltem ugeramtem lachem ikkuv:

Penu lachem. laachorechem vetelchu bammidbar letzad yam suf – shehammidbar shehayu mehallechim bo lidromo shel har seir haya mafsik ben yam suf lehar seir – atta himmashchu letzad hayyam utesabbevu et har seir kol deromo min hammaarav lammizrach:
Hammidbar haggadol vehannora. shehayu vo nechashim kekorot, veakrabbim kikshatot (sham):
Lule vegomer hotir lanu sarid. meelav uverachamav, velo betzidkotenu:
Kimat kisdom hayinu. kullanu kalim:
targum: Ilulafon motar tuveh dayya tzevaot ashar lana shezva berachamohi it imana chovin decheenash sedom pon avadna ucheyatve amora ishtetzana:

ohc: Vattamru vegomer vattazidu. perush: himru pi Adonai sheamar lahem shello laalot, veod shehaya inyan shettachsheshu beyoter shello lehamerot, ki hu haggashatchem lifne oyvechem, veze yaggid zedon levavchem, vehu amro vattazidu vegomer. od yirtze lomar shello asu haaliyya lahar leotzem hahavtacha baAdonai kede sheyyihye lahem tikkun lemiut havetacha veemuna shehaya lahem baAdonai ad sheamru sheeno yachol chas veshalom lehatztzilam ulehorish haammim, ella bezadon asitem haddavar belo mardut vehachenaa uvakkashat tikkun lifne Adonai, laze "vayyetze haemori" vegomer.

rashi: Asher darach bah. — chevron; shenneemar (Bamidbar 13) "vayyavo ad chevron":
ohc: Hu yirenna velo etten vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar "yirenna" kevan shemmavtiach letittah lo, bichlal matayim mane. venire shennitkavven Adonai lomar sheshshete zechuyyot hayu beyad kalev beinyan ze uvishvilam zacha lishne devarim: 1 – sheppinna atzmo meatzat hammeraggelim velo amar ra, 2 – sheadrabba haya soter divre hammeraggelim lemallot achare Adonai, dichtiv (Bamidbar 13:30) "vayyahas kalev" vegomer. veyied lo Adonai shene devarim tovim: keneged ma sheppinna atzmo meatzat hammeraggelim ala beyado zechut shello yamut bigzeratam, vehu ma shessamach lomar ben yefunne hu yirenna, perush bishvil sheppinna atzmo meatzat hammeraggelim yatza mikkelal gezerat "im yire ish vegomer vechol menaatzay lo yiruha" (Bamidbar 14:23). ucheneged shemmille achare Adonai natan lo et haaretz, vehu amro "velo etten et haaretz vegomer yaan asher mille achare Adonai".

rashi: Miyyad. mershut:
Lo taalu. lo aliyya tehe lachem ella yerida:
Vaekkach et rashe shivtechem. meshachtim – ashrechem, al mi batem lehitmannot? al bene avraham yitzchak veyaakov, al bene adam shennikreu achim vereim, chelek venachala, vechol leshon chibba (sham):
Anashim chachamim viduim. aval nevonim lo matzati; zo achat mishsheva middot sheamar yitro lemoshe velo matza ella shalosh, anashim tzaddikim, chachamim, viduim (sham):
Rashim alechem. shettinhagu vahem kavod, rashim bemekach, rashim bemimkar, rashim bemassa umattan, nichnas acharon veyotze rishon (sham):
Sare alafim. echad memunne al elef:
Sare meot. echad memunne al mea:
Veshotrim. minniti alechem leshivtechem – ellu hakkoftin vehammakkin birtzua al pi haddayyanin (80 sham):
Meare happerazi. peruzot ufetuchot belo choma, vechen (Zecharya 2) "perazot teshev yerushalayim":
Vaatzav etchem. livne reuven uvene gad haya medabber:
Lifne achechem. hem hayu holchim lifne yisrael lammilchama lefi shehayu gibborim, veoyvim noflim lifnehem, shenneemar (Devarim 33) "vetaraf zeroa af kadkod":
Veet banav. banav chetiv, shehaya lo ven gibbor kemoto (tanchuma chukkat):
Lecha yom. geullatam shel yisrael:
Af lecha layla. veammecha hayu betzarot hallayla:
Atta hachinota maor vashamesh. atta hachinota lahem meor hattora:
targum: Di lach yemama lechod di lach lelya ant atkenta sihara veshimsha:

rashi: Veashiva yadi alayich. makka achar makka, ad kelot happoshim:
Kabbor. leshon borit, 118 belaaz, uleshono leshon nikkayon, kemo "uvar levav" (Tehillim 24:), al shem shehu menakke habbeged mikketamav:
Sigayich. haamur lemala kemo "kaspech haya lesigim" (Yeshayahu 1:22), taarovet nechoshet bechesef karuy sig, af kan taarovet reshaim im hakkesherim. ani achalle happoshim shehem hassig:
Kol-bedilayich. bedil hameorav bakkesef, kelomar: harshaim shebbach. bedil 390 belaaz:
targum: Veativ mechat gevureti alach vaavarer kema dimnakan bevorita kol rashiaya veadi kol chovach:

ohc: Velo ava vegomer. amar leshon ava shemmore meun belo taam, lomar hagam shello haya lo mechush leyirat haavarat yisrael beiro vesamuch batuach haya libbo sheen koach beyisrael lehara lo, af al pi chen lo ava, vehu ma sheggamar omer "ki hiksha Adonai" vegomer:

rashi: Yillachem lachem. bishvilchem:
Ad nachal eshkol. maggid shennikra al shem sofo (sham):
Vayraggelu otah. melammed shehalchu vah arbaa ummanin sheti vaerev (sham):
ohc: Vayyifnu vayyaalu vegomer. amro vayyifnu, perush, sheppanu midderech shehayu bah, ki kodem shehitchil hashshelichut hayu tzaddikim keamro "kullam anashim", umeet shehitchilu lalechet bishlichut ze hirshiu ufanu midderech hassechel. veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk "vayyelchu vayyavou" (Bamidbar 13:26).
Vayraggelu otah. perush, lo kemo sheamru yisrael lemoshe "veyachperu lanu", ella riggelu otah ladaat ma hi uma anasheha, velo bikshu ladaat chafirot hammatmoniyyot.

rashi: Tzidonim yikreu lechermon vegomer. uvemakom acher hu omer (Devarim 4) "vead har sion hu chermon", hare lo arbaa shemot, lamma hutzrechu likkatev? lehaggid shevach eretz yisrael – shehayu arba malchuyyot mitpaarot bechach, zo omeret al shemi yikkare, vezo omeret al shemi yikkare:
Senir. hu sheleg bilshon ashkenaz uvilshon kenaan:
Nachon libbi. neeman immecha:
Af kevodi. hu ma sheani meshorer lecha. davar acher: af kevodi. af lefi chevodi lo emmana leshorer lo, velo achallek leatzmi kavod:
targum: Takin libbi elohim ashabbach vaazamer lechod aykari:

rashi: Mimmidbar kedemot. aappi shello tzivvani hammakom likro lesichon leshalom, lamadti mimmidbar sinay – min hattora shekkadma laolam – keshebba hakkabba littenah leyisrael chazar otah al esav veyishmael, vegaluy lefanav shello yekabbeluha veaappi chen patach lahem beshalom, af ani kiddamti et sichon bedivre shalom; davar acher, mimmidbar kedemot – mimmecha lamadti, shekkadamta laolam, yachol hayita lishloach barak echad velishorof et hammitzrim, ella shelachtani min hammidbar el paro lemor (Shemot Adonai) "shallach et ammi", bemittun (tanchuma):

Mikkinneret. meever hayyarden hammaaravi, venachalat bene gad meever hayyarden hammizrachi, venafal begoralam rochav hayyarden kenegdam, veod meever sefato ad kinneret, vezehu shenneemar vehayyarden ugevul – hayyarden umeever lo:
Echa eshsha levaddi. im omar lekabbel sachar, lo uchal, zo hi sheamarti lachem lo meatzmi ani omer lachem ella mippi hakkabba:
Torchachem. melammed shehayu yisrael tarchanin – haya echad mehem roe et baal dino notzeach baddin, omer yesh li edim lehavi, yesh li reayot lehavi, mosif ani alechem dayyanin:

Umassaachem. melammed shehayu eppikorsin, hikdim moshe latzet, amru ma raa ven amram latzet? shemma eno shafuy betoch beto; echar latzet, amru ma raa ven amram shello latzet? ma attem sevurim? yoshev veyoetz alechem etzot raot vechoshev alechem machashavot:
Varebakem. melammed shehayu rognim (sifre):
ohc: Echa essa vegomer. hi gezerat maamar "lo uchal", ella shehifsik bainyan leharim michshol hannimshach middibbur "lo uchal levaddi" vegomer kemo shepperashti, vechazar lehashelim haddibbur shehitchil lomar veamar "echa essa" vegomer "havu lachem" vegomer.

rashi: Rashe livyatan. paro nikra ken, shenneemar: "yifkod Adonai becharbo hakkasha al livyatan vegomer" (yeshaya 27:1):
Tittenennu maachol leam letziyyim. natatta mamono leam yisrael leachlo, letziyyim lechittot utzevaot shehotzeta:
Tziyyim. siot, kemo (Bamidbar 24:24) "vetzim miyyad kittim" ketargumo "vesian":
targum: Ant terata reshe gibbare paro yehavtinun legamra leam bet yisrael vegushemehon lirode:

rashi: Rashe tanninim. hem mitzrayim shennikreu tanninim, shenneemar: "hattannim haggadol vegomer" (Yechezkel 29:3):
targum: Ant gezerta beushenach moy deyama ant tevarta reshe taninaya veshanekta mitzrae al yama:

rashi: Bemishpat tippade. al yede sheyyihyu bah ose mishpat:
Tippade. meavonoteha:
Veshaveha. ose teshuva shebbetochah. (bitzdaka – bematzdikim atzmam bemishpat uvitzdaka shebbetochah):
targum: Tzion kad yitaved bah dina titperok vedaavadu orayta yetuvun lah bezachu:

rashi: Vannefen vannaavor. letzad tzafon hafachnu fanim lahaloch ruach mizrachit:
ohc: Vannaavor meet achenu vegomer. taam shehizkiram beachva, lomar shekkiyyemu maamar Adonai shetztzivva otam leval yitgaru bam venasu mehem beachva. od keraam achenu lefi shennahagu im yisrael beachva shemmachru lahem lechem umayim umazon, dichtiv (Devarim 2:29) "kaasher asu li bene esav" vegomer:

rashi: Hitannaf. nitmalle rogez:
ohc: Gam bi hitannaf Adonai biglalchem vegomer. kashe, vahalo lo matzinu shehitannaf Adonai al moshe baavon hammeraggelim. veramban peresh veamar: veod hosaftem lehara paam acheret ad sheggeramtem lehitannef bi, ad kan, veen devarav nirim, ki roani sheadayin hu medabber beinyan hammeraggelim, shekken amar hakkatuv achar ze "vetappechem asher amartem" vegomer ad sof happarasha, vehu medabber beinyan hammeraggelim, velamma hifsik betoch hainyan beshello kainyan? uma shehelitz harav sheratza lehazekir yachad hannimnaim meavor haaretz shehem hayu gerama laze, lo yadati ma hanaa yesh baze.

Vehannachon hu al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (taanit 29.) sheamru befasuk (Bamidbar 14:1) "vayyivku haam ballayla" vegomer, kavu bechiyya ledorot ki lel tisha beav hayta shebbo nechrav habbayit, veamru od (sota 9.) sheim haya nichnas moshe laaretz vehaya bone bet hammikdash lo haya habbayit nechrav sheen umma velashon nogaat bo, veamru od (midrash tehillim et) befasuk "mizmor leasaf elohim bau goyim" vegomer veze leshonam: kina mibbae leh, ella al shehishlich chamato al etzim vaavanim. meatta im haya nichnas moshe laaretz vehaya bone bet hammikdash ulehashlich chamato alav lo efshar kannizkar, veyichar af Adonai besone yisrael veyihye kilyonam bimkom churban habbayit. laze gazar Adonai bigzerat hammeraggelim gam al moshe sheyyamut bammidbar, vehu amro "gam bi hitannaf Adonai biglalchem", perush begilgul devarim shellachem, ki im lo haya avon hammeraggelim vehayu nichnasim efshar shehaya nichnas moshe immahem, vahagam sheyyivne bet hammikdash en mechush ki lo nitgabber bechinat hara vehayu omdim betzidkam baaretz, ella meemtzaut avon meraggelim gavra yad risha veyada Adonai ki lo yaamdu betzedek, vetze ulemad mishshirat haazinu.

Veim tomar, vahalo roani shemmitat moshe hayta al me meriva (Bamidbar 20:13). kevar katavti sham sheim moshe haya mekaddesh shemo yitbarach, hayu yisrael chozrim letaharatam shehayu bo kodem chet hammeraggelim beemtzaut kiddush hashshem haggadol, vehaya Adonai mattir shevuat moshe, vehaya nichnas laaretz uvone bet hammikdash machon leshivto olamim.
Veet yehoshua tzivveti vegomer. perush, tzivviti leval yira mehaammim, kemo sheamar besamuch (Devarim 3:22) "lo tiraum", veeno chozer al maamar "enecha haroot" ki baze lo yutzdak leshon tziuuy.

Vetaam shello samach maamar ze lemaamar nefilat sichon veog, uchetavo achar hanechalat artzam livne gad uvene reuven utenaehem, lefi shemmeemtzaut tenay ze shehitna moshe im bene gad uvene reuven yivvaled hammechush mimma shemmevakkesh ezer baggibborim vaAdonai hu hallochem, ma tzorech bachalutze bene gad uvene reuven. asher al ken samach maamar veet yehoshua vegomer lemaamar chalutzat bene gad uvene reuven, lomar shello tachshov shetztzarich gevurat chogrim vetavo belibbecha yira, ki enchem tzerichin lammilchama, vehu ma sheggamar omer ki Adonai elohechem hu hannilcham lachem. dikdek lomar hu lemaet mechush hannishma mimmitzvat bene gad uvene reuven "chalutzim taavru". vetaam shehutzerach lachalutzat bene gad uvene reuven perashti befarashat mattot, veayyen bassamuch befasuk "et kol".

Baet hahi lemor. taam amro baet hahi, perush beet sheraa hattenay shehitneti im bene gad uvene reuven yeor hammechush al derech shepperashti bappasuk hakkodem laze. veamro lemor, efshar shello amar lo baet hahi lashon ze atzmo laze amar "lemor", perush, mechuvvan hammaamar hu ze. od yirtze shetztzivvahu lemor leyisrael bizman sheyyikkansu lemilchemet shiva amamin lehasir morech millibbam.

Et kol asher asa vegomer ken yaase vegomer. bemaamar ze kalal taam mitzvato livne gad uvene reuven laavor im yisrael et hayyarden, ki kederech sheasa Adonai lishne malche haemori ken yaase lechol hammamlachot vegomer, ucheshem shemmaase shene malche haemori hayu yachad shivte yisrael shenem asar, kemo chen beever hayyarden yihyu kullam nikbatzim chalutzim lifne Adonai. uletaam ze hu shetztzivva moshe sheyyaavru bene gad uvene reuven chalutzim lemilchemet mitzva, aval leolam Adonai hu hannilcham velo hachalutzim. umeatta lo haya yachol moshe lomar lihoshua "enecha haroot" vegomer ella achar shehitna im bene gad uvene reuven laavor chalutzim, aval zulat ze en reaya mimma sheraa, sheeno dome zechut shenem asar shevatim lizchut tisha umechtza, vehu atzmo shepperashti befasuk (Bamidbar 32:6) "veattem teshvu fo" sheamar livne gad ureuven.

rashi: Tichru. leshon mekach, vechen "asher kariti li" (Bereshit 50), shekken bichrakke hayyam korin limchira kira (rosh hashshana 26):

Achare hakkoto. amar moshe im ani mochicham kodem sheyyikkansu liktze haaretz, yomru ma laze alenu? ma hetiv lanu? eno va ella lekanter velimtzo illa, sheen bo choach lehachenisenu laaretz, lefichach himtin ad shehippil sichon veog lifnehem vehorisham et artzam veachar kach hochichan (sifre):

Sichon asher yoshev becheshbon. illu lo haya sichon kashe vehaya sharuy becheshbon, haya kasha, shehammedina kasha, veillu hayta ir acheret vesichon sharuy betochah, hayta kasha, shehammelech kashe, al achat kamma vechamma shehammelech kashe vehammedina kasha (sham):
Asher yoshev beashtarot. hammelech kashe vehammedina kasha:

Ashterot. hu leshon tzukin vekoshi, kemo "ashterot karnayim" (Bereshit 14) veashtarot ze hu ashterot karnayim, shehayu sham refaim shehikka amrafel, shenneemar (sham) "vayyakku et refaim beashterot karnayim". veog nimlat mehem, vehu shenneemar (sham) "vayyavo happalit", veomer (Devarim 3) "ki rak og melech habbashan nishar miyyeter harfaim":
Beedrei. shem hammalchut:
Kaspech haya lesigim. shehayu osin maot nechoshet umetzappin otan bechesef lehonot bahem:

Savech mahul bammayim. mashkim shellachem meoravim bammayim, kedita bifsikta (Pesikta rabbati 15:). mahul – meorav, veen lo dimyon bammikra; umidrash aggada poter "lischok amarti meholal" (Kohelet 2:) – meorbav:
targum: Kaspech hava lifsula vechamrech mearav bemaya:

rashi: Adonai malach. yomru leatid:
Af tikkon tevel. bemalcho tismach haaretz:
targum: Adonai melich gevtanuta albesh albesh Adonai ushena veizdaraz lechod takef tevel dela tizdaza:

rashi: Metom. leshon temimut, shalem meen machov:
Petza. makkat cherev:
Chabbura. leshon chabbala:
Umakka teriyya. tirgem yonatan: "merassa", ketuta umeruseset:
Teriyya. 169 belaaz, uvilshon gemara yesh "tarye leresheh" (chullin ma:). menachem peresh leshon lachut, kelomar: lacha vertuva, tamid novaat, 366 belaaz:

Lo zoru. hannegaim haelle lo zoru al yede rofim avkat sammane tachboshet, lashon "yezore al navehu gafrit" (Iyov 18:15). umenachem peresh leshon refua, kemo "en dan dinech lemazor" (Yirmeyahu 30:13). velo chubbashu. leshon refua:

Velo rukkecha bashshamen. lo rukkecha makkatam bashshemen kemishpat shear makkot, veen nofel kan lomar 'lo rukkechu bashshemen, sheen merakkechin ella bimkom hammakka, aval hammazor vehachavisha nofel leshonam al kol hagguf, lefichach nofel bam leshon rabbim: "lo zoru" hannegaim "velo chubbashu". veyonatan patar kol hammikra bilshon dugema, al shehem meluchelachim umenuggaim beavon, vetirgem "mikkaf regel vead rosh" mikketannim vead gedolim (Yirmeyahu 6:3), "en bo metom" en tov bo, "petza vechabbura" pesha vaavonot vechattaim. lo zoru vegomer kelomar lo nitrappeu lashuv bitshuva shelema, velo rukkecha bashshamen afillu tzad hirhur teshuva en belibbam:
targum: Mishar ama vead resha let behon dishlim bidchalti kulehon sarvin umardin itgaalu vechovin kemacha merassa la shavkin mizdonehon vela mechamdin lityuveta af la zachvan lehon leagana alehon:

rashi: Al tira oto. uvesichon lo hutzrach lomar al tira oto ella mityare haya moshe shello taamod lo zechut sheshshimmesh leavraham, shenneemar (Bereshit 14) "vayyavo happalit", vehu og:

Vannefen vannissa hammidbara. illu lo chatu hayu ovrim derech har seir likkanes laaretz min deromo litzfono, uvishvil shekkilkelu hafchu letzad hammidbar, shehu ven yam suf lidromo shel har seir, vehalchu etzel deromo min hammaarav lammizrach derech yam sof. derech yetziatan mimmitzrayim shehu bemiktzoa deromit maaravit; mishsham hayu holchim letzad hammizrach:
Vannasov et har seir. kol deromo ad eretz moav:
Tachat kol hashshamayim. limmed sheamda chamma lemoshe beyom milchemet og venoda haddavar tachat kol hashshamayim (avoda zara 25):
Kaasher esav li bene esav. lo leinyan laavor beartzam, ella leinyan mecher ochel umayim:
Ad asher eevor et hayyarden. musav al ebera veartzecha:
Sorrim. sarim min hadderech hayeshara:

Verodef shalmonim. tashlumin. targum yonatan: "amrin gevar lechavreh avid li tav bedini vaashallem lach bedinach". shofet shehaya gazlan, vehannigzal tzoek alav bifne shofet acher, ze omer lo: tzaddekeni hayyom vaani ashallem gemulecha kesheyyitzaku alecha befanay. have rodef tashlum gemulot:

Veriv almana lo-yavo alehem. haalmana baa litzok, vehayyatom yotze, vezo pogaat bo veshoalto: "ma hoalta bitzakatcha lifne hashshofet?" vehu omer: "kol hayyom hazze yagati lo bimlacha, vesofo lo hoalti." vezo chozeret laachoreha veomeret: "uma ze shehu ish lo hoil, ani lo kol shekken?" have "yatom lo yishpotu veriv almana lo yavo alehem" kelal:
targum: Ravrevayich mardin veshuttafin leganavin kulehon rechimin lekabbala shochada amrin gevar lechavreh aved li tav bedini vaashalem lach bedinach din yatma la daynin ukevelat armalta la alat lokodamehon:

rashi: Rachatzu hizzakku. pattach hu, leshon tziuuy, lefi shehu miggizrat rechatz, aval rachatzu kamatz leshon avar shehu miggizrat rachatz:

Rachatzu, hizzakku, hasiru, chidlu, limdu, dirshu, ashsheru, shiftu, rivu, lechu. eser azharot shel leshon teshuva yesh kan, keneged aseret yeme teshuva ucheneged asara malchuyyot zichronot veshofarot:
Chidlu harea. chidlu mimmaasim haraim:

Harea. kemo leharea, en tzarich lichtov meharea, shekken leshon hammikra nofel al leshon chadala, "vechadal laasot happesach" (Bamidbar 9:3), "ad ki chadal lispor" (Bereshit 41:9), kelomar: chadla hassefira, chadla haasiyya, af kan tachdelu haraa:
targum: Tuvu leorayta veidakku mechovechon veado vishut ovadechon mikovel memri itmeniu milavasha:

rashi: Toch hannachal ugevul. kol hannachal veod meever lisfato, kelomar ad vead bichlal veyoter mikken:

Vayyitav beenay haddavar. beenay velo veene hammakom; veim beene moshe haya tov lamma amarah battochachot? mashal leadam sheomer lachavero mechor li chamorcha ze, amar lo hen, notno atta li lenissayon? amar lo hen, beharim uvaggevaot? amar lo hen, kevan sheraa sheen meakkevo chelum, amar hallokeach belibbo batuach hu ze shello emtza vo mum, miyyad amar lo tol meotecha eni menassehu meatta, af ani hodeti ledivrechem, shemma tachzeru vachem keshettiru sheeni meakkev, veattem lo chazartem bachem (sifre):
Vaekkach mikkem. min habberurim shebbachem, min hamesullatim shebbachem (sham):
Shenem asar anashim ish echad lashshavet. maggid shello haya shevet levi immahem (sham):
ohc: Vayyitav beenay haddavar. perush, lefi taam sheamartem "veyachperu lanu", veamru zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni shalach) shehakkavvana hi sheyyishlechu hameraggelim lirot hachafirot shettomnim hakkenaanim mamonam bahem. veamro beenay, perush ani sheene basar li, aval beene bochen levavot – lo. veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat shelach lecha (Bamidbar 13:2).

rashi: Shimu shamayim vehaazini eretz. moshe amar "haazinu hashshamayim vetishma haaretz" (Devarim 32:1), lamma shinna yeshaya et hallashon? shanu rabbotenu bedavar ze umidrashot rabbim befarashat haazinu besifri, venechleku chachamim alehem veamru: en haddavar ken, ella bizman shehaedim baim umeidim venimtzeu divrehem mechuvvanim – edutan kayyemet, veim lav – en edutan kayyemet. illu lo ba yeshaya venatan shemia lashshamayim vehaazana laaretz, hayu shamayim meidim veomrim: keshennikranu leedut zo bime moshe, sheamar "haidoti vachem hayyom" (Devarim 30:19), behaazana shamanu, vehaaretz meida: ani nikreti bilshon shemia, veen edutan mechuvvenet. ba yeshaya vechillef et haddavar, nimtzeu shenehem meidim bilshon haazana uvilshon shemia:

Ki Adonai dibber. shettihyu edim baddavar keshehitreti bam bime moshe. lachen bou veshimu sheani mitvakkeach immam, sheavru al hahatraa. ani lo sarachti bahem, ella giddaltim veromamtim vehem pashu vi (sefarim acherim). shettihyu edim laddavar, vehechan dibber? "haazinu hashshamayim vaadabbera" (Devarim 32:1) bamchilta (ba 12):
targum: Shemau shemaya dezau kad yehavit orayti leami vaatziti ara deitregishat min kodam pitgamay are Adonai malel imi bet yisrael keriti lehon benin chavavtinun vikartinnun veinun meradu vememri:

ohc: Lo tiraum. hagam shemmedabber lihoshua, amar leshon rabbim lichlol gam kol yisrael, lomar shello yihye afillu echad miyyisrael yare mehem, ki Adonai nilcham lahem. ulema shepperashti "lemor" leyisrael, amar lashon sheyyedabber bo leyisrael sheyyivtechu belohim chayyim.
Chassalat parashat Devarim

rashi: Lenegdechem zarim ochlim otah. leenechem yochluha oyvechem:
Ushemama. mikkem, kenachala hannehpechet lezarim vehi shemama mibbealeha; kach tirgem yonatan:
targum: Arachon tzadya kirvechon yekidat nur arachon lekivlechon ammaya machsenin yatah uvechovehon tzediat minchon itchalafat vahava lenucherain:

rashi: Et kol haddevarim asher taasun. ellu aseret haddevarim shebben dine mamonot ledine nefashot (sham):
Kol yad nachal yabbok. kol etzel nachal yabbok:
Vechol asher tzivva Adonai elohenu. shello lichbosh, hinnachnu:
Vatteragnu. lashon hara, vechen "divre nirgan" (Mishlei 18) – adam hammotzi dibba:
Besinat Adonai otanu. vehu haya ohev etchem, aval attem sonim oto; meshal hedyot omer ma divlibbach al rechimmach ma divlibbe alach (sifre):

Besinat Adonai otanu hotzianu meeretz mitzrayim. hotzaato lesina hayta; mashal lemelech basar vadam shehayu lo shene vanim veyesh lo shete sadot, achat shel shikya veachat shel baal, lemi shehu ohev noten shel shikya, ulemi shehu sone noten lo shel baal, eretz mitzrayim shel shikya hi, shennilus ole umashke otah, veeretz kenaan shel baal, vehotzianu mimmitzrayim latet lanu et eretz kenaan (242 17):

Nasu neharot Adonai. leshon tzeaka vekovlan hu ze: ahah Adonai, hinne haummot hashshotfim kanneharot nasu kolam yehemayun, veet duch amke nivchehem yisu veyagbihu tamid lehitgaot negdecha. kol leshon dacha leshon omek veshiflut:
targum: Zekifin naharvata Adonai zekifin naharvata kalhon beshirta yekabbelun naharvata agar shevachehon:

rashi: Elle haddevarim. lefi shehen divre tochachot umana chan kol hammekomot shehichisu lifne hammakom bahen, lefichach satam et haddevarim vehizkiram beremez mippene chevodan shel yisrael (80 sifre):

El kol yisrael. illu hochiach miktzatan, hayu ellu shebbashshuk omrim attem heyitem shomim mibben amram velo hashivotem davar mikkach vechach? illu hayinu sham hayinu meshivim oto, lechach kinnesam kullam veamar lahem hare kullechem kan, kol mi sheyyesh lo teshuva yashiv (sifre):
Bammidbar. lo vammidbar hayu ella bearvot moav, umahu bammidbar? ella bishvil ma shehichisuhu bammidbar sheamru (Shemot 16) "mi yitten mutenu vegomer":
Baarava. bishvil haarava, shechatu bevaal peor beshshittim bearvot moav:

Mol sof. al ma shehimru veyam suf bevoam leyam suf, sheamru (sham 14) "hamibbeli en kevarim bemitzrayim", vechen benasam mittoch hayyam, shenneemar (Tehillim 106) "vayyamru al yam beyam suf" kidita baarachin (daf 15):

Ben paran uven tofel velavan. amar rabbi yochanan chazarnu al kol hammikra velo matzinu makom sheshshemo tofel velavan, ella hochichan al haddevarim shettaflu al hamman, shehu lavan, sheamru (bammidbar 21) "venafshenu katza ballechem hakkelokel", veal ma sheasu vemidbar paran al yede hameraggelim:
Vachatzerot. bemachlakto shel korach; davar acher amar lahem haya lachem lilmod mimma sheasiti lemiryam bachatzerot bishvil lashon hara, veattem nidbartem bammakom:
Vedi zahav. hochichan al haegel sheasu bishvil rov zahav shehaya lahem, shenneemar (Hoshea 2) "vechesef hirbeti lah vezahav asu labbaal" (80 sifre; berachot 32):
ohc: Elle haddevarim vegomer. "elle" miet hakkodem, perush, lefi sheamar "asher dibber moshe" shehem divre atzmo, shekkol hassefer tochachot hem umusar mimmoshe laover pi Adonai, veamru zichronam livracha (Megila lo:) kelalot shebbemishne tora moshe mippi atzmo amaran, vaafillu ma shechazar uferesh maamre Adonai hakkodmin lo nitztavva asot ken ella meatzmo chazar haddevarim, vechash hakkatuv lomar ki kederech sheamar moshe mippi atzmo devarim kaelle, kemo chen bammaamarim hakkodmin amar moshe mippi atzmo eze davar, laze amar elle haddevarim perush, elle levad hem haddevarim asher dibber moshe divre atzmo, aval kol hakkodem bearbaat chummashim lo amar afillu ot achat meatzmo, ella haddevarim sheyyatzu mippi hammetzavve ketzuratan belo shum shinnuy afillu ot achat yetera o chasera.

Od yirtze lehaggid hakkatuv shekkol arbaim shana shehaya moshe roe yisrael bammidbar, lo dibber lahem kashot zulat elle haddevarim hu sheddibber kashot. vahagam shemmatzinu sheamar lahem (bammidbar 20:10) "shimu na hammorim", lo amar davar ze lichlalut yisrael ella lechelek echad shehayu morim horaa, vechen amru besefer hazzohar. aval lechol yisrael lo dibber kashot zulat elle, vehu ma sheddikdek lomar el kol yisrael, perush el kullam hu shello dibber kashot ella elle, aval liktzatan yimmatze sheddibber kashot chutz meelle:

Od yirtze lirmoz cheshbon yamim asher hochiach leyisrael, shehem bemispar "elle", vechen mochichim hakketuvim ki beechad lechodesh shevat hitchil ledabber alehem, dichtiv "beashte asar chodesh beechad lachodesh", vehu nitzpan beshiva baadar (kiddushin lach.), hare 36 kemispar "elle" shebbahem dibber haddevarim shel hattochachot haamurim bainyan.

Od yirmoz al derech ma sheamru baggemara (yoma 19:): amar rava: "vedibbarta bam" – velo bidvarim betelim, ad kan, mikkan sheasur ledabber zulat bedivre tora veyira. vehodia hakkatuv ki moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom elle hem haddevarim asher dibber kol yamav meatzmo levad haddevarim asher tzivva meAdonai ledabberam, ha lamadta shekkiyyem "vedibbarta bam", udevarav elle kol roe yaid ki chullan divre tora vechachma umusar.

Od yirmoz al ze hadderech: "elle" – pasal kol haddevarim chutz meelle, sheen madrega shava lidvarim ellu. venatan hakkatuv taam maalatam: 1 – "asher dibber moshe" – mitztzad maalat hammedabber sheen kamohu elyon, kemo sheheid Adonai lishne echav, kakkatuv battora (bammidbar 12:8). 2 – "el kol yisrael" – mitztzad maalat hannidbar elav umma shelema. veramaz od beamro el kol yisrael, perush, lo leyisrael shehayu nimtzaim niglim sham baddor hahu levad hayu haddevarim, ella lechol yisrael asher sham hayu vaasher atidin lihyot, ki tora sam moshe bidvarav elyonim ellu veal kol yisrael lekayyem kol davar hakkatuv bidvarim elle. hare sheen devarim baolam bemadrega shava lidvarim ellu, vehu maamar elle haddevarim, perush, veen dome lahem.

Asher dibber moshe. perush, lefi shemmatzinu shehochiach yisrael al ma shehimru al yam beyam suf, veyomar haomer: vahalo otam shehimru al yam suf kevar metu venishlemu betv beav shel shenat haarbaim (Eicha rabbati, Petichta) kodem maamar ze shel moshe, veim ken elle hatztzon me asu shemmochicham? laze amar asher dibber moshe, perush im hayu haddevarim mippi Adonai en makom ledabber lahem kashot, aval moshe hu hammedabber veyachol leyasser gam otam shehayu az pachot mibben esrim shello nigzera gezera, ki bet din shel matta maanishin mibben shelosh esre, ucheneged otan shehayu ben shelosh esre beyam suf hu sheddibber moshe kashot.

El kol yisrael. taam amro el kol yisrael, lefi shebbedivre moshe yesh shene inyanim: 1 shehechzir lahem hattora, 2 shehochicham al ma shekkevar asu, ulechol echad tzerichin haddevarim lihyot lechullan – leinyan chazarat hattora, kelomar taam shehutzrach lehachezir lahem haddevarim mishshum shechash leeze adam beyisrael sheshshachach ezo mitzva mimmitzvot Adonai veen metziut lehassig daat baal hashshiggayon mi hu vehashshiggayon ma hu, laze kibbetz kullan vehechzir lahem hattora shebbeemtzaut ken yihye beyad kol echad machsoro; gam leinyan hattochacha im yochiach miktzatan yesh lahem lehitraem ma nishtannu ellu meellu. od efshar shekkalal bemaamar el kol yisrael gam leotan shekkevar metu, shebbetochchotav dibber al harishonim veal haacharonim, al derech amro (yeshaya 43:27) "avicha harishon chata".

Beever hayyarden. nitakkev millehochicham ad shehayu beever hayyarden, sherau shehiggiu limchoz cheftzam sheaz yekabbelu musaro, velo mikkodem shehayu meruchake hattikva venafsham ketzara velo yattu aznam lehasekil betochchotav.

Veamro bammidbar baarava vegomer, rabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (sifre) shehochicham al ma sheasu bammidbar vegomer. veefshar lefaresh kol hakkatuv derech remez beofen acher, vehu ki bemikra muat limmed moshe kelalut yirat Adonai umiddot hahagunot hatztzerichin laholchim betorat Adonai vehem middot tisha.
Haachat) sheyyihye lokeach middato shel avraham, dichtiv (Bereshit 14:13) "leavram haivri", vehu ma sheramaz beamro beever.
2) Sheyyihye mardut belibbo tamid, keamram zichronam livracha (berachot 7.) tova mardut achat belibbo shel adam mimmea malkiyyot, vehu ma sheramaz beamro hayyarden.

3) Middat haanava, keamram zichronam livracha (eruvin ned.): leolam yasim adam atzmo kemidbar, veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat yitro befasuk "vayyisu merfidim" (Shemot 19:2), vehu ma sheramaz beamro bammidbar.

4) Shettihye haanava bederech hannaot, lo bederech happechitut hannimas, kemo shekkatav harambam behilchot deot (perek Adonai). od tenay haanava shello yishtammesh bah leharechik tochachot al avon im yire ish over pi Adonai veyomar "mi ani umi veti lehochiach anashim gedolim", ella tzarich lehochiach letzad chiyyuv bearvut. vehu ma sheramaz beamro baarava, kalal shene devarim: 1 shettihye haanava areva al derech amro (Mishlei 3:4) "umetza chen vesechel tov" vegomer, 2 chiyyuv haarvut sheyyitztarech lehochiach al avon lekaton vegadol velo yishtammesh baanava beinyan ze.

Adonai) maamar hattanna (avot 3:1): histakkel bishlosha devarim vechulei ulean atta holech vechulei velifne mi atta atid vechulei, vechen amar hattanna (avot 82): shuv yom echad vechulei, uferesh sham shehakkavvana hi sheyyizkor tamid yom moto veshekkol yom hu zeman gevul hammita, vehu ma sheramaz beamro mol suf sheyyihye lemul enav sof adam vetachlito.

6) Maamar hachasidim (chovat hallevavot, sear happerishut – sear 9) veze leshono: happarush tzahalato befanav vedaagato belibbo. vehu ma sheramaz beamro ben paran uven tofel, keneged tzahalato befanav amar ben paran leshon peer, hefech itztzavon shehu panim raot, ucheneged itztzevon hallev amar uven tofel shello yihye libbo arev alav veyitatztzev el libbo mippachad shemma avar et pi Adonai belo yedia bigdolot o biktannot, o shemma miet baavoda mimma shetztzarich asot.

7) Sheyyihye lo lev tahor venaki, kederech shehitpallel david (tehillim 51:12) "lev tahor bera li" vegomer, veyarchik mimmennu sinat habberiyyot vehakkina vetacharut vehammastema, vehu ma sheramaz beamro velavan sheyyihye lo lev tahor sheyyityaches letahara kinnuy ze shel lavan.
8) Talmud tora bikviut keyaakov avinu, dichtiv (Bereshit 25:27) "yoshev ohalim", lo lilmod aray, vehu amro vachatzerot – hem chatzrot Adonai shehem batte midrashot.

9) Shello yihye lahut achar devarim hannidmim leehov hon olam hazze, shekkol haholech achar taavat libbo batel hu meavodat Adonai, vetzarich haadam lehistappek bahechrechi, vehu ma sheramaz beamro vedi zahav sheyyomar lazzahav day. o yirtze al ze hadderech shekkol ma sheyyihye lo yihye beenav davar maspik keillu yesh lo kol zahav, vehu al derech amro (avot 4:1) ezehu ashir hassameach bechelko, uvaze yitte levavo laavoda haelyona hi avodat Adonai elohim chayyim:

rashi: Venishmartem meod. umahu hashshemira? el titgaru bam:
Chazon yeshayahu ven amotz vegomer. amar rabbi levi (Megila 10:): davar ze masoret beyadenu meavotenu: amotz vaamatzya melech yehuda achim hayu:

Asher chaza al yehuda virushalim. vahalo al kamma ummot nitnabbe: massa bavel (Yeshayahu 13:1), massa moav (Yeshayahu 15:1)? ha lamadta sheen ze techillat hassefer velo nikra hassefer al shem hechazon hazze. vechen shaninu bivrayta dimchilta, "bishnat mot hammelech uzziyyahu" (Yeshayahu 6:1) techillat hassefer, ella sheen mukdam umeuchar basseder. vehaddevarim mochichim, shehare beyom haraash, yom shennitztara uzziyyahu, neemar "vaeshma et kol Adonai omer et mi eshlach umi yelech lanu" (Yeshayahu 6:8), veamar "hinni shelacheni". lamadnu shehu techillat shelichuto, unevua zo neemra achar kach. veal zo levaddah neemar "asher chaza al yehuda virushalim", keshem sheamar al massa kol umma veumma "massa umma peloni", af kan katav chazon ze chaza al yehuda virushalim. ulefi shehem tochchot koshi, keraam chazon, shehu kashe measara leshonot shennikret nevua, kemo sheamru bivreshit rabba (Bereshit Rabba 44:), ureaya laddavar "chazut kasha huggad li" (Yeshayahu 21:2):

Bime uzziyyahu vegomer. malche yehuda – arbaa melachim hallalu kippeach beyamav. beyom shennitztara uzziyyahu sharta shechina alav, venitnabbe kol yeme hammelachim hallalu, ad sheamad menashshe vaharago (unevua zo neemra bime chizkiyyahu achar sheggalu aseret hashshevatim ketargum yonatan):
targum: Nevuat yeshaya var amotz deitnabbe al enash yehuda veyatve yerushelem bime uziya yotam achaz yechizkiyahu malchaya devet yehuda:

rashi: Uvaddavar hazze. shehu mavtichachem lahaviachem el haaretz – enchem maaminim bo:
ohc: Uvaddavar hazze vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro "uvaddavar hazze". verashi zichrono livracha peresh al havetachat biat haaretz hu medabber, veen nire ken ella kifshat hakkatuv sheal nisse midbar hu asher nesaam Adonai kaasher yissa ish et beno, sheggam baddavar hazze enam maaminim. veze lecha haot, amro (Shemot 17:7) "hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin", vechammashal shehevi bazzohar (Shemot Rabba 26) al av shennasa beno al ketefo, pagu beadam echad vehaya habben shoalo al aviv vechulei, kemo chen yisrael am Adonai baruch hu. vehu ma shennitkavven bemaamar uvaddavar hazze vegomer enchem maaminim baAdonai elohechem shehu hannose etchem vegomer, veomer haholech vegomer mosif lehafeli perate haddevarim shebbahem yitchayyevu lehakkir ulehaamin baAdonai.

rashi: Limdu. rafe nakud, vehu miggizrat "lamod" – hayu lemedin lehetiv. hammelammed leatzmo hu mimmishkolet lashon kal, lefichach tziuuy lashon rabbim shello nakud bechirik kemo "imru", "shimu", aval hammelammed laacherim hu mimmishkolet lashon kaved hammadgish, veim ba letzauot et harabbim hu nakud "lammedu". vechen "dirshu" miggizrat "darosh", aval "ashsheru" shehashshin mudgeshet mimmishkolet lashon kaved umiggizrat "ashsher", lefichach lashon tziuuy lerabbim nakud pattach kemo "dabberu", "sapperu", "basseru":

Ashsheru chamotz. hachaziku et haggazul, vehu leshon mishna: "asharnuhi" (ketuvot ka.), "i ayashsher cheli" (gittin 30:), "yishar kochacha" (shabbat paz.). lashon acher: haderichuhu bintiv emet lizkot beshello, leshon "baashuro achaza ragli" (Iyov 23:1), "veashsher bederech libbecha" (Mishlei 23:9):
Shiftu yatom. peloni zakkay, peloni chayyav:
Rivu almana. hishtaddelu berivah lehitvakkeach baadah, sheenah yotzet lachazor achare baale dinah (62):
Chamotz. gazul, vedome lo "mikkaf meavvel vechometz" (tehillim 71:4):
targum: Alifu leotava tevau dina zakku daanis dunu din yatma avidu kabbilu kevelat armalta:

rashi: Uvammidbar asher raita. musav al mikra shellemala hemennu – kechol asher asa etchem bemitzrayim, veasa af Bamidbar asher raita asher nesaacha vegomer:

Kaasher yissa ish et beno. kemo shepperashti etzel "vayyissa malach haelohim haholech lifne machane yisrael vegomer" (Shemot 14) mashal limhallech badderech uveno lefanav, bau listim lishboto, vechulei:

Vattaanu oti vegomer. chalattem et haddavar lahanaatchem; haya lachem lehashiv, rabbenu moshe, mimmi nae lilmod, mimmecha o mittalmidcha? lo mimmecha shennitztaarta aleha? ella yadati machshevotechem, heyitem omrim achshav yitmannu alenu dayyanin harebe, im en makkirenu, anu meviin lo doron vehu nose lanu fanim (sham):
Laasot. im hayiti mitatztzel, attem omrim ase mehera (sham):
ohc: Vattaanu oti vegomer. rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sifre) sheamar lahem: "haya lachem lomar rabbenu mimmi nae lilmod vechulei mimmecha shennitztaarta aleha vechulei ella sheani yodea" vechulei, ayyen sham. veefshar lefaresh hakkatuv leshevach, sheyyisrael nitztaaru al haddavar aval lahanaat moshe machalu al atzmam, vehu amro tov haddavar lehakel meal rabbenu hagam shehu kashe etzlenu laasoto lilmod mippi talmidcha, vehu amro asher dibbarta devarim kashim etzlenu laasot otam. vahagam shehammaamar ba bichlal hattochachot, ulay shehikpid gam al ze.

Veefshar lomar ki moshe nitchakkem ledabber devarim hannishma mehem shete derachim: achat lignay kemo sheamru besifre, veachat leshevach kemo shepperashnu. vetamo ki beyisrael hayu shene sugim: echad kat hatztzaddeket veechad kat hakkanteranit, vechol echad mehem yodea atzmo. uchesheamar haddevarim kol echad yavin et asher im levavo: kat hatztzaddeket devarav lahem kedarkenu kemo shepperashti ki yodim beatzman ma hayta kavvanatam, vechat hakkanteranit yachivu otam haddevarim kefi ma sheanu veyavinu keferush sifre.

rashi: Larotchem. kemo lehareotchem, vechen (Shemot 13) "lanchotam hadderech", vechen (tehillim 26) "lashmia bekol toda", vechen (Melachim 2 9) "lalechet laggid beyizreel":

Penu lachem tzafona. sobbu lachem leruach mizrachit, min haddarom latztzafon, penechem latztzafon, nimtzeu holchim et ruach hammizrachit vezehu shenneemar (Shoftim 11) "vayavou (vayyavo) mimmizrach shemesh leeretz moav":

Venotra vat tziyyon. rekanit miyyoshveha, ki yiglu mittochah, kaasher tivvater sukkat hakkerem sheasaah notzer, uveet yivtzor hakkerem manniach sukkato veholech, "batar diktafuhi" (targum yonatan) – leachar shebbatzru otah:

Kimluna vemiksha. "kaasher teazev hammeluna sheasa notzer berosh hammiksha lishmor kishshuin shellah, umishshettillaket mannichah veholech. zo shebbakkerem keruya sukka, lefi shehu gar sham yomam valayla, bayyom shomrah min haofot uvallayla min haggannavim. aval hakkishshuin kashin hem veen lira min haofot veen tzarich leshamrah bayyom, lefichach nikret meluna al shehi linat hallelot. "kearsal mevatuta" – kemishkav hammeluna, "bemikshaya batar deaviuhi" – leachar shellikketuhu, leshon hammishna (pea 4:): "shalosh avayot bayyom:
Keir netzura. keir shetztzaru aleha, veosim sukkot saviv lah lehistatter sham hachayalot, ucheshemmistallekim mealeha mannichin otam veholchin. kol ze targum yonatan:
targum: Veishtearat kenishta detzion kemitalalta becharma batar dekatfuhi kearsal mabbetuta bemikshaya batar diavayuhi kekarta detzayrin alah:

rashi: Veatta Adonai ad matay. tabbit veencha rofe?
targum: Venafshi itbehilat lachada veant Adonai ad ematay revach li:

rashi: Chevel argov. metargeminan bet pelech terachona, veraiti targum yerushalmi bimgillat ester kore palatin terachonin, lamadti chevel argov hipparchiyya – hechal melech, kelomar shehammalchut nikret al shemah; vechen et haargov dimlachim (Melachim 2 15:25), etzel hechal melech harago pekach ben remalyahu lifkachya ven menachem, lamadti shekkach nikra shem hipparchiyya:

Achad asar yom mechorev. amar lahem moshe reu ma geramtem en lachem derech ketzara mechorev lekadesh barnea kederech har seir, veaf hu mahalach 11 yom, veattem halachtem otah bishlovosha yamim – shehare beesrim beiyyar nasu mechorev, shenneemar (Bamidbar 10) "vayhi bashshana hashshenit bachodesh hashsheni beesrim bachodesh vegomer", uvecht besivan shalchu et hameraggelim mikkadesh barnea (taanit 29), tze mehem 30 yom sheasu bekivrot hattaava sheachlu habbasar chodesh yamim, veshiva yamim sheasu vachatzerot lehissager sham miryam, nimtza vishlosha yamim halchu kol oto hadderech – vechol kach hayta hashshechina mitlabbetet bishvilchem lemaher biatchem laaretz, uvishvil shekkilkaltem hesev etchem sevivot har seir arbaim shana (70 sifre):
Lechu na venivvachcha yachad, ani veattem, veneda mi sarach al mi; veim attem serachtem alay, odenni noten lachem tikva lashuv:
Im-yihyu chataechem kashshanim. ketumim lefanay keodem shanim, albinem kashsheleg:

Yomar Adonai. tamid hu omer lachem ken, kemo "al pi Adonai yachanu" (Bamidbar 9:). davar acher: lechu na venivvachcha – ma katuv lemala mimmennu? "chidlu harea limdu hetev" (Yeshayahu 1:7-17), veachar shettashuvu elay lechu venivvachcha yachad lehodieni: "asinu ma shealenu, ase ma shealecha", vaani omer "im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg" vegomer:
Chattola. tzeva shetztzovim bo adom, garinim hem, veyesh tolaim bechol echad veechad:
targum: Bechen kad tetuvun leorayta tivun min kodamay veabed bautechon amar Adonai im yehon chovechon ketimin ketzivonin ketalga yechevarun im yismekun kezohoreta kaamar neke yehon:

rashi: Hahu yikkare eretz refaim. hi otah shennatatti leavraham:
ohc: Hahu yikkare eretz refaim. perashti lemala ki hakkavvana hi tikkare velo techashev kefi haemet, sheim encha omer ken vehi bichlal harfaim ma shennatan Adonai leyisrael, tikshe barayta desifre sheamru "asher Adonai elohecha noten lach" perat leever hayyarden shennatalta meatzmecha, ad kan, vahalo bichlal ma shennatan Adonai hi. uma gam ledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha sheamru berabbot (Bereshit Rabba 44) sheharfaim ze chivvi, umatzinu shemmenao hakkatuv bichlal hashshiva shennatan lahem baalotam meeretz mitzrayim, dichtiv: "vaomar aale etchem meoni mitzrayim el eretz hakkenaani vegomer vehachivvi" vegomer (Shemot 3:17), ella vadday sheen eretz og nechshevet refaim ella shennetaluha meatzman.

Veim tomar, vahalo matzinu shehaemori gam ken nizkar beshiva amamin asher amar Adonai sheyyitten lahem baalotam meeretz mitzrayim, vehu sichon dichtiv (Bamidbar 21:21) "melech haemori", uchetiv (Bamidbar 21:25) "vayyeshev yisrael beare haemori", vechazra kushyatenu ledivre sifre. zo eno kushya, ki are haemori haamurim besichon enam ma shennatan Adonai leavraham, kemo sheggilla hakkatuv beferush sham (Bamidbar 21:26) "ki cheshbon ir sichon" vegomer "vehu nilcham bemelech moav harishon vayyikkach et kol artzo miyyado" vegomer, hare sheeretz sichon moavit hi, ella shezzacha bah sichon venikret emori bishvil sichon shehaya melech al haemori, uleolam lo baa bichlal mattenat shiva ummot shehiggia zemannam.

Od nire ki leolam kol asher beshem refaim yechunne nichlal bemaamar Adonai leavraham "veet harfaim" (Bereshit 15:20), veeretz sichon veog bichlal asher natan Adonai hi, shehare keraah hakkatuv eretz haemori, veeretz og gam ken hare keraah refaim shehem hachivvi. uferush barayta shel sifre sheamar perat leever hayyarden (Devarim 7:13) hu al yeshivat haaretz, ki hagam shennatan Adonai shiva amamin leavraham, lo kol haaratzot shavot beinyan ze sheyyihyu reuyim ladur bahem. veyihye ze keinyan kedushshat haaretz atzmo shemmatzinu eser haderagot kedushsha baaretz atzmah bimkomoteha (kelim 1:6), vetihye eretz sichon veog pechuta lematta. vahagam shennatan Adonai otah leavraham, tihye leshalal immah, veguf haaretz tihye kishar hashshalal o leshamma, aval lo ledira.

Vehu ma sheamru besifre "latet lanu" – perat leever hayyarden. sham dikdek hakkatuv lomar "bati el haaretz asher nishba Adonai latet lanu" (Devarim 6:23), perush, haaretz asher nishba Adonai sheyyitten lanu lediratenu, lemaet shear aratzot shehagam shennetanam lanu lo natan haaretz ledira mippene sheenah reuya likdushsha. vetimtza shennatan gam ken ammon umoav veedom shehem hakkeni vehakkenizzi vehakkadmoni, uchetiv (yirmeya 49:17) "vehayta edom leshamma", uchemo chen hayta reuya lihyot eretz sichon veog. aval eretz yisrael hi ma shennishba Adonai latet leyisrael lishkon sham. ushemor lecha kelal ze gam ken shehagam shello natan Adonai haaretz ladur bah, vegam shello natan immah leavraham uchevashuha rov yisrael – yesh linhog bah din kedushsha bishvil shennichbesha lifne Adonai.

rashi: Lo tosifu havi minchat shav. matre ani bachem: lo taviu li minchat shav shellachem, sheheashan ole mimmenna kitor shel tiuv hu li, velo lenachat haruach:

Chodesh veshabbat kero mikra lo uchal vegomer. velikro mikra chodesh veshabbat sheattem neesafim likro atzara vaasifa bahem, lo uchal lisbol aven shebbilvavchem hannote laavoda zara vehaatzara immo, sheen shene haddevarim kaellu reuyin yachad: likro atzara leasef lefanay, vehaaven shebbilvavchem laavoda zara, veen attem motziin oto mittoch levavchem:
targum: La tosfun leaytaa minchat anisa kureban merachak hu kodamay yarchin veshabbin kenisha attun mitkanshin la shavkin chovechon lekabbela tzelotchon beidan kenishatchon:

rashi: Mikkolot mayim rabbim vegomer. yadati ani, ki yoter mikkolot hammayim harabbim asher yehemayun alenu (yeshaya 17:12), umeaddire mishbere hayyam hazze, atta addir bammarom Adonai, veyadcha takkifa alehem:
targum: Min kalan demayin sagiin mimshabbechaya tevire yama rabba meshabbach bishme meroma dayay:

rashi: Rav lachem shevet. kifshuto; veyesh mia, hirba lachem gedulla vesachar al yeshivatchem bahar hazze – asitem mishkan, menora, vechelim, kibbaltem tora, minnitem lachem sanhedrin, sare alafim vesare meot (70 sifre):
Ree natatti. beenechem attem roim, eni omer lachem meomed umishshemua (sifre):
Bou ureshu. en mearer baddavar, veenchem tzerichim lemilchama, illu lo shalchu meraggelim lo hayu tzerichim lichle zayin (70 sham):
Laavotechem. lamma hizkir shuv leavraham leyitzchak uleyaakov? ella avraham keday leatzmo, yitzchak keday leatzmo, yaakov keday leatzmo (sham):
ohc: Ree natatti lifnechem vegomer. amro bitchilla ree leshon yachid vegamar omer leshon rabbim, lefi shebbegeder hariyya shavim hem keish echad veen hahishtannut benehem, aval beerech ma shehem en geder kullam shave, laze amar "lifnechem", uchemo chen kol ma sheamar bappasuk achare chen bilshon rabbim "bou ureshu" vegomer eno begeder hahishtauut keechad.

Bou ureshu et haaretz vegomer. taam shehutzrach lichpol zichron haaretz velo amar otah umuvan shechozer el haaretz shehizkir besamuch, lefi sheeretz shehizkir besamuch sherau shennatan Adonai hi eretz sichon veog shennatan livne gad uvene reuven, laze kesheamar "bou ureshu" hutzrach lehazekir ma sheyyirshu veamar haaretz asher nishba Adonai vegomer, perush ki haaretz asher natlu bene gad uvene reuven lo hayta bichlal hashshevua, uchemo shekkatavti befarashat mattot (Bamidbar 32:7) vehochachnu missifre.

rashi: Edotecha. sheheidu vehivtichu neviecha levetcha, shehu naava kodesh:
Neemnu meod levetcha. uleorech yamim hu metzappe lahem, veaf al pi shearchu hayyamim, neemanim hem laAdonai meod:
Naava. kemo "neot elohim" (tehillim 83:13), leshon nave. veteda shekkol nave shebbammikra enan mefikin alef, lefi shehem leshon noy, veze mefik alef:
targum: Sehidvatach kashitin lachada levet makdeshach yain vekadishin Adonai leorichut yomin:

rashi: Yosef alechem kachem elef peamim. mahu shuv vivarech etchem kaasher dibber lachem? ella amru lo, moshe atta noten kitzba levirchotenu? kevar hivtiach hakkabba et avraham "asher im yuchal ish limnot vegomer" (Bereshit 13), amar lahem zo mishshelli hi, aval hu yevarech etchem kaasher dibber lachem (sifre):
ohc: Adonai elohe vegomer kachem vegomer. perush tzaddikim kachem elef peamim, ucheneged haribbuy amar vivarech etchem kaasher dibber vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sifre): zo mishshelli vechulei, vechavvanat hammaamar kullo hu lehazekir shemo yitbarach alehem gam keshehizkir shivcham bemidda tova heyotam tzaddikim haddomim lakkochavim, kederech shepperashnu bemaamar "Adonai elohechem hirba etchem", shehizkir shemo yitbarach alehem keshehizkir ribbuyam.

rashi: Ki Adonai elohecha berachcha. lefichach lo tichpu et tovato lehareot keillu attem aniyyim, ella hareu atzmechem ashirim:
Miyyeter harfaim. shehargu amrafel vachaverav beashterot karnayim, vehu palat min hammilchama shenneemar (Bereshit 14) "vayyavo happalit" – zehu og:
Beammat ish. beammat og:

Ad midrach kaf ragel. afillu midrach kaf regel, kelomar afillu derisat haregel eni marshe lachem laavor beartzam shello virshut. umidrash aggada ad sheyyavo yom derisat kaf regel al har hazzetim, shenneemar (Zecharya 14) "veamdu raglav vegomer":

Yerushsha leesav. meavraham, asara amamim natatti lo, shiva lachem vekeni ukenizzi vekadmoni hen ammon umoav veseir, echad mehem leesav vehashshenayim livne lot, bischar shehalach itto lemitzrayim veshatak al ma shehaya omer al ishto achoti hi, asao kivno (Bereshit Rabba nusach acher):
ohc: "Lo etten vegomer midrach kaf" vegomer. perush, en ani noten lecha laavor beartzam kede shettuchal lechufam alav, aval im bene esav yitratztzu lehannicham laavor beartzam en Adonai oser alehem haddavar, velaze shalchu malachim bedivre achva veritztzuy im yirtzu latet lahem midrach kaf raglehem laavor beartzam.

rashi: Hoil. hitchil, kemo (Bereshit 18) "hinne na hoalti" (70 sifre):
Beer et hattora. beshivim lashon pershah lahem (tanchuma; 70 sota 32):
Ketzine sedom. sarim shemmaasehem kisdom. mikkan amru (berachot 19.): al yiftach adam piv lassatan:
targum: Kabbilu pitgama dayya shiltonaya deovadehon bishin keshiltone sedom atzitu leorayta deelahana ama deavdehon damyan leam amora:

rashi: Vehaavvim hayyoshvim bachatzerim vegomer. avvim mippelishtim hem, sheimmahem hem necheshavim besefer yehoshua, shenneemar (Yehoshua 13) "chameshet sarne felishtim haazzati vehaashdodi haeshkeloni haggitti vehaekroni vehaavvim", umippene hashshevua shennishba avraham laavimelech lo yachlu yisrael lehotzi artzam miyyadam, veheveti alehem kaftorim vehishmidum vayyeshvu tachtam, veachshav attem muttarim lekachtah miyyadam (chullin 60):
Ki pi Adonai dibber. vehechan dibber? "veheveti alechem cherev" (Vayikra 26:5):
targum: Veim tesarvun vela tekabbelun lememri becherev saga titkatlun are memra dayya gezar ken:

rashi: Hayta bam. lemaher ulehummam betoch arbaim shana, shello yigremu livnehem od lehitakkev bammidbar:
ohc: Vegam yad Adonai vegomer lehummam. perush, millevad hammita atzmah od lahem shello haya lahem nachat ruach bammidbar, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 19,21) shehayu homim 360 92, vehayu homim veholchim betachaluim ad shettammu. veamro mikkerev hammachane, perush shehifli Adonai ben otam shennigzera gezera alehem uven shear hammachane, sheotam shennigzera alehem gezera hayu homim umitmaatim veholchim asher lo chen shear hammachane shehayu betocham:

rashi: Savati olot elim. kemo "pen yisbaacha useneecha" (Mishlei 25:17):
Meriim. behemot tzon petumot:
Lo chafatzti. achar sheattem ovrim al torati, "zevach reshaim toeva" (Mishlei 21:27):
targum: La raava kodamay bisgiut nichsat kudeshechon amar Adonai sevaet misat alavat dichrin uterav patimin vedam torin veimrin vegadyan dichilen la raava kodamay behon:

rashi: Lo takkiru fanim bammishpat. ze hamemunne lehoshiv haddayyanim, shello yomar ish peloni nae o gibbor, oshivennu dayyan, ish peloni kerovi, oshivennu dayyan bair, vehu eno baki vedinin, nimtza mechayyev et hazzakkay umezakke et hachayyav, maale ani al mi shemminnahu keillu hikkir panim baddin:

Kakkaton kaggadol tishmaun. sheyyehe chaviv alecha din shel peruta kedin shel mea mane, sheim kadam uva lefanecha, lo tesallekennu laacharon. davar acher — kakkaton kaggadol tishmaun ketargumo, shello tomar ze ani hu vachavero ashir umetzuvve lefarneso, azakke et heani venimtza mitparnes binkiyyut; davar acher — shello tomar heach ani pogem kevodo shel ashir ze bishvil dinar, azakkennu achshav, uchesheyyotze lachutz omar lo ten lo sheatta chayyav lo (sham):
Lo taguru mippene ish. lo tiru; davar acher — lo taguru lo tachnis devarecha mippene ish, leshon "oger bakkayitz" (Mishlei 10):
Ki hammishpat lelohim hu. ma sheatta notel mizze shello chaddin, atta mazkikeni lehachazir lo, nimtza shehitteta alay hammishpat (sanhedrin 8):

Takrivun elay. al davar ze nistallek mimmennu mishpat benot tzelafchad (sham); vechen shemuel amar leshaul (Shmuel 1 9) "anochi haroe", amar lo hakkabba chayyecha sheani modiacha sheen atta roe, veematay hodio? keshebba limshoach et david (Shmuel 1 16) "vayyar et eliav vayyomer ach neged Adonai meshicho", amar lo hakkabba velo amarta anochi haroe? "al tabbet el marehu" (sifre):

targum: Kol yoma kisufi lekivli uvahatat appay chafatni:
Im tevun utekabbelu lememri tuva deara techlun:
Adonai la berugezach tachnieni vela beritchach tirde yati:
Yarchechon umoadechon rachek memri havo kodamay lerichuk asgeti lemishbak:
Metakan kuresyach min lekadmin min alma at elaha:
Shira ushevacha al yeda dedavid:
La zar pelig uzechochit libbana veat asteta istavrana min teritzat archatach:
Kol da arat yetana vela ashlinach vela shakarna vikyamach:
Min kala dimchased umegadef min kodam bael devava venakim nikmata:

bart: Hitbil bo et hammitta. sheragleha gevohot, vei efshar lehatebilah kullah keachat bemikve katan kaze sheshshiuro metzumtzam, ella im ken ragleha shokot battit:
Heave. sheeno narok veen matbilin bo:
Shehammayim mekaddemin. lehatebil haraglayim kodem sheyyishkeu vattit, uvammayim hutbelu:
Shemmemav meruddadim. sheen hammayim amukkim, mechamat shehammikve rachav vehammayim mitpashshetim bechullo. veaf al pi sheyyesh bo arbaim sea, en kol gufo mitkasse vammayim bevat achat:
Kovesh. letzad echad shel mikve:

Afillu chavile etzim vekanim. veaf al gav denire chemikve shechilleko, afillu hachi hoil vehammayim nichnasin benehen, lo have chilluk. vechovesh denakat, mippene shehaetzim vehakkanim tzafim al pene hammayim, vetzarich lichbosh alehem avanim kede sheyyikkansu tachat hammayim:
Haya molich umevi vammayim. menanea hammayim beyadav:

Kevan sheavar haggal. shel mayim al hammaala shel mikve shehammachat munnach bah vetzafu me haggal al hammachat, tehora. ulefi shehammachat dakka uketanna veyare fen tippol bammayim, derech lehatebilah ken:
Lashsheti. millemala lematta:
Laerev. miyyamin lismol:
Chilluf haddevarim. millemala lematta, en mitztaref. miyyamin lismol, mitztaref. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Nifretzu ze vetoch ze. hayenu millemala verosh hakkotel. dedavka cheshennisdak hakkotel o nikkav ulemala verosho shalem, hu devainan kishfoferet hannod, aval keshennifratz hakkotel berosho vehammayim mitchabberim sham, saggi verum kiklippat hashshum uverochav kishfoferet hannod:
Haelyon min hattachton. kegon shehaya haelyon mayim sheuvim vetachton mayim kesherim:
Veharachok min hakkarov. velo chayshinan shemma va adam vehifsik hashshakato velo alta lo tevila:
Mevi sillon shel cheres o shel avar. vehu haddin shel etz o shel etzem o shel zechuchit: avar. oferet:
Umanniach yado tachtav. shel hassillon kede shello yetzu mayim lachutz keshehu mitmalle ad shaa sheyyashshik veyitchabberu im hammikve haacher:

Afillu chassaara. dehekellu vishuva shehi derabbanan. aval im haya haelyon chaser mikkashshiur uva lehacheshiro al yede hashshaka lehashelimo lechashshiur, en day vehashshaka chassaara, daafillu rabbi yehuda demekel tefe beferek 2‏ degittin [daf 16], bae tofeach al menat lehatepiach:
Memalle vakkatef. demeachar sheyyesh bammikve arbaim sea mayim kesherim, afillu chol mayim sheuvin shebbaolam en poslin oto:
Min hashshilloach. hu mayan hassamuch lirushalayim:
Machazeket shelosha luggin. [zehu] pachut shebbannesachim, reviit hahin lakkeves:
Shaar hammayim. echad mishshaare azara nikra chen, al shem shebbo machnisin tzelochit shel mayim denissuch hechag:
Taku veheriu. mishshum shenneemar (yeshaya 12) usheavtem mayim besason:
Ala vakkevesh. shehaya bidromo shel mizbeach:
Ufana lismolo. shennesachim naasim bekeren maaravit deromit, ucheshehu pone lismolo hi harishona:
Shehayu mashchirim penehen. mechamat hayyayin, vedomin lechesef shehu shachor min hassid:

Kemin shene chotamin dakkin. chotem echad besefel echad venekev echad bechatmo. vehakkohen meare befi hassefalim vehannesachim mekallechim veyordim derech hechotamin al gag hammizbeach, uvammizbeach haya nekev shebbo hayyayin vehammayim yordin lashshittin shel mizbeach, shehen chalulim vaamukkim meod:
Echad meubbe veechad dak. echad mehannekavim ave, vehu oto shel yayin, veechad dak, oto shel mayim:

Kede sheyyihyu kalin shenehen bevat achat. shehammayim memaharin latzet yoter min hayyayin, mippene shehayyayin av yoter umeacher latzet, lefichach haya hannekev shel yayin meubbe vehannekev shel mayim dak, kede sheyyihyu kalin bevat achat:
Hachi garsinan maaravi shel mayim, mizrachi shel yayin. hassefalim hayu netunim etzel hakkeren semuchim ze laze, ze lifne ze, echad letzad maarav veechad lifnim mimmennu, dehaynu lammizrach:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. betarte paleg, ashshelosha luggin paleg, veashshiva dekaamar tana kamma, vaata rabbi yehuda lememar af bashshemini menassechim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hageba et yadecha. kede shennire im titten mayim bassefel. lefi shetztzedokim en modim benissuch hammayim: sheppaam achat nissech. tzedoki echad et hammayim al raglav:
Hakkol tzafuy. kol ma sheadam ose bechadre chadarim galuy lefanav:
Veharshut netuna. beyado shel adam laasot tov vara, kedichtiv (sham 30) ree natatti lefanecha hayyom et hachayyim vegomer:

Uvetov haolam niddon. bemiddat rachamim. veaf al pi chen en hakkol shavin bemidda zo, lefi shehakkol lefi rov hammaase. hammarbe bemaasim tovim notnim lo rachamim merubbim, vehammamit bemaasim tovim memaatim lo berachamim. perush acher, vehakkol lefi rov hammaase, lefi rov maasav shel adam hu niddon, im rov zechuyyot zakkay, im rov avonot chayyav. verambam peresh, hakkol tzafuy, kol maase vene adam ma sheasa uma sheatid laasot hakkol galuy lefanav, velo tomar kevan shehakkadosh baruch hu yodea ma sheyyaase haadam im ken hu muchrach bemaasav sheyyihye tzaddik o rasha, ki harshut netuna beyado laasot tov vara veen shum davar sheyyachrichehu kelal, vechevan shekken hu, betov haolam niddon, lehippara min harshaim velitten sachar tov latztzaddikim. shehachote chata birtzono, rauy sheyyeanesh. vehatztzaddik haya tzaddik birtzono, verauy sheyyekabbel sachar:

Vehakkol lefi rov hammaase. lefi ma sheadam kofel umatmid baasiyyat hattov kach secharo merubbe. sheeno dome hamechallek mea zehuvim litzdaka bemea peamim, lenoten otam befaam achat. vegirsat rambam hi, vehakkol lefi rov hammaase, aval lo al pi hammaase:

Shemmitzva goreret mitzva. kach minhago shel olam, haose mitzva achat noach lo laasot acherot, vehamatchil baaverot kashe lifrosh mehem. veod, shessechar mitzva mitzva. shemmin hashshamayim mesayyein umazminim beyad mi sheasa mitzva achat sheyyaase acheret kede latet lo sachar al shetehen. vechen sechar avera vechulei. perush acher, shessechar mitzva mitzva, shekkol ma sheadam mistakker umitanneg baasiyyat hammitzva nechshav lo lemitzva bifne atzmah, venotel sachar al hammitzva sheasa veal haoneg vehahanaa shennehena baasiyyata:
Usechar avera avera. vehassachar vehahanaa shemmaggaat lo laadam baasiyyat haavera nechshav lo kaavera bifne atzmah, veloke al haavera sheasa veal hassachar vehahanaa shemmekabbel baasiyyatah:
Hashshidda vehatteva. kelim gedolim shel etz umunnachim betoch mikve chasher:
Ella im ken hayu nekuvim kishfoferet hannod. dumeya deukka deamrinan leel shetztzarich shettehe nekuva chishfoferet hannod:
Bichli gadol. kegon bar tisha tefachim o yoter, demiuto have arbaa tefachim, saggi vinkivat arbaa tefachim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Sak o kuppa. sal asuy minnetzarim shel arava kelufin:
Matbilin bahen kemo shehen. im hen bayyam. velo vau nekiva chishfoferet hannod, shekkullam meleim nekavim uvetelim mayim shebbetochan legabbe me mikve:
Enan poslin et hammikve. mishshum mayim sheuvin:

Umaalin otan kedarkan. kegon bemikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea metzumtzamot deamrinan lekamman dechar vecheset shel or kevan shehigbiah siftotehem min hammayim, hammayim shebbetochan sheuvin, ketzad yaase, matbilan umaale otan derech shulehen, uvesak vekuppa lo chayshinan, dela chashive mayim shebbetochan sheuvin lifsol et hammikve:
Chalukim. shemmattif tippin chalukim kemin shalshelet:
Battechilla. bitchillat hattalat me raglayim:
Tahor. delav min keri hu, ella meatzirat hashsheten hu va:
Baemtza uvassof. shel hattalat me raglayim, tame, demin keri hu:
Venimshachim. me raglayim medubbakim:
Tame. demin keri hu:
Levanim kaachurim. uvattechilla tahor, baemtza uvassof tame. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Yom tov rishon vechulei. deamrinan lekamman demitzvat lulav docha et hashshabbat beyom tov rishon levaddo, lefichach hayu molichin sham lulevehen meerev shabbat:

En adam yotze vechulei. dichtiv ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon, lachem mishshellachem. veim netano lo chavero bemattana afillu al menat lehachezir shemah mattana, venotlo veyotze bo veachar kach machaziro. veim lo hechziro iggallay milleta lemafrea degazul haya beyado meikkara, velo yatza yede chovato:
Niktam roshah pesula. af zo enah halacha:
Tzaftzafa. min arava veale shellah agol:
Veshel baal. sheggedela bassade velo bannachal, keshera. lo neemar arve nachal ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove:

Kol hashshocheach davar echad mimmishnato. bishvil shello chazar aleha, maalin alav keillu mitchayyev benafsho. shemmittoch shichchato hu ba lehattir et haasur venimtzet takkala baa al yado, veshiggato ola zadon. i nammi keillu mitchayyev benafsho, lefi sheotah mishna hayta meshammarto veachshav sheshshechachah enah meshammarto:
Takfa alav mishnato. shehayta kasha alav umittoch hakkoshi shebbah shechachah:
Hammayim. sheuvin. ben temein ben tehorim:
Me chevashim. mayim shekkavshu vahen zetim o mine yerakot:
Ume shelakot. mayim sheshshalku vahen shelakot:
Vehattemed. chartzannim vezagim o shemarim shennatan alehen mayim:
Ad shello hechemitz. deim hechemitz, niddon keme ferot:
Kortov. echad mishshishshim vearbaa belog:

Peamim maalin. kedimfaresh, kesheyyesh bammikve arbaim sea mayim kesherim, venatan bo sea me ferot, veachar kach natal sea mimmennu mayim ume ferot meoravim yachad, hare chol hassea shel me ferot shennishara vammikve mashlimim et hammikve:
Peamim en maalin. kidkatane vemikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea chaser achat:

Kol sheyyirat cheto kodemet lechachmato. ani shamati, shemmakdim bemachashavto yirat cheto lechachmato, shehu choshev belibbo elmad bishvil sheehye yere chet. veze al derech sheamru techillat hammachashava [hi] sof hammaase:
Chachmato mitkayyemet. shehachachma meviato lema shellibbo chafetz vehu nehene bah:
Vechol shechachmato kodemet leyirat cheto. sheeno lomed al menat laasot, hoil veen levavo pone lihyot yere chet:
En chachmato mitkayyemet. shemmittoch shehi monaat oto millalechet achare sherirut libbo hu katz bah umoasah umannichah:
Kol shemmaasav merubbim mechachmato. hacha mayre shezzariz bemitzvot ase, uleel bechol sheyyirat cheto kodemet lechachmato ayre shennizhar bemitzvot lo taase:

Afillu shenayim ketumin. ahadassim kae. uvaggemara parech i katum pasul vehu matzrich shelosha libbae kullehu shelemim, vei katum kasher lichshar shelashtan ketumim. umassik dechazar bo rabbi yishmael mittechillat devarav shehaya matzrich shelosha hadassim umachshir afillu shenayim ketumin. vehu haddin i lo mayte lehu kelal, diktumin keman deletnehu dami:
Afillu shelashtan ketumin. delo bae hadar bahadas. vahalacha kerabbi tarfon:
Mayan sheheeviro al gabbe hashshoket. shehu cheli, velo shoket shebbassela:

Pasul. lehatebil bammayim shebbetoch hashshoket uvammayim sheyyotzim veovrim min hashshoket lachutz, hoil ume hammayan kullam shofchim letoch hashshoket. aval im me hammayan ovrim al sefat hashshoket kol shehu, af al pi shemmiktzatam ovrim betoch hashshoket, kasher lehatebil bammayim sheal sefat hashshoket o chutza lah, demayan metaher bechol shehu:
Vehifsiko. sheen me habberecha mechubbarin lammayan:
Hare hu chemikve. veen metaher bechol shehu, ad sheyyehe sham arbaim sea:
Chazar vehimshicho. shechibber me hammayan labberecha:
Pasul lazzavim. dichvar pasak chayyutan. vezavim umetzoraim ume chattat ketiv behu mayim chayyim:
Molichin et lulevehen lehar habbayit. yom tov rishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat molichin et lulevehen meerev shabbat:
Hachazzanim. shammashim shehayu sham letzarche tzibbur:
Al gav haitztabba. rechava shel har habbayit hayta mukkefet beitztabbaot leshev sham, umesukkachot lemala mippene haggeshamim:
Vehazzekenim. haddoagim shello yidchafum lemachar kesheyyavou lakachat ish lulavo:
Umelammedin. bet din et kol haam lomar, im yavo lulavi el yad chaveri hare hu shello bemattana, kede shello yehe etzlo lo gazul velo shaul:
Venaflu lemikve lo fesaluhu. hoil vehen nirin keyayin, ume ferot en poslin bishlosha luggin:

Hakkol holech achar hammare. af al pi sheen hechalav posel hammikve veen bammayim shiur shelosha luggin lifsol, mikkol makom kevan sheyyesh kan shelosha luggin shennirin kemayim, chashvinan lehu keillu chullan mayim. ufoslin. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:

Al tehi dan yechidi. af al pi sheyyachid mumche yachol ladun, middarche hachasidut hu sheafillu mumche lo yehi dan yechidi. vedavka keshello kibbeluhu baale haddin alehem ledin, aval kibbeluhu baale haddin alehem, dan yechidi vaafillu midderech chasidut:
Sheen dan yechidi ella echad. hakkadosh baruch hu shehu yachid beolamo:
Veal tomar. lachaverecha hacholkim alecha kabbelu dati sheani mumche uvelo hatztzeruf shellachem hayiti yachol ladun:
Shehen rashshain velo atta. hoil vetzerafta otam immecha rauy sheyyippasek haddin al pi harabbim:
En bo mare mayim arbaim sea. im en bammikve arbaim sea sheyyesh bahen mare mayim, lo yitbol beoto mikve afillu veoto tzad sheyyesh bo mare mayim. veim taval, lo alta lo tevila:

Hallomed al menat lelammed maspikin beyado lilmod ulelammed. garsinan. vehachi perusho, hallomed al menat lihyot tamid osek battora veen bedato lihyot gomel chasadim im habberiyyot, kerabba (rosh hashshana 18.) deasak battora velo asak bigmilut chasadim, af al gav deibbae leh leiassoke nammi bigmilut chasadim, mikkol makom maspikin beyado lilmod ulelammed, vetihye machashavto naaset. vehallomed al menat laasot, shehu rotze laasok battora velihyot gam ken gomel chasadim, keabbaye (sham) deasak battora uvigmilut chasadim, maspikin beyado lehashelim machashavto, veyizke lilmod ulelammed lishmor velaasot. veyesh mefarshim hallomed al menat lelammed, bishvil sheyyikkare rav, vegorsin en maspikin beyado lilmod ulelammed. uverov hassefarim matzati kegirsa rishona, veikkar:
Al taasem atara lehitgaddel bahem. shello tomar elmad bishvil sheekkare rabbi veyoshivuni barosh, ella lemad meahava vesof hakkavod lavo:

Velo kardom lachpor bahem. velo tilmad tora kede laasot mimmenna melacha shettitparnes bah, kemo kardom lachpor bah, shehaose chen moel bikdushshatah shel tora vechayyav mita bide shamayim kemi shennehene min hahekdesh. umelammede tinokot notlin sechar shimmur hattinokot bilvad, shemmeshammerin otan shello yifsheu veyazziku, usechar pissuk teamim, sheen harav chayyav litroach ulelammed lattalmidim pissuk hatteamim. aval sechar limmud asur littol, dichtiv (Devarim 4) veoti tzivva Adonai baet hahi lelammed etchem chukkim umishpatim kaasher tzivvani Adonai elohay, ma ani bechinnam, af attem bechinnam. vechen haddayyan asur likkach sechar pesak haddin, ella sechar battala bilvad, davar shehu nikkar kamma mafsid mibbittul melachto kede lishmoa taanot baale haddin, uvilvad sheyyittol mishshenehem beshave, veim notel yoter mizze, dinav betelim. uma shehittira tora letalmid chacham lehanot middivre tora, hu, shettimmacher sechorato bashshuk kodem kol adam, vegam sheyyippater mikkol missim veullim vearnoniyyot, vaafillu kesef gulegalta chayyavin hatztzibbur litten alav, vaafillu hu ashir veyesh lo mamon harebe yachol hu lishol baddin sheyyifteruhu. veim talmid chacham chole hu umedukka beyissurin umarbin haam lehavi manot gedolot mippene kevod torato, mitzva alav sheyyittol, veen ze bichlal neot middivre tora, hoil vei efshar lo lehitparnes bederech acheret. vechen talmid chacham shemminnu oto hatztzibbur alehem parnas o rosh hasseder umitassek betzarche tzibbur, muttar lo likkach mehem peras vaafillu sachar harebe yoter mikkede parnasato, kede sheyyihyu mezonotav berevach umittoch kach yihye gadol veyaruy umeuyyam beenehem. kidashkechan bechohen gadol dichtiv beh haggadol meechav, vedarshu chachamim (yoma 18.) gaddelehu meechav, sheyyihyu echav hakkohanim maashirim oto mishshellahen. vachachamim harishonim shehayu nimnaim mizze, middat chasidut hayta bahem, aval lo min haddin:
Eretz yisrael tehora. vaafillu ayarot shel kutim shebbetochah. shello gazru tuma ella al eretz haammim bechutza laaretz:
Umikveoteha tehorim. velo machzekinan lehu vishuvim, distama vehechsher naasu:
Levaale kerayin. lehattiran bedivre tora. devaal keri asur bedivre tora ad sheyyitbol, vechi tavel afillu vemikve shekkol memav sheuvin muttar:
Afillu nitmalleu vekilon. shemmilleu mayim bakkatef veshafchu letoch gumma, umeotah gumma yesh derech sheholchim hammayim lammikve:
Shechutz lammafteach. chutz lefetach hammedina:

Kesherim af leniddot. lehattiran levaalehen, veaf al gav deikka issur karet. velo chayshinan shemma chaserim hayu venaflu alehem mayim sheuvim venitmalleu, dechutz lefetach hammedina en regel bene adam metzuyin sham:
Lifnim min hammafteach. lifnim mippetach hammedina:
Ufesulim lechol hattemeim. shebbene adam metzuyin sham harebe umemalleim bakkatef mayim venotnim sham lechabbes velirchotz:
Mippene hakkevisa. sheyyesh lomar chaserim hayu venifselu min hakkelim shemmechabbesim sham:
Veharchokim tehorim. sheen mechabbesim bahen velekka lemechash lehachi. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Veshinnu et marav kasher. dahadachat kelim la chashiva shinnuy mare:
Veen poslim oto veshinnuy mare. mishshum detziva let beh meshasha:
Mochal. mayim hayyotzim min hazzetim:
Yamtin ad sheyyerdu geshamim. dilmallot bakkatef i efshar, divchaser askinan, shehu nifsal bishlosha luggin:
Memalle vakkatef. demikve shalem en hashsheuvim poslim oto leolam:

Makom shennahagu lichpol. kol pasuk ufasuk meodcha ulematta ad sof hahallel koflim, lefi shekkol oto happerek mehodu laAdonai‏ ki tov ad odcha ki anitani kullo kaful bammikra, umeodcha ulematta eno kaful, lechach nahagu lichpol hammikraot hallalu:
Levarech acharav. hakkol keminhag hammedina. aval birkat hallel lefanav mitzva hi bechol makom veeno taluy bamminhag:
Hallokeach lulav mechavero. am haaretz:

Bashsheviit. sheam haaretz chashud al hashsheviit. unehi didme lulav yachol litten lo lefi shellulav etz bealma hu veen bo kedushshat sheviit, deme etrog eno yachol litten lo, shepperot sheviit tzerichin lehitbaer bishviit hen udemehen, hilkach tzarich sheyyikkach mimmennu haetrog bemattana velo yitten lo damav, shemma lo yevaarem am haaretz bikdushshat sheviit:

Hammatheret shebbammerchatz. shikatot hammayim haasuyot bammerchatz shennimshachim lahem mayim tzonnim lehishtattef bahen kede letaher atzman leachar sherachatzu vechammin, ufeamim shehen shete shekatot zo vetzad zo ella shehaachat elyona mechavertah, veyesh nekev bakkotel shebben shetehen shehammayim yotzim mizzo lazo:

Im yesh keneged hannekev shelosha luggin. shehannekev rachav vearoch keshiur sheyyikkansu vo shelosha luggin, nifsela haelyona mechamat hammayim sheuvin shebbattachtona, dachashiv keillu hammayim shekkeneged chalal hannekev sheuvin hen beemtza haelyona, lo min hatztzad, ushelosha luggin mayim sheuvin poslim keshehen baemtza af al pi sheen poslin min hatztzad. urevuta nakat shehattachtona mayim sheuvin vehaelyona mayim kesherim, shedderech hammayim laredet veen darkan laalot, veaf al pi chen nifsal haelyon. vechol shekken sheyyippasel kesheyyihye hakkasher letzad tachton:
Kamma yehe vannekev. hasheta ata leashmoinan kamma shiuro shel nekev sheyyetzu mimmennu shelosha luggin bevat achat:

Achad mishshelosh meot veesrim babberecha. dishlosha luggin echad mishshelosh meot veesrim [bearbaim] sea. ketzad, hassea shishsha kabbin, vehakkav arbaa luggin, nimtzeu arbaim sea hen tesha meot veshishshim log, hare shelosha luggin chelek echad mishshelosh meot veesrim babberecha, kelomar bemikve chasher shel arbaim sea, veshiaru chachamim shiur mikve shemmachazik arbaim sea, amma al amma berum shalosh ammot, hare shiur hannekev hammachazik shelosha luggin hu echad mishshelosh meot veesrim meamma al amma berum shalosh ammot hammachazik arbaim sea. verambam katav, sheim hayta habberecha pachot o yoter mearbaim sea, mechashshevin hannekev befachot uveyoter lefi cheshbon ze, kegon im haya vabberecha esrim sea, tzarich lihyot hannekev echad mimmea veshishshim:
Afillu hattachtona melea chesherim vehaelyona melea sheuvin. shedderech mayim lered, afillu hachi en shelosha luggin sheuvin shebbannekev poslin et hattachtona:
Shello amru ella shelosha luggin shennaflu. veen hashsheuvin poslin et hammikve ad sheyyippelu letocho. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Kol sheruach habberiyyot nocha hemennu. kol mi sheahuv lematta beyadua shehu ahuv lemala:
Shena shel shacharit. sheholech veyashen ad sheonat keriat shema overet:
Veyayin shel tzohorayim. moshech libbo shel adam, dichtiv (Kohelet 2) limshoch bayyayin et besari, umevi oto lide shichrut:
Vesichat hayeladim. mevattelet et avotehem millaasok battora:
Vishivat batte chenesiyyot shel amme haaretz. shemmitkannesim umedabberim bidvarim betelim:
Heve kal lerosh. lifne adam gadol zaken veyoshev barosh bayyeshiva, heve kal laavod avodato uleshammesh lefanav:
Venoach letishchoret. leadam bachur shessaarotav shechorot encha tzarich lehakel atzmecha kol kach, ella taamod lefanav benachat uveyishshuv:

Veheve mekabbel vechulei. neged kol adam ben rosh ben tishchoret taamod besimcha. mekabbel, kemo makbil. mittargum neged, kovel. perush acher, heve kal lerosh, bereshitcha kesheatta bachur heve kal laasot retzon boraacha, uveziknutecha keshehushcharu panecha mippene hazzikna tehe noach lo:
Al tehi vaz lechol adam. lomar ma yuchal peloni lehazzik li:
Veal tehi maflig. marchik lechol davar sheyyesh lachush alav, al tomar rachok hu sheyyihye veen lidog mimmennu:
Kol hameorav. chore hammeara. chorin shebbetoch hammikve. umishshum sherov tevilot shellahen bimarot, kare lemikve meara:
Kema shehen. af al pi sheen nekuvin kishfoferet hannod:
Ukkat hammeara. gumma shebbeshule hammikve, en memeha necheshavin im meme hammikve shellemala mehen lihyot kesherim litbol bahen, ella im ken yesh benehen kishfoferet hannod lechabberan:
Amar rabbi yehuda ematay. lo va rabbi yehuda lachalok ella lefaresh:
Bizman shehi maamedet et atzmah. keshebba litbol baukka, haukka hi maamedet et atzmah, veen haggag hammafsik benah uven hammeara nofel meelav:
Aval im enah maamedet et atzmah. uveshaa shebba litbol, nofel gag haukka, shehu tachtit hammikve, umitarvim meme hammeara veme haukka:
Matbilin bah kema shehi. afillu en bannekev kishfoferet hannod:
Gigiyyot. kelim shel zahav meleim mayim, kede shello yichmeshu alehen:
Chariyyot. anafim shel dekel hayu meviim ben bechol ben bashshabbat, velo arava, dichtiv kappot temarim, shetayim hen, achat lallulav veachat lammizbeach. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka:
Hamechallel et hakkadashim. hammevi kadshe hammizbeach lide piggul venotar vetame, o hammoel venehene ben bekadshe mizbeach ben bekadshe bedek habbayit:
Vehamevazze et hammoadot. yamim shel chol hammoed, ose bahen melacha o noheg bahen minhag chol baachila ushetiyya:

Vehammalbin pene chavero varabbim. hammitbayyesh panav maadimot techilla veachar kach mitlabbenot, shehannefesh yesh lah shete tenuot achat lachutz veachat lifnim, ucheshemmevayyeshin et haadam bitchilla haruach mitnoea letzad chutz kemi shemmitmalle chema ufanav maadimot, uchesheeno motze taana ketzad yasir habboshet hahu meal panav, hu doeg bekirbo venichnas haruach letzad panav mippene hatztzaar, ufanav mitkarkemim umitlabbenim. vezehu sheamru (bava metzia noach:) beinyan hahalbana, deazzil sumeka veati chivra:
Vehammefer berito. shello mal, o shemmal umoshech arlato lechassot hammila kede shello yerae shehu mahul:
