Vehamegalle fanim battora. shemmare panim uferushim battora shello kahalacha. kegon hametargem umizzaracha lo titten lehaavir lammolech, umizzaracha lo titten leaavara learmiyyuta. veen ze peshuto shel mikra. uvichlal ze haddoresh derashot shel dofi. perush acher, megalle panim, shemmeez panav laavor al divre tora befarhesya beyad rama veen lo boshet panim:

Af al pi sheyyesh beyado tora umaasim tovim. velo chazar bitshuva meachat meaverot hallalu shebbeyado, af al pi shebbau alav yissurim umet bayyissurim, en lo chelek laolam habba. aval im chazar bitshuva kodem moto, en lecha davar sheomed bifne hatteshuva:
Hashsheni tame. devadday chasar shiur hammikve bitvilato shel rishon:

Af hashsheni tahor. deamrinan gud achet, vehave cheillu hammayim sheheela harishon begufo hen mechubbarin leme mikve velo nechsar mishshiuro chelum. ufershu vaggemara dachagiga [daf 19] delo tiher rabbi yehuda ella vemaalot derabbanan, kegon shehaya tahor lechullin vetaval lihyot tahor lemaaser, o shehaya tahor lemaaser vetaval lihyot tahor litruma. aval laalot mittuma gemura letohora, divre hakkol tame. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Sagos. beged tzemer av, vekorin lo vaaravi 355, uvolea mayim harebe:

Miktzato nogea bammayim tahor. uvemikve sheyyesh bo arbaim sea metzumtzamot ayre, vetaval bo adam leachar shehitbil bo et hassagos, tahor haish hattovel af al pi shennechsar shiur mikve bitvilat hassagos, meachar shemmiktzat hassagos nogea bammayim. verabbi yehuda hi disvira leh amrinan gud achet:
Hammayim shebbetochan sheuvim. vechozrim ufoslim et hammikve bishlosha luggim. shehare lo hayu vo ella arbaim sea mechuvvanot venitchasser keshehigbiah siftotehen min hammayim:
Umaale otam derech shulehem. kede shello yippelu hammayim shebbetochan lammikve veyippaslu chol memav:
Gal shennitlash. min hayyam sheholech vesoer:
Venafal al haadam veal hakkelim tehorim. lechullin bilvad, dechullin lo vau chavvana. aval lemaaser sheni velitruma, lo tahar hattovel ad sheyyechavven:
Tovlin. ish veishsha:
Umatbilin. kelim o yadayim bemakom shetztzarich tevilat yadayim, kegon lakkodesh delo saggi vintila:
Charitzin. rechavim umerubbaim kimara, ella sheenan mekorin:
Neitzin. ketzarim millematta urechavim millemala:
Parsat chamor. vehu haddin parsat kol behema:
Hameorevet babbika. gumma shennaaset bakkarka al yede farsat regel shel behema venitkabbetzu vah mayim, vehi meorevet lemikve shel arbaim sea al yede nekev kishfoferet hannod, matbilin bah:
Chardalit. kemo har dalit. zerem mayim habbaim middalyo shel har, perush miggova hahar. vaafillu en mittechillatan vead sofan ella arbaim sea, matbilin bahen levet shammay:
Uvet hillel omrim en matbilin. ad sheyyihyu arbaim sea bemakom echad, sheen chardalit metaheret ella veashboren:
Sheggoder kelim vetovel bahem. ose mechitztza vechelim kede sheyyeakkevu hilluch hammayim velo yihyu zochalin, vetovel beotan hammayim shebbetoch mechitztzat hakkelim shehen keme mikve:

Vechelim sheggadar bahen lo hutbelu. lefi shello hutbal kol hakkeli bammayim shebbetoch hammechitztza, ki im hatztzad shekkelappe hachardalit velo tzad shekkelappe chutz. vei kashya, veha amar rabbi yose leel kol davar shehu mekabbel tuma en mazchilin bo, vehechi faleg abbet hillel shemmodim sheggoder kelim vetovel bahen. yesh lomar, dehay umodim assefa kae, deamar vechelim sheggadar bahen lo hutbelu, vehachi kaamar, modim bet shammay levet hillel shehaggoder kelim vetaval bahen, kelim sheggadar bahen lo hutbelu. aval bet hillel leolam savre sheen goder kelim vetovel bahen, kerabbi yose deamar kol davar shehu mekabbel tuma en mazchilin bo. vehachi mashma battosefta:
Baze esrim uvaze esrim. mayim kesherim, uvashshelishi esrim sea mayim sheuvin:
Vetavlu venitarvu. al yede tevilatan tzafu hammayim vehishshiku venitchabberu shelashtan ze vaze:

Hammikvaot tehorim. afillu hashshauv. shehare shene hakkesherim mitarvim yachad veyesh kan shiur mikve arbaim sea mayim kesherim, ucheshemmitchabber lahen hashshauv shehammayim tzafin al gabbehen mechamat hattovlim, huchsheru memav litvila:
Haya hashshauv baemtza. mechamat shehashshauv mafsik ben shenayim hachitzonim hakkesherim, en hakkesherim mitarvin ze im ze:

Hammikvaot kemot shehayu. shehakkesherim kesherim lehikkavot alehen lehashelim arbaim sea kesherim, vehashshauv en kasher lehikkavot alav. veaf al pi shemmeme hashshauv mitarvim im kol echad, lo mippasle lehikkavot alehen, dederech hameshacha nitarvu velo naflu min hakkeli lakkesherin, uma sheyyardu mimmennu lechol echad, nitbattel berov kodem sheyyardu lammikve:
Im en tora vechulei. en massao umattano yafe im habberiyyot:
Im en derech eretz vechulei. sof shettorato mishtakkachat mimmennu:

Im en daat vechulei. daat, hu shemmotze taam laddavar. uvina, hu shemmevin davar mittoch davar aval eno mare lo taam. veim en daat latet taam laddavar en bina, achar shello yada taamo shel davar keillu lo yedao. umikkol makom habbina hi kodemet, lefichach im en bina en daat:
Im en kemach en tora. mi sheen lo ma yochal heach yaasok battora:
Im en tora en kemach. ma yoil lo hakkemach shebbeyado, hoil veen bo tora, noach lo shello haya lo kemach vehaya met baraav:
Heve memaet beesek. hameet beesek sechoratcha umelachtecha, veyihye ikkar iskecha battora:
Veheve shefal ruach bifne chol adam. lilmod afillu mimmi shehu katan mimmecha bechachma:

Yesh lecha vetelim harebe chenegdach. sheyyesayyeu levattelcha. perush acher, yesh baolam kamma betelim shehem harshaim vechayyot raot shehem betelim, veal yadam hakkadosh baruch hu yavi alecha puranut:
Veim asakta vattora. hu atzmo yeshallem secharcha velo al yede shaliach. uveze yetera midda tova al middat puranut:
Shehu mashuch kenadal. shemmemav zochalim bimkomot harebe, kesheretz ze shemmarbe raglayim, vekorin lo velaaz 259:
Ribba alav. mayim sheuvim, ad shennimshechu venitgaddelu hammekomot shemmemav zochalim sham:
Hare hu chemo shehaya. hammekomot hallalu metaharim bezochalim uvechol shehu kemo shehayu vattechilla:
Haya hammayan omed. velo hayu memav nizchalim, veribba alav mayim sheuvim venitgaddel hammayan ad shemmemav nizchalim elach vaelach mechamat hammayim sheuvin:

Shave vechulei‏ lemayan. hammekomot hallalu shehammayim nizchalim bahem, shavin lemayan shemmetaharim bechol shehen, veshavim lemikve sheen metaharim bezochalin ella veashboren. perush acher, ribba alav vehimshicho, hirchiv habberechot shehayu moshchot mayim min hammayan hahu vehigdilan, hare hu chemot shehaya, devammakom shehayu memav zochalim kodem sheribba alehen vehirchivan, sham metaher bezochalin, umin hatztzedadim en metaher ella veashboren. aval im lo hayu memav zochalim ella omdim, veribba alav, shehirchiv mekom amidatan, vehimshicham, sheasa mekom amidatan zochalin, shave lemikve letaher beashboren, veen metaher bezochalin, meachar deikkar mekom hammayan enan zochalin:

Kol hamechabbed et hattora. haddoresh hachaserot vehayeterot shebbattora umare taam al kol kotz vekotz lomar sheen bah davar levattala, en lecha kevod tora gadol mizze. i nammi, hamechabbed sefer tora umechabbed lomde hattora vehaoskim bah, kol ellu bichlal mechabbed et hattora hen:
Asara shehayu yoshvim baddin. garsinan:
Baadat el. veen eda pechuta measara, shenneemar bamraggelim (Bamidbar 14) ad matay laeda haraa hazzot, yatzu yehoshua vechalev, hare asara:
Uminnayin afillu chamishsha shenneemar bekerev elohim yishpot. shelosha dayyanim ushene baale dinim:

Uminnayin afillu shelosha shenneemar vaaguddato al eretz yesadah. haesh vehaavir vehammayim shehem shelosha, al eretz yesadah, al yesod haaretz hem makkifim. hare lecha sheshshelosha keruyin agudda. i nammi, matzinu shelosha keruyin agudda, aguddat ezov shehem shelosha kelachim. veyesh sefarim shekkatuv bahen uminnayin afillu chamishsha shenneemar vaaguddato al eretz yesadah, sheadam oged beyado achat sheyyesh bah chamesh etzbaot, uchelal etzbaot shebbayyad keruyin agudda. uverosh hammikra hu omer, habbone bashshamayim maalotav, kelomar hashshechina shehi bashshamayim yoredet lematta laaretz kesheyyesh sham agudda oskim battora. uminnayin afillu shelosha shenneemar bekerev elohim yishpot, shehaddayyanim hem shelosha:
Ki natal alav. leshon sechach. targum vesakkota, vetattel, kelomar shehashshechina sochechet alav:

Eruv mikvaot. mikve chaser shebbetzad mikve shalem, i nammi baze esrim sea uvaze esrim sea umitarvin hammayim derech charitz o nekev, shiuro letzarfan ulehachshiran keillu yesh bechol echad arbaim sea:
Kishfoferet hannod keavyah vechachalalah. shel kane shennotnin befi hannod,
Vehayenu chishte etzbaot chozrot limkoman. mithappechot berevach bachalal hannekev. ushete etzbaot sheamru hen shete etzbaot hassemuchot laggudal, harishonot shebbefas hayyad, dehaynu etzba veamma:
Mippene shehi min hattora. chiyyuv hattevila bemikve mayim have min hattora:

Vechen kazzayit min hammet. safek yesh bahen kashshiur safek en bahen kashshiur, sefekan tame. vedavka virshut hayyachid. aval birshut harabbim, sefekan tahor. veaf al gav daafillu vidrabbanan sefek tuma virshut hayyachid sefeko tame, mikkol makom hacha illu havu shiure derabbanan, hayinu metaharin oto:
Kol sheyyaamod. ben afar ben tzerorot ben yavchushim adummim haggedelin bammayim, im omdin al pi hannekev memaatin bishfoferet hannod veen hammikvaot mitarvin:
Kol shehu mibberiyyat hammayim. kegon yavchushim adummim. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Hamekayyem et hattora meoni. shehu dachuk limzonot umitbattel mimmelachto kede laasok battora:
Hamevattel et hattora meosher. mechamat rov hammamon tzarich litten libbo paam lechan ufaam lechan veen lo penay laasok battora:
Alta chazazit. kemin avabuot dakkot:
Al rubbo. bemakom echad hu devainan rubbo, aval bishnayim o bishlosha mekomot afillu al miuto pasul. veal pitmato afillu kol shehu pasul, sheshsham hu nire yoter mibbishar mekomot:
Pitmato. haddad shebberosho. kemo pitma shel rimmon:

Niklaf pasul. vedavka shenniklaf kullo, aval miktzato kasher. veit deamre ippecha, niklaf miktzato pasul, demechaze kimnummar, aval niklaf kullo kasher. vehay niklaf lav shehusera hakkelippa ad shennire hallavnunit shebbetocho, dehay have chaser ufasul, ella shenniklaf mimmennu geled dak umarehu yarok kaasher bitchilla:

Nikkav. nekev mefullash meever el ever afillu bechol shehu pasul. vesheeno mefullash veeno chaser kelum, kegon shettachav bo yated ava, im hannekev rachav keissar pasul, pachot mikkan kasher. vehayenu nikkav velo chasar kol shehu kasher ditninan lekamman, sheeno mefullash veeno rachav keissar:
Etrog hakkushi. sheggadal kan vehu shachor, pasul. aval kushi sheggadal beeretz kush orcheh hu vechasher:
Verabbi yehuda posel. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda. vechol hane pesulim beyom tov rishon, aval beyom tov sheni im shear hayyamim hakkol kasher:
Bammikdash shiva. kiddarshinan lifne Adonai‏ elohechem shivat yamim, velo bigvulin shivat yamim:
Bammedina. birushalayim, sheaf hi kigvulim leinyan ze:
Vesheyyehe yom hanef. shel omer, dehaynu yom 16 benisan:

Kullo asur. uvizman shebbet hammikdash kayyam mishshekkarav haomer hayu ochlim chadash bo bayyom, dichtiv (Vayikra 23) ad haviachem. ucheshecharav bet hammikdash muttar min hattora mishsheheir hammizrach, deamrinan katuv echad omer (sham) ad etzem hayyom hazze, demashma mishsheheir hammizrach, vechatuv echad omer ad haviachem, ha ketzad, bizman deikka omer ad haviachem, bizman delekka omer ad etzem hayyom. veasar rabban yochanan ben zakkay alehem kol hayyom, mishshum mehera yibbane bet hammikdash veyomru eshtakad mi lo hava achlinan mishsheheir hammizrach, hasheta nammi nechol:
Vehechan hayu menanein. hasheta mehadder tanna leha ditninan leel, kol lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim kede lenanea, alma mitzva beninua, vehechan menaneim:
Behodu laAdonai‏ techilla. techillat hammikra:

Vasof. sof hammikra, ki leolam chasdo. veit dimfarshe techilla hodu rishon, vesof hodu acharon shebbesof hahallel. vehachi mistabbera. vechetzad menanea, molich umevi kede laatzor ruchot raot, maale umorid kede laatzor telalim raim. uveholacha menanea shalosh peamim, vechen bahavaa vechen baaliyya vechen birida, al kol achat veachat shalosh peamim:
Vehem lo nineu ella veanna Adonai‏ hoshia na bilvad. veen kach halacha ella kedivre bet hillel:
Yittol al shulchano. im shachach velo natal lulav kodem achila yafsik seudato veyittol al shulchano:
Hachoshech atzmo min haddin. bemakom sheyyesh gadol mimmennu. i nammi, omer levaale haddin sheyyitpashsheru:
Porek mimmennu eva. shehayyotze mibbet din chayyav, sone laddayyan, sheomer belibbo lo hippech bizchuti:
Vegazel. shemma yechayyev hazzakkay venimtza sheggazel ba al yado:

Ushevuat shav. shemma yechayyev shevua lemi sheeno chayyav bah venimtza mevi lide shevuat shav. i nammi, kare tanna lishvuat sheker shevuat shav, kegon haomer lo laviti velava, devishat shevua yatza mippiv lashshav:
Vehaggas libbo vahoraa. belo iyyun uvelo hametana:
Vehitbilan hare ellu tehorim. vaafillu en pi haddeli rachav kishfoferet hannod. uchegon shehaddeli atzmo tame vetzarich tevila, demiggo desalka leh tevila laddeli, salka leh nammi lema shebbetocho:
Veim lo taval. garsinan. kelomar veim haddeli tahor veeno matbilo, sheeno tzarich tevila:
Ad sheyyehu meoravin kishfoferet hannod. en hakkelim shebbetocho tehorim ad sheyyihye vefi haddeli chishfoferet hannod:
Lulav vaarava. lulav lintila vaarava lehakkif hammizbeach:
Shishsha veshiva. lefi sheppeamim dochim et hashshabbat vehavu lehu shiva, ufeamim sheen dochin velo havu ella shishsha. ulekamman mefaresh lehu veazel:
Vehahallel. ligmor kol shemona, ma sheen ken befesach, lefi sheyyemot hechag chalukim bekarbenotehen:

Vehassimcha. leechol besar shelamim bizman hammikdash, dichtiv (Devarim 17) vesamachta bechaggecha, veen simcha bizman hammikdash ella bivsar shelamim, dichtiv (sham 26) vezavachta shelamim veachalta sham vesamachta:
Sukka. leshev bassukka:
Venissuch hammayim. bitmide hechag shacharit:
Hechalil. besimchat bet hashshoeva hayu semechim bechag lichvod sheivat nissuch hammayim, umenaggenim bachalilim vechinnorot. veoto chalil eno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov:
Yehi chevod talmidcha chaviv alecha keshellecha. shekken matzinu bemoshe sheamar lihoshua talmido bechar lanu anashim (Shemot 17), asao shave lo:
Uchevod chavercha kemora rabbecha. deamar leh aharon lemoshe bi adoni (Bamidbar 12), veachiv gadol mimmennu beshanim haya vekare leh adoni:
Umora rabbecha kemora shamayim. dichtiv (sham 11) adoni moshe kelaem, kallem min haolam, kevan shemmardu becha keillu mardu behakkadosh baruch hu vechayyavim kelaya:

Meod meod heve shefal ruach. af al pi shebbishar middot hadderech haemtzait hi hameshubbachat, bemiddat haggaava eno chen, ella yitte lakkatze haacharon shel shiflut haruach. lefi shehaggaava hi meusa beyoter, veod sherov bene adam nichshalim bah velo bedile eynashe minna, lechach tzarich laasot lah harechaka yetera:

Chibba yetera nodaat lo. rambam peresh, chibba yetera hera hakkadosh baruch hu laadam shehodio veamar lo ree shebberaticha betzelem, shehammetiv lachavero umodio hattova sheasa immo, mare chibba yetera yoter mishsheillu hetiv immo veeno chashuv beenav lehodio hattova sheasa immo. veyesh lefaresh, chibba yetera nodaat lo, chibba geluya umefursemet, shello bilvad ahava mesutteret haya lo lammakom baruch hu im haadam ella af chibba geluya vidua lakkol:
Shenneemar ki lekach tov. kol maase vereshit shenneemar bo vayyar elohim ki tov, lo nivra ella bishvil hattora shennikret lekach, kema deat amar (Devarim 32) yaarof kammatar likchi:

Patur mippene shehotzio virshut. uchegon shello yatza yede chovat netila beshaa shehotzio. aval yatza yede chovat netila kodem shehotzio, chayyav, delo tared mehasheta bammitzva laasotah. vehechi mashkachat delo yatza yede chovat netila kodem shehotzio, deha middeagbeheh nafak beh, mashkachat leh kegon shehafacho, shekkol hammitzvot kullan en adam yotze bahen ella derech gedilatan, shenneemar (Shemot 26) atze shittim omdim, sheomdim derech gedilatan. i nammi shehotzian bichli, dilkicha al yede davar acher derech bizzayon lav shemah lekicha. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Nikra motza. baggemara omer sheshshemo 191, veod hayyom kach shemo, vehaarava metzuya sham, vehammakom rachok mirushalayim meat. uferush 191 chafshi mimmas. ulefichach nikra motza, shehaya mutza mimmas hammelech bishvil haarava shellokchim mishsham:
Murbiyyot. anafim gedolim gevohim achat esre amma, umenichim otam al yesod hammizbeach, verashehen zekufim umutin al hammizbeach amma:
Ani vaho. begimatriyya anna Adonai. veod hem shene shemot shebbeshem amud bet. perush acher, mi sheani vehu betzara, al derech immo anochi betzara, hoshia na:
Peraklit. malach melitz tov:
Kattegor. melitz ra. uleshon kattegor, kore tiggar. vesannegor shehu hefech kattegor, perusho sone tiggar:
Niktam rosho pasul. velet hilcheta kistam matnitin, ella kerabbi tarfon deamar lekamman afillu shelashtan ketumin kesherim:
Anavav. peri yesh bo sheddome laanavim:
Merubbot mealav pasul. lo shanu ella shechorot o adummot, aval yerukkot mina dahadas hu vechasher:
Veen memaatin otan beyom tov. dahava leh metakken:
Hattinokot shomtim et lulevehen. haggedolim shomtim luleve hattinokot miyyadan shel tinokot:

Veochlim. haggedolim etrogehen shel tinokot. veen baddavar mishshum gezel, shekkach nahagu mishshum simcha. perush acher, hattinokot mashlichim lulevehen miyyadam veochlim etrogehen bashshevii, aval haggedolim en ochlim etrogehen kol oto hayyom, dechevan shehuktza lemitzva lemiktzat hayyom, huktza lechullo:
Ben zoma. lefi shello heerich yamim velo nismach sheyyikkare rabbi, hayu korin oto al shem aviv. vechen ben azzay. ushenehem shemam shimon:
Ezehu chacham. hachi kaamar, ezehu chacham sherauy sheyyithallel bechachmato:
Hallomed mikkol adam. veaf al pi shehu katan mimmennu. shekkevan sheeno chas al kevodo velomed min hakketannim, nikkarim haddevarim shechachmato hu leshem shamayim velo lehityaher ulehitpaer bah:

Shenneemar mikkol melammeday hiskalti. vesefa dikra ki edvotecha sicha li, kelomar hayiti lomed tora mikkol melammeday vaafillu min hakketannim mimmenni velo hayiti choshesh lichvodi, ki edvotecha sicha li, shekkol kavvanati hayta lashshamayim bilvad. vechen ezehu gibbor sherauy sheyyithallel bigvurato, hakkovesh et yitzro:

Shenneemar tov erech appayim miggibbor. hachi have perusha dikra, tov erech appayim habba mitztzad haggevura shel kibbush hayyetzer, lo mitztzad rakkut hatteva. vechen moshel berucho keshebba milloched ir, min hammelech shelleachar shekkavash et hair uvau leyado haanashim hammordim bo, moshel berucho veeno horgan:
Ezehu ashir. harauy lo lehithallel beashro, hassameach bechelko:

Ezehu mechubbad. lefi sheshshelosha devarim tovim hallalu shennizkeru leel, shehem hachachma vehaggevura vehaosher, hazzoche bahem hu nichbad meatzmo beene elohim veadam, veaf im habberiyyot lo yechabbeduhu baavuram, lechach chibber hattanna leze veamar mi sheyyesh bo hammiddot hallalu vehu nichbad beatzmo, ma yaase veyihye mechubbad meacherim, yechabbed et habberiyyot:

Ki mechabbeday achabbed. vehaddevarim kal vachomer, uma hakkadosh baruch hu shehu melech hakkavod vechol ma shebbara beolamo lo bara ella lichvodo, mechabbed et mechabbedav, kal vachomer levasar vadam:
Uvozay yekallu. lamadnu anvetanuto shel hakkadosh baruch hu. lo amar uvozay akallel, ella yekallu meatzmam. uvichvod hatztzaddikim hikpid yoter, shenneemar (Bereshit 12) umekallelcha aor:
Lulav shiva. deyom rishon doche shabbat, mishshum deit leh ikkar min hattora bigvulim, dichtiv (Vayikra 23) ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon:

Ushear kol hayyamim. im chal yom tov rishon bishar yeme hachol, venimtzet shabbat bechol hammoed, lo dache. veaf al gav dechol shiva hu min hattora bammikdash, heemidu chachamim gezeratam bishar yeme hechag hoil veen lahem ikkar min hattora bigvulim. uvedin haya daafillu bazzeman hazze yihye lulav doche et hashshabbat beyom tov rishon shel chag, ella mishshum delo bekiinan bikvia deyarcha, veshemma en ze yom tov rishon, hilkach lo dachinan shabbat missefeka. vetaama degazru shello littol lulav beshabbat, vahare en bintilato shum melacha ella tiltul bealma, gezera shemma yittelennu beyado veyelech etzel baki lilmod habberacha o seder hanninuim veyaavirennu arba ammot birshut harabbim, vehayenu taama deshofar, vehayenu taama dimgilla:
Hakkol natun beeravon. raglohi devar nash inun arevin beh (sukka 53.) laatar demitbae taman movilin yateh:
Umetzuda ferusa. yissurin umita:
Hachanut petucha. uvene adam nichnasim sham velokchim bahakkafa:
Vehachenvani mekif. umaamin lechol habba littol. kach bene adam chotim bechol yom vehakkadosh baruch hu mamtin lahem ad bo ittam:
Vehappinkas patuach. lichtov bah hahakkafot kede shello yishachach:
Vehayyad kotevet. shello tomar af al pi shehappinkas patuach peamim shehachenvani tarud veeno kotev hakkol, lechach amar vehayyad kotevet:
Vechol harotze lilvot vechulei. hayenu veharshut netuna dilel, sheen shum adam muchrach lilvot shello birtzono:
Vehaggabbaim. yissurim ufegaim raim:
Ledato. peamim shezzocher et chovo veomer yafe dantani:
Veshello ledato. peamim sheshshachach vekore tiggar keneged dino shel makom baruch hu:

Veyesh lahem al ma sheyyismochu. al happinkas, veal hachenvani shehu neeman al pinkaso. kach hayyissurim hallalu hen nismachim al maasav shel adam hannizkarim lifne hammakom baruch hu, af al pi shehem nishkachim min haadam:
Vehaddin din emet. sheen hakkadosh baruch hu ba bitruneya im beriyyotav (avoda zara 3.):
Vehakkol metukkan lasseuda. echad tzaddikim veechad reshaim yesh lahem chelek laolam habba leachar sheggavu mehen et chovan:
Begimoniyyot shel zahav. chute zahav kefufin kegimon, kemo halachof keagmon (yeshaya noach), vesovvin haagudda:

Bemino hayu ogdin oto millematta. lekayyem mitzvat eged. veze lenoy bealma hava. verabbi yehuda letaameh deamar lulav tzarich eged, hilkach i aged leh shello bemino havu lehu chamishsha minin. vaanan kayma lan delulav en tzarich eged, hilkach beha halacha kerabbi meir:
Mekabbelet ishsha. et hallulav, velo amrinan dimtaltelet mide delo chazi la:
Umachzeret lammayim. shello yichmoshu:
Beshabbat machzirim. shehare mehem netalum hayyom. aval lo mosifim, vechol shekken sheen machlifin:
Uveyom tov mosifin. aval lo machlifim, lishpoch ellu velatet tzonnin mehen, detarach letakken mana:
Uvammoed. bechol hammoed mitzva lehachelif. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Chayyav ballulav. lechannecho middivre sofrim:
Yesh maalin. mashlimin learbaim sea:
Velo foslin. bishlosha luggin sheuvin. vechullehu mefaresh ketzad:
Hakkefor. geshamim sheyyordin nikpim:
Gelid. mayim shekkafu al pene haaretz o al pene hammayim:
Tit hannarok. tit rach verakik shennaasa chemo rok:

Even habbarad kammayim. kemayim sheuvim deamrinan lekamman poslim velo maalim. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri. vahalacha keedutan shel anshe medva sheosin mikve min hashsheleg afillu lechattechilla:
Nimtzeu maalin. shehishlimuhu:
Velo foslin. bishlosha luggin sheuvin. shehare sea hi harebe yoter mishshelosha luggin, velo nifsal hammikve vechach:
Hayyam haggadol kemikve. lo kara hakkatuv mikve ella layyam haggadol, deveh mishtae kera bemaase vereshit, sheshsham nikvu chol meme vereshit:
Lo neemar yammim. bilshon rabbim, ella mippene shemmeoravin bo mine yammim harebe, shekkol hannechalim holchim elav:

Rabbi yose omer kol hayyammim. veyam haggadol nammi torat mayan alehem lainyan shehem metaharin bezochalin, mippene shehannechalim holchim vezochalin alehem. aval pesulin hen letorat mayim chayyim, shehakkatuv keraan mikve. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Ten lo mishshello. lo timmana millehitassek becheftze shamayim ben begufecha ben bemamoncha, [sheencha noten mishshellecha, lo miggufecha velo mimmamoncha], sheatta umamoncha shello:

Ma nae ilan ze ma nae nir ze. hu haddin lechol sicha betela, ella sheddibber bahove shedderech holche derachim ledabber bema sheroim beenehem. veyesh omrim, deashmoinan revuta deaf al gav deal yede chen hu mevarech baruch shekkacha lo beolamo, af al pi chen maalin alav keillu mitchayyev benafsho, mippene shehifsik mimmishnato:
Nir. telem hammacharesha, kemo niru lachem nir (yirmeya 4):
Rabbi yehuda omer kabbetza. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda defachot mikkabbetza pasul:
Rabbi yose omer afillu bishte yadav. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Hechalil. harebe mine zemer hayu sham, veal shem shechalil kolo nishma yoter min haacherim nikreu kullam al shemo:

Chamishsha veshishsha. peamim chamishsha peamim shishsha. chal yom tov rishon lihyot beshabbat, hechalil shishsha. chal bishar yeme hachol, hechalil chamishsha, lefi sheeno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov:
Simchat bet hashshoeva. lefi shekkol simcha zo al sheivat hammayim shel nissuch, karu la simchat bet hashshoeva, al shem usheavtem mayim besason (yeshaya 12):
Lo yattir. eged shellah lesatrah, deha kol hayyom chovatah:
Aval morid. hu mimmenna hakkelim naim umatztzaot naot sheheela letochah:
Mippene chevod yom tov. sheyyerae kemechin likrato [lemakom] sheyyisad bo hallayla:

Yom shevii shel arava kulei. deavud hekkera ladaat shehi deorayta, kelomar halacha lemoshe missinay. umishshum hay hekkera tikkun dishvii shellah doche shabbat bammikdash, shebbaarava hayu makkifim et hammizbeach. vehaidna enah ella minhag neviim, shehinhigu et haam littol arava bashshevii chutz mearava shebballulav, veen mevarchin aleha:
Lulav haggazul pasul. dichtiv ulekachtem lachem, mishshellachem. uleachar yeush bealim nehi deshello hu shekkone oto beyeush, mikkol makom have mitzva habbaa baavera:
Vehayyavesh pasul. divchullehu bainan hadar velekka:
Shel ashera. ilan hanneevad:
Veshel ir hanniddachat pasul. delisrefa kae. velulav bae shiur, vehane kevan delisrefa kayme en shiuran kayyam:
Niktam rosho pasul. delo have hadar:
Nifretzu alav. veenan mechubbarin ella al yede agida:
Nifredu alav. mechubbarim hen bashshidra, ella shellemala hen nifradin lechan ulechan keanfe ilan:
Yeegdennu milmala. im nifredu alav yeaggedem sheyyihyu olim im hashshidra kishar lulavim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Tzinne har habbarzel. yesh dekalim shellulavin shellahen alehen ketzarim meod veen olin al orech hashshidra. im hen arukkin kol kach ad sherosho shel ze maggia letzad ikkaro shel ze kesherim:
Kol lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim. keneged orech hahadas vetefach yoter, kede lenanea bo, delulav bae lenanue kedilkamman:
Kede lenanea bo. tane, uchede lenanea bo, dehaynu tefach yoter al shelosha tefachim:
Shehayu vahen shelosha luggin mayim. beluin udevukin bahen, aval enan nirin been, hilkach lo gazru rabbanan, deen ze mikkere naflu:

Masoret seyag lattora. hammasoret shemmasru lanu chachamim bachaserot viterot shebbattora, hem gader vechizzuk lattora shebbichtav, sheal yedehem anu mevinim kamma mitzvot ech yaasu otam. kemo bassukkot bassukkot bassukkot, shenayim chaserim veechad male, shemmimmennu anu lomdim lehacheshir sukka beshalosh defanot. uchegon moade Adonai asher tikreu otam, shennichtav chaser bishlosha mekomot, lelammed, attem afillu shoggim, attem afillu mezidim, attem afillu mutim:
Maasrot seyag laosher. dichtiv asser teasser, asser bishvil shettitashsher (taanit 9):
Nedarim seyag lapperishut. bizman sheadam matchil bifrishut umityare shello yaavor, mekabbel alav bilshon neder shello yaase kach vechach, veal yede chen hu kovesh et yitzro:

Seyag lachachma shetika. bema anan kaymin, i bishtika middivre tora, hare kevar ketiv vehagita bo vegomer, i bishtika merchilut velashon hara ukelala, deorayta ninhu. ha eno medabber ella bishtika middivre harshut shebben adam lachavero, sheyyesh lo laadam lemaet haddibbur bahem kol ma sheefshar. vaalehem amar shelomo (Mishlei 17) gam evil macharish chacham yechashev:
Heeviro al gabbe chelim. sheheevir hammayan al dafne hakkeli mibbachutz:
Hare hu chemo shehaya. letaher bezochalim uvechol shehu:
Hare hu chemikve. devae arbaim sea uveashboren:
Uvilvad shello yatbil al gabbe hassafsal. gezera shemma yatbil bechelim. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Sheenah mekuddeshet. shello nitchannecha laavodat mizbeach. dei have mayte bimkuddeshet ifsilu lehu belina, shekkele sharet mekaddeshim kedichtiv (Shemot 30) kol hannogea bahem yikdash, vechol hakkadosh kedushshat hagguf nifsal belina:

Haya memalle min hakkiyyor. veaf al pi shehakkiyyor hukdash lichle sharet umekaddesh et memav, lo hayu nifsalim belina, lefi shehayu mashkiim oto mibbaerev babbor, kidamar beyoma [perek 3] af hu asa mucheni lakkiyyor shello yihyu memav nifsalim belina:
Shehammayim vehayyayin hammegullin. hayenu taama denitgalla memalle min hakkiyyor velo haya menassech [mehen], shehammayim [vehayyayin] hammegullin pesulim legabbe hammizbeach:
Shel arla veshel teruma temea pasul. deamar kera (Vayikra 23) ulekachtem lachem, sheyyihye rauy lachem:
Veim natal kasher. shehare yesh bah hetter achila:
Uvet hillel machshirin. deha chazi laaniyyim, keditnan maachilin et haaniyyim demay:
Birushalayim kulei. aval chutz lirushalayim lo, devainan lachem, sheyyehe rauy lachem:
Mi shehaya eved o ishsha o katan vechulei. mi sheeno chayyav bedavar eno motzi acherim yede chovatan, lechach tzarich sheyyaane acharav milla bemilla ma shehu omer:
Utehe lo meera. shello lamad:
One acharav haleluyah. al kol davar shehu omer, shekkach hayu regilin laanot achar makre et hahallel al kol davar vedavar haleluyah:
Kinnin. karbenot haof keruyin kinnin, leshon kan tzippor. veyesh bahen halachot chamurot, kegon im nitarvu chova vindava, o ola shemmaaseha lemala bechattat shemmaaseha lematta:
Ufitche nidda. hilchot nidda sheibbeda vistah utzericha lishmor ad shettachzor lefitchah. ufeamim shehi tzericha litbol 95 tevilot ledivre haomer tevila bizmannah mitzva:
Hen hen gufe halachot. ikkar tora shebbeal pe, shemmekabbelim aleha sachar:
Tekufot. inyan mahalach hammazzalot:
Vegimatriot. cheshbon haotiyyot:
Parperaot lachachma. kemo happarperaot shergilin leechol besof hasseuda lekinnuach derech taanug, kach hachachmot hallalu mechabbedot et baalehem beene habberiyyot:
Hazzochalin. kegon neharot shehen zochalin, hare hen kemayan umetaharin bezochalin uvechol shehen:
Vehannotfim. kegon me geshamim:
Kemikve. letaher bearbaim sea uveashboren:
Shehem kesherim. kezochalin. hoil venotfin muatim. vaafillu vemakom sheen kede tevila vazzochalin ella im ken notfin mashlimim lahem:
Venotfin sheasaan zochalin. kegon mikve shepparatz al sefato umemav yotzin vezochalin:
Somech afillu makkel. o kane, o zav o zava somchin bayyad o varegel, vesotmin mekom yetziat hammayim ad sheyyaamdu hammayim bemakom echad venaasim ashboren, veyored hattame vetovel:

Kol davar shehu mekabbel tuma. lo mibbaya zav vezava shehen temein, sheenan yecholim listom mekom yetziat hammayim bidehem o veraglehem kede lehaamid hammayim velaasotan ashboren, ella afillu tahor gamur, hoil vehu mekabbel tuma:

En mazchilin bo. kelomar en maamidin bo mekom hazzechila kede sheyyease ashboren veyuchal litbol bo. vetaama derabbi yose, deamar kera mikve mayim yihye tahor, havayatan tehe al yede tohora. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Haavik shebbammerchatz. keli shel mattechet meshukka baambati veyesh bo nekev, dichshennimasin me haambati mechamat hattevilot potchim hannekev shebbaavik veyotzim hammayim shebbaambati umamshichin lo mayim acherim nekiyyim vesotmim hannekev shello yetzu hammayim, vehammayim hannimshachim laambati hen kesherim litvila, dilachar sherachatzu vechammin shebbammerchatz nichnasim laambati vetovlim sham:
Bizman shehu vaemtza posel. lefi shekkol hammayim gerurim al gabbav, umayim haggerurim al gabbe chelim hare ellu fesulim:

Min hatztzad eno fosel. deen hammayim gerurim al gabbav, veen kan shauv ella ma shebbetocho, ushear hammayim havu lehu mikve chasher samuch lashshauv, umayim sheuvin betzad mayim kesherim lo fasle veaf al pi shennogim ze vaze:
Im mekabbelet haambati reviit. mayim kesherim kodem sheyyaggiu laavik, keillu mekabbelet arbaim sea dame, mishshum dirviit shiur mikve hi middeorayta lehatebil bah mechatin vetzinnoriyyot:

Im mekabbel haavik. kelomar kevan deavik hu heasuy lekabbala chol shehu, pasul bechol inyan sheyyihye, ben baemtza, ben min hatztzad, ben mekabbelet haambati reviit kodem shebba laavik, ben enah mekabbelet:
